MsgJp: なんだおまえは？　あ？　レオの使い？
MsgEn: Who are you? Huh? Leo's messenger?

MsgJp:
おい、声を低く――奴らに聞かせるな
――それで、なんの用だ
MsgEn:
Hey, lower your voice - don't let them hear you.
So, what do you want?

MsgJp:
あいつは昔からそうだ
自信たっぷりな態度で間違えやがる
MsgEn:
That person has always been like that, making
mistakes with a confident attitude.
Hey, what are you whispering about?

MsgJp: 騎士団風情に聞かせる話なんぞないわ！
MsgEn:
I have no stories to tell that would impress the
Knightly Order!

MsgJp:
その言葉、聞き捨てならない！
あんたも元は騎士だろう？
MsgEn:
That word, I can't ignore it! Were you also once
a Knight?

MsgJp:
んな昔のことは忘れたぜ！
もう５０年前だからな！
MsgEn:
I've forgotten about such ancient things!
It's already been 50 years!

MsgJp:
確かに俺がいた頃の騎士団は
誇り高き戦闘集団だった
MsgEn:
Indeed, the Knight's Order back when I was there
was a proud and elite combat unit.

MsgJp: ところが、今の騎士団はどうだ！？
MsgEn: However, how is the current Knight's Order!?

MsgJp: 口先だけの腰抜け集団だって言ってるんだよ！
MsgEn:
I'm saying they're a group of cowards who only
talk big!

MsgJp:
な？　魔物討伐の優先権があるってなら
さっさとやっつけろよ！
MsgEn:
Huh? If there's a priority for slaying monsters,
then hurry up and defeat them already!

MsgJp:
何度も倒している！
しかし、倒しても、また現れるのだ
MsgEn:
I have defeated it many times!
However, no matter how many times I take it down,
it keeps reappearing.

MsgJp:
どこかに巣窟があり、そこを叩かねば
ならないと協議しているところへ貴様が来て――
MsgEn:
There is a nest somewhere, and we must strike it.
And just as we were discussing this, you came――

MsgJp: ほら来た言い訳騎士団！
MsgEn: Here comes the excuse-making Knight Order!

MsgJp: 今度はなんだ？　奴らに聞かせるなよ
MsgEn: What is it this time? Don't let them hear you.

MsgJp:
なんだと！？
魔物を倒しただって？
MsgEn:
What did you say!?
You defeated the enemy?

MsgJp:
騎士団さんよ、人が悪いぜ
魔物はすっかり倒したらしいじゃねえか
MsgEn:
Hey, knights! Cut the slack. It seems the
monsters are all defeated.

MsgJp:
ったく！
おれたちは帰る！　ああ、帰るぞ！
MsgEn:
Seriously! We're going back! Yeah, we're going
back!

MsgJp: おまえ、騎士団副長のハインツだろ？
MsgEn: Are you the vice captain of the Knights, Heinz?

MsgJp:
そこまで出世するってのは
よほど話のわかる奴に違いねえ
MsgEn:
To achieve such success, one must truly
understand the ways of the world.

MsgJp:
だから、ここの魔物を退治したのは
あんたか部下の誰かってことにしておけ
MsgEn:
So, let's just say that you or one of your
subordinates took care of defeating the enemies
here.

MsgJp: それから新入り、おまえ――

いろいろ文句はあるだろうが全部飲み込め
疑問も飲み込め
MsgEn:
There may be various complaints, but swallow them
all.
Swallow your doubts as well.

MsgJp:
ここにいる全員、おまえの手柄は忘れない
だが、公式には騎士団が倒したことにする
MsgEn:
Everyone here will never forget your achievement,
but officially, we'll credit the knighthood for
defeating it.

MsgJp: はん！　その手には乗るか！
MsgEn: Hah! Will you fall for that trap?!

MsgJp:
恩を売りつけようというのか？
貸しを作っておこうという魂胆か！？
MsgEn:
Are you trying to sell me your favor?
Or is your intention to create a debt!?

MsgJp:
怒声が木々に響き渡っているが――
揉め事ではないだろうな
MsgEn:
The angry voice echoes through the trees, but it
doesn't seem like a quarrel.

MsgJp:
信じられないことだが、騎士と見れば
因縁をつける志の低い覚者もいるようだ
MsgEn:
It's hard to believe, but there are some
low-minded Arisen who pick fights with Knights at
the slightest provocation.
I didn't mean to provoke anyone!

MsgJp:
騎士団長さんよ、信じてやりな
こいつはおれたちの不作法をいさめただけだ
MsgEn:
Oh, Captain of the Knights, please believe me.
This person merely reprimanded our rudeness.

MsgJp:
ハインツたち、いい仕事をしたぜ？
魔物はもういない――静かなもんだ
MsgEn:
Heinz and the others, did a great job, huh?
The enemies are gone now... It's so peaceful.

MsgJp:
――ほう
任務はすでに完了したというのか
MsgEn:
Oh, is it true that the mission has already been
completed?

MsgJp:
ふむ――
レオから報告を受けて慌ててここへ来たが
MsgEn:
Hmm――
I hurriedly came here upon receiving a report
from Leo, but...

MsgJp:
取り越し苦労だったようだな
では、一同、神殿へ戻るがいい
MsgEn:
It seems that we were overly worried.
Well then, everyone, let us return to the Temple.

MsgJp: よし、じゃあ、覚者も解散だ！
MsgEn:
Alright, then. It's time for the Arisen to
disband as well!

MsgJp:
お疲れだったな
特におまえ――よくこらえた、いい根性だ
MsgEn:
You must be exhausted.
Especially you - you endured well.
You have great willpower.

MsgJp:
こんなところで――
奇遇だな
MsgEn:
In a place like this...
What a coincidence.

MsgJp:
我々白騎団の捜索だけでは
心許ない――
MsgEn:
We cannot rely solely on our White Knights search
efforts—

MsgJp: ジョゼフ殿のご判断か

ともあれ、メイリーフ嬢は
このあたりにはいない
MsgEn: Anyway, Lady Mayleaf is not around this area.

MsgJp:
森にいるとすれば
さらに奥――
MsgEn: If she's in the forest, it must be further inside.

MsgJp:
いや待て――
これはトロールの足跡！？
MsgEn:
Wait, could it be...
These are the footprints of a Troll!?

MsgJp:
はるか向こうまで続いているようだ
新しいぞ――？
MsgEn:
It seems to continue far beyond. Is there
something new...?

MsgJp: メイリーフ嬢はすでに！？
ここ、お友達のお墓なの――
MsgEn: This is the grave of a friend...

MsgJp:
わたしがもっと幼かった頃――
あの子も同い年で――
MsgEn:
When I was younger...
That child was also the same age as me...

MsgJp:
どこへ行くにも――
何をするのも一緒だった――
MsgEn:
Wherever we go—
Whatever we do—it's together—

MsgJp:
でも、あの子は――
大人になって――
わたしを遠ざけるようになった――
MsgEn: She started keeping her distance from me—

MsgJp:
わたしがいつまでたっても
少女のままだったから――
MsgEn: Because I will forever remain a young girl—

MsgJp:
彼女となら
ずっと仲良くできると思っていたのに――
MsgEn:
I thought I could always get along with her,
but...

MsgJp:
結局、あの子は
わたしを遠ざけたまま――
MsgEn: In the end, that child keeps me at a distance--

MsgJp:
わたしを怪物扱いしたまま
自分はしわくちゃに老いて――
MsgEn:
Continuing to treat me like a monster, they age,
becoming wrinkled...

MsgJp:
それ以来、人間とは
仲良くならないようにしてるんだ
MsgEn:
Since then, I have been avoiding getting close to
humans.

MsgJp:
いつも距離を置いて
お互い、つかず、離れず、ね
MsgEn:
Always keeping a distance,
Neither too close nor too far, that's how we
should be, you know.

MsgJp:
わたしが人間じゃないって
話したかな？
MsgEn: Did I ever say that I'm not human?

MsgJp:
人間とは
生きている時間が違うの

あなたは――
あなたやレオやイリスは特別
MsgEn: You are... You, Leo, and Iris are special.

MsgJp:
心臓が時を刻まないから――
年を取らないんだよね
MsgEn:
Because the heart doesn't mark the passage of
time -
it doesn't age, you know.

MsgJp:
わたしはゆっくりだけど
年を取る――
あなたたちは取らない――

わたしの背が伸びて
胸がふくらんだり――
MsgEn: My height has grown, and my chest has swelled...

MsgJp:
腰が曲がって
お婆さんになったり――
MsgEn: My back bends and I become an old lady.

MsgJp:
はい――これで告白はお・わ・り
じゃあ、また、神殿で！
MsgEn:
Yes... With this, the confession is o-ver.
Well then, I'll see you again at the Temple!

MsgJp:
はぁ――はぁ――
ジョゼフ様のご命令でね

メイリーフを見つけて
仲良くなっておけって――
MsgEn: He told me to find Mayleaf and befriend her-

MsgJp:
逃げた方がいいって！ 
キリがないぞ！？
MsgEn: It's better to run away! There's no end to this!

MsgJp: 誰かっ！　誰か助けて！

MsgEn: That's the second time you and I have done this.

MsgJp:
そういえば
自己紹介がまだだった

我々の出会いは
いつも慌ただしいな

メイリーフの行方には
心当たりがある
MsgEn: I have an idea about the whereabouts of Mayleaf.

MsgJp:
あの子の保護は
僕に任せてくれ
MsgEn: Please entrust the protection of that child to me.

MsgJp:
彼女の身を案じることに
かけては――
MsgEn: When it comes to caring for her well-being...

MsgJp: 僕の方が上だと自負している
MsgEn: I take pride in believing that I am superior.
You should return to the Temple...

MsgJp:
自陣の結束を
確認しておいた方がいい
MsgEn: You should make sure your forces are united.

MsgJp:
人の繋がりなど――
脆いものだから
MsgEn:
Human connections and the like—
They are fragile things.

MsgJp:
ねえ、急いで神殿へ戻ろう
嫌な予感がする
MsgEn:
Hey, let's hurry and return to the Temple.
I have a bad feeling about this.

MsgJp:
――いや
嫌なものを見たっていうか――
MsgEn:
- No... It's more like I saw something
unpleasant...

MsgJp:
狙いはエルフだぞ！　いいな？
小さいぞ！　見逃すな！
MsgEn:
The target is an elf, got it? Small one! Don't
let them escape!

MsgJp:
メイリーフ
俺から離れるな！
奴らは僕が引きつける
いや、敵は俺たちが引き受ける
MsgEn: No, we'll take on the enemy.

MsgJp:
あんたみたいな優男に
あの大軍は無理だ
MsgEn:
A delicate man like you can't handle that massive
army.

MsgJp: そう――ただの優男ではない
MsgEn: I'm not just some delicate man.

MsgJp:
さあ、愚かなオークどもよ！
エルフの命欲しくば――いざ！
MsgEn:
Now, foolish Orcs!
If you desire the lives of the Elves,
then come forth!
Don't you want to go and help?

MsgJp:
エルフなら
うまく逃げ切るさ
MsgEn:
An Elf like him, should be able to escape
successfully.

MsgJp:
ただ今より、ここを最前線とする！
戦士たちよ！　退くな！　下がるな！
MsgEn:
From this moment on, this place shall be the
forefront!
Soldiers, do not retreat! Do not step back!

MsgJp:
なんだ？
何が起こっている！？
ほーら、こい、こい、こっちへこい！
MsgEn: Come on, come on, come over here!

MsgJp:
モゴック――エルフ野郎の居場所がわかった
エルテ・ディナンだ
MsgEn:
Mogok... I found the whereabouts of that Elf
bastard.
It's Erte Deenan.

MsgJp: ははっ！　ズールよ、そりゃいい

ろくでなしども！　引き上げるぞ！
エルテ・ディナンへ行く
MsgEn: Rotten scoundrels! We're going to Erte Deenan!

MsgJp:
ああ、ハインツ、丁度良かった
わたしを神殿まで連れて帰ってくれ
MsgEn:
Ah, Heinz, just in time.
Please take me back to the Temple.

MsgJp:
それはもちろん！
このわたしと――
ローガンとデュークにお任せください
MsgEn: Leave it to Logan and Duke.

MsgJp:
世話になったな
年寄りの世話は終わりだ
MsgEn:
I'm indebted to you.
My care for the elderly is over.
Then, let's meet at the temple.

MsgJp: なんだか、久しぶりだね
MsgEn: It's been a while, hasn't it?

MsgJp:
一番最近会ったのはキノザ――
ううん、《禊の神殿》だ
MsgEn:
The most recent one I met was in Kinoza—
No, it was in the "Temple of Purification".

MsgJp: あの時は迷惑をかけちゃったな
MsgEn: I caused you trouble back then.

MsgJp:
いや、違うよね？
前回会ったのはアークの中だった
MsgEn:
No, that's not right, is it?
The last time we met was inside the Ark.

MsgJp:
あの時、あんたもいたよね？
レオと一緒に――
MsgEn:
Back then, you were there too, right?
Together with Leo...

MsgJp:
そう――来てないんだ
え？　伝言？
MsgEn: No... they haven't come yet. Huh? A message?

MsgJp:
「命がけで身を隠せ」――か
うん、了解
MsgEn: "Hide yourself at all costs" — Got it.

MsgJp: じゃあ、こっちからもレオに伝えて
MsgEn:
Well, then, let's also convey it to Leo from our
side.

MsgJp: 「村に迷惑をかけたくないから山に隠れる」って
MsgEn:
"I don't want to be a nuisance to the village, so
I'll hide in the mountains," is what you're
saying, right?

MsgJp:
さて、わたし、行くよ
――神殿のみんなによろしく
MsgEn:
Well, I'm off.
――Please give my regards to everyone at the
Temple.

MsgJp: 始まりは、荒波を海岸に叩きつけた強い風
MsgEn:
It all began with a strong wind that slammed the
rough waves onto the shore.

MsgJp: 続いて水平線に現れた黒雲は、夜のとばりの如く
MsgEn:
The black clouds that appeared on the horizon
continued, like a veil of night,

MsgJp: レスタニアを覆い、重い雨で大地を穿った
MsgEn:
Covering Lestania, it pierced the earth with
heavy rain.

MsgJp: これほどの自然の猛威は白竜の記憶にもなかった
MsgEn:
This level of natural devastation was not even
recorded in the White Dragon's memory.

MsgJp: 人々は怖れ、おののき、祈った
MsgEn: The people were afraid, trembling, and prayed.

MsgJp: その祈りを知ってか知らずか――
MsgEn:
Whether the White Dragon knew about those prayers
or not...

MsgJp: 白竜は、覚者たちを神殿に集めるよう
MsgEn:
The White Dragon commanded the Arisen to gather
in the temple.

MsgJp: では、各自、割り当てに従い現地へ向かってくれ
MsgEn:
Now, each of you, follow your assigned location
and go there.

MsgJp: 状況の把握が目的だが、優先すべきは人命だ
MsgEn:
Although the purpose is to assess the situation,
saving lives should be the priority.

MsgJp: 怯える民に白竜の加護を伝えよ！
MsgEn:
Deliver the protection of the White Dragon to the
frightened people!

MsgJp: が、若い女は面倒だ、おまえに任せる
MsgEn:
Ugh, young women are such trouble.
I'll leave this to you.

MsgJp: ――小娘ってのは、いつも俺の想像を越えやがる
MsgEn: Ladies... They never fail to surprise me!

MsgJp: オマイ！　またオマイか！

あの時はよくもやってくれたなあ！
ああ、覚えているとも！
MsgEn:
You really pulled it off back then!
Ah yes, I remember it well!

MsgJp:
踏んづけて地面にめり込ませてやりたいが
今は忙しい
MsgEn:
I'd like to stomp you into the ground,
but I'm too busy right now.

MsgJp: ――オレは、特別な女を探している
MsgEn: ――I am looking for a special woman.

MsgJp:
オマイ、オレの手先になって、女を
探さないか？
MsgEn: Will you be my henchman and help me find a woman?

MsgJp:
――ふん、また邪魔する気だな！
つくづく、面倒な奴め！
MsgEn:
Hmph, once again you intend to interfere!
You truly are a bothersome individual!

MsgJp: ふん――調子に乗るがいい――
MsgEn: Hmph, you better not get too carried away.

MsgJp:
だがな、オマイらはオレを見るたびに
怖れおののくことになるぞ
MsgEn:
But you all, every time you lay eyes on me, you
end up trembling in fear.

MsgJp:
オレの主（あるじ）は
ディアマンテスだと思っておろうが――
MsgEn:
My master is...
I know you think he's Diamantes, but...

MsgJp: 我が主は、ああ偉大なり、黒き鎧の騎士！
MsgEn:
My Lord, oh how magnificent you are, the Knight
in black armor!

MsgJp:
オレは黒騎士の不死身のポーン
何度でも蘇り、オマイの前に立ちふさがってやるわ
MsgEn:
I am the undying Pawn of the Black Knight.
I will resurrect countless times and stand before
you.

MsgJp:
女を差し出さねば
オマイらの悪夢は永遠に終わらんぞ！
MsgEn:
If you don't hand over the woman, your nightmares
will never end!

MsgJp: しっかし、ズールが黒騎士のポーンだったとは！
MsgEn: But to think Zuhl is a Pawn of the Black Knight!

MsgJp:
セシリー、知ってた？
君がここにいた理由と関係ある？
MsgEn:
Cecily, did you know?
Does it have anything to do with the reason you
are here?

MsgJp: わたしが追われる理由――
MsgEn: The reason why I am being chased—

MsgJp:
――ずっと考えているんです
雨が目に入ってつらかったこと――
MsgEn:
I have been thinking about it all the time.
The pain of rain getting into my eyes -

MsgJp:
間近に迫る黒騎士がおそろしかったこと――
生き延びねばならないと決意していたこと――
MsgEn:
The terrifying Black Knight approaching—
The determination to survive—

MsgJp: 覚えているのはそれだけです

わたし、どこかの島に
あなたを飛ばしてしまったそうですね
MsgEn:
I heard that I accidentally sent you to some
island, didn't I?

MsgJp:
場所を覚えていますか？
今一度、そこへ行けないでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Do you remember the place?
Can you go there again?

MsgJp:
騎士団が全力で探してるよ
大丈夫、きっと見つかるって
MsgEn:
The Knights are searching with all their might.
Don't worry, they will surely find it.

MsgJp: 隊長、神殿へ戻りましょう
MsgEn: Captain, let's return to the temple.

MsgJp:
島のことが気になるし、ズールの件も報告しないと
ジョゼフ様、今頃、ぷりぷり怒ってますって
MsgEn:
I'm curious about the island, and I need to
report about Zuhl as well.
Master Joseph must be furious by now.

MsgJp: 心強い援軍が来てくれた
MsgEn:
We have received reinforcements that give us
strength.

MsgJp: 統率の右腕と呼ばれし者だ――
MsgEn:
He is known as the right-hand man of our
commander.

MsgJp: さあ、もうひと揉みしてやろうぞ！
MsgEn: Well, shall I give you another massage!

MsgJp:
わはははは！
これは気分がいい

セシリーがあんまり心配するから
連れてきちゃった
MsgEn:
Because Cecily was so worried, I ended up
bringing her along.

MsgJp: 見事な戦いぶりでした！

人々が覚者を頼りにする理由が
わかったような気がします
MsgEn:
I feel like I understand why people rely on Arisen
now.

MsgJp: 竜に選ばれ、竜を守る者
MsgEn: Chosen by the dragon, defender of the dragon.

MsgJp:
それだけの力を授けられているからね
もちろん、その力は、竜とレスタニアのために使うの
MsgEn:
Because I have been bestowed with such power, I
will use it for the sake of the dragons and
Lestania, of course.
But you know, there are also worries.

MsgJp:
ずっと先の話だけど、覚者の誰かが
白竜様を引き継ぐことになるんだよね
MsgEn:
It's a story far in the future, but someday,
someone among the Arisen will inherit the White
Dragon.

MsgJp: 新しい白竜として、レスタニアに君臨するの
MsgEn:
To become the new White Dragon and reign over
Lestania.

MsgJp:
不安っていうのはね、その時、竜になれなかった
覚者はどうなっちゃうんだろうってこと
MsgEn:
You see, the unease comes from wondering what
happens to the Arisen who couldn't become dragons
at that time.

MsgJp: 竜に力を返して――死んじゃうのかな？
MsgEn:
Returning power to the dragon... will it mean
I'll die?

MsgJp:
それとも――よぼよぼになって
しわくちゃで生きながらえるのかな――
MsgEn:
Or maybe... will I just become feeble and
shriveled, barely surviving...

MsgJp:
レスタニアの大地のため――
暮らす人々のために使命をまっとうする――
MsgEn:
For the land of Lestania—
For the people who inhabit it, I will fulfill my
mission—

MsgJp:
未来はどうあれ、後悔のない今を生きること――
わたしにはとても素敵に映りました
MsgEn:
No matter what the future holds, living in the
present without regrets - that is what seemed
really wonderful to me.

MsgJp: ま、そうだね、ちょっと照れくさいけど、その通り！
MsgEn:
Well, yeah, it's a little embarrassing but it's
true!

MsgJp: イリスを覚えているな？

おまえは知るまいが、かつて、覚者仲間に
イリスという女がいた
MsgEn:
You may not know, but there was once a woman
named Iris who was a fellow Arisen.

MsgJp:
人懐こく、明るい娘だったが
心の中に闇を抱えていた
MsgEn:
She was a friendly and cheerful girl, but she
carried darkness within her heart.

MsgJp: その闇を、邪悪な力に利用されてな――
MsgEn: That darkness, was used by an evil power...

MsgJp: 結果、オレはイリスを殺した
MsgEn: As a result, I had to kill Iris.

MsgJp:
心中、お察しします
でも、わたしには――関係ありません
MsgEn:
I understand your feelings.
However, it does not concern me.

MsgJp: 見たところ、おまえの闇は深そうだ
MsgEn: It seems like your darkness runs deep.

MsgJp:
わかりません
それよりも、ロイグに会わせてください！
MsgEn:
You're not making sense.
Please let me see Loeg!

MsgJp: 無事で何よりだ、セシリー
族長ガラダの娘、セシリーだろ？
MsgEn:
The daughter of tribe chief Gearóid, Cecily,
right?

MsgJp:
そうです！　わたしの父はガラダ
そう、わたしは――ガラダの娘です！
MsgEn:
That's right! My father is Gearóid.
Yes, I am... Gearóid's daughter!

MsgJp:
他には、他には何か知りませんか？
教えてください！
MsgEn: Do you know anything else? Please tell me!

MsgJp:
黒騎士に追われている理由！
わたしの、内なる力と――
MsgEn:
The reason I'm being chased by the Black Knight!  
It's my inner power and――

MsgJp: この焼けるような使命感の正体は！？
MsgEn:
What is the true nature of this burning sense of
purpose!?

MsgJp: 悪いけど――知らないんだ

わたしが知っているのは
君が黒騎士に追われているという事実だけ
MsgEn:
The only thing I know is that you are being
pursued by the Black Knight.

MsgJp:
理由は知らない
なんとかして助けようと思った
MsgEn:
I don't know the reason, but I wanted to find a
way to help.

MsgJp: でも、その望みは叶わず、こうして、ここに――
MsgEn: But, that wish was not granted, and so, here...

MsgJp: どうしてセシリーを助けようと思ったの？
MsgEn: Why did you think of helping Cecily?

MsgJp:
取り繕っても仕方がないから正直に言うと――
族長の娘だからさ
MsgEn:
There's no point in lying, you're the daughter
of the chief of the tribe after all.

MsgJp: 族長に一目置かれたかった
MsgEn: I wanted to earn the respect of the chief.

MsgJp: なーんだ、ロマンティックな話かと――
MsgEn: Well, what a romantic story it turned out to be...

MsgJp: 見つけたぞ！　女を渡せ！
MsgEn: I found her! Hand over the woman!

MsgJp:
はぁ――はぁ――
オレが倒れたら――黒騎士様が動き出すぞ
MsgEn:
Haa... haa...
When I fall... the Black Knight will move.

MsgJp: 魔物どもが主の意思により動くとなれば――
MsgEn:
If these monsters move according to their
master's will...

MsgJp:
クックックッ――
もはやレスタニアに安寧はない――
MsgEn:
Kukukku...
There will be no peace in Lestania anymore...

MsgJp:
すっごい捨て台詞だったよね
これで腐れ縁に終止符！　やったね！
MsgEn:
That was a really cliché line, wasn't it?
This puts an end to our cursed fate! We did it!

MsgJp:
口惜しい――どうして記憶が戻らないの？
どうして？
MsgEn:
How frustrating... Why can't I regain my memories?
Why?

MsgJp:
大地を巡る竜力が淀み、集まる場所がある
そこで竜力を取り入れれば――
MsgEn:
Dragon Force, the power of dragons that
circulates through the earth, gathers in a certain
place. By harnessing the Dragon Force there...

MsgJp:
覚者は更なる力を手に入れることができる
いつか話してくれただろう？
MsgEn:
Arisen can obtain even greater power.
Didn't you mention it before?

MsgJp:
その地を、教えてほしい
レオ――レスタニアの危機だ
MsgEn:
I want you to tell me about that place, Leo—
Lestania is in danger.

MsgJp:
生まれ合わせた時代のせいで
俺たちは理から外れた覚者になった
MsgEn:
Because of the era we were born into, we have
become Arisen who are outside of order.

MsgJp:
多勢は心強いが――
その代償は分散した竜の力
MsgEn:
While having many allies is reassuring, the price
for that is the dispersed power of the dragons.

MsgJp:
納得しているつもりだったが
黄金竜との対決で、考えずにはいられなかった
MsgEn:
I thought I understood and accepted it, but I
couldn't help but think during the confrontation
with the Golden Dragon.

MsgJp: なぜあいつを倒せないのか――
MsgEn: Why can't we defeat that guy—

MsgJp: それは、俺が弱いからだ

竜の力を存分に継承していないことを
思わずにはいられない
MsgEn:
I can't help but think that they haven't fully
inherited the power of the dragon.

MsgJp:
時代の巡り合わせだからと
したり顔ではいられない
MsgEn:
We can't just pretend it's just a coincidence of
the times.
Since then, I have left the temple...

MsgJp:
俺は、分散してしまった力を補う方法を
探し求めてきた
MsgEn:
I have been searching for ways to replenish the
dispersed power.

MsgJp:
覚者とは、竜の敵と戦う者
言ったのは俺だったな――
MsgEn:
What is an Arisen? It is one who fights against
the enemies of dragons.
It was I who said that —

MsgJp: ともに権利を主張して、力を手に入れようか
MsgEn: Shall we both claim our rights and obtain power?

MsgJp:
その力を合わせれば、黒騎士など
たやすく討伐できるだろう
MsgEn:
If we combine our powers, we should be able to
easily defeat the Black Knight and others.

MsgJp: まるで何かを恐れているようだ
MsgEn: It seems as though they are afraid of something.

MsgJp: ここ連日の不吉な予兆は私も感じている
MsgEn:
I also feel the ominous signs that have been
occurring here in recent days.

MsgJp:
よし、万一の事態に備え
急ぎ神殿にも事の次第を伝えよ
MsgEn:
Alright, prepare for any unforeseen circumstances
and quickly inform the Temple of the situation.

MsgJp:
地図が示しているのはこのあたり――
いや、まさにここだな
MsgEn:
What the map is showing is this area right here—
No, it's exactly here.

MsgJp: それらしいものは何もない、が――
MsgEn: There's nothing that seems to be like it, but...

MsgJp:
――わたしはわかったぞ
ここは特別な場所だ
MsgEn:
――I understand.
This is a special place.

MsgJp: おまえは思い出せないのか？
レオが統率になって間もない頃だ
MsgEn: It was around the time when Leo took command.

MsgJp: ほら、わたしとおまえ、そしてイリス――
あいつは演習と称し、わたしたち４人でここを訪れた
MsgEn:
He called it a training exercise and brought the
four of us here.

MsgJp:
だが、それはオーク相手の連戦に疲れ切った
わたしたちを労う、レオの気づかいだった
MsgEn:
However, it was Leo's thoughtfulness,
acknowledging our exhaustion from the continuous
battles with the orcs.

MsgJp: 結局、覚者の仲が深まったんだよな
MsgEn: In the end, the bond between the Arisen deepened.

MsgJp: 覚者同士の絆こそが、宝だと考えたのかも知れない
MsgEn:
Perhaps they thought that the bond between Arisen
was a treasure.

MsgJp: あれ以来、こうして出かけることはなかった
MsgEn:
Since that incident, I haven't been able to go
out like this.

MsgJp:
今となっては、覚者隊が同じ境遇といえるだろう――
エリオット、リズ、ガルドリン――
MsgEn:
Now, the Arisen Corps would be able to say that
they are in the same situation as well -
Elliot, Lise, and Gurdolin -

MsgJp:
仲間への想いは、レオと共に戦い続けた
あんたなら一番分かっているはずだ
MsgEn:
The feelings for my companions have endured, as I
continued to fight alongside Leo.
You, of all people, should understand that the
most.

MsgJp: あいつは、消えちまった後も――
残る俺たちの結束を気にしてるんだろうよ
MsgEn:
You're probably concerned about the unity of the
rest of us.

MsgJp:
ふっ――とんだお節介だな
しかし実にレオらしい
MsgEn:
Hmph... Quite meddlesome, aren't you?
However, it's very much like Leo.

MsgJp:
私たち覚者とレスタニアの未来には
まだまだ試練が待ち受けているだろう
MsgEn:
In the future of us Arisen and Lestania, there
are still many trials awaiting us.

MsgJp:
ああ、その日に備え俺たちが
レオのメッセージを心に刻んでおかないとな
MsgEn:
Ah, we must engrave Leo's message in our hearts
in preparation for that day.

MsgJp: 黒竜は討たれ、長きに渡った動乱の時代は終わった
MsgEn:
The Black Dragon has been slain, and the era of
long-lasting turmoil has come to an end.

MsgJp:
竜たちの大陸はそれぞれの問題を抱えたまま
未来に向かって歩き始める
MsgEn:
The continents of dragons each continue to face
their own problems as they begin to walk towards
the future.

MsgJp:
道しるべなき旅に出た者――
共に戦った仲間と手を取り、進もうとする者――
MsgEn:
Those who embark on a journey without a guide――
They are the ones who join hands with their
comrades and press forward――

MsgJp:
彼らが竜の加護を忘れずに歩む限り
竜も彼らを見守り続けるだろう
MsgEn:
As long as they walk without forgetting the
Dragon's Protection, the dragon will continue to
watch over them.

MsgJp:
人と竜が等しく生きる時代の訪れ――
その時代を切り開いた英雄は
MsgEn:
The arrival of an era where humans and dragons
live as equals—
The hero who paved the way for that era is—

MsgJp:
竜や王ではなく
仲間と共に戦い抜いたひとりの覚者であった
MsgEn:
Not a dragon or a king, but a single Arisen who
fought alongside comrades.

MsgJp: ゥゴアアアアァァァァ――――――ッッ！！

この臭いを忘れるな
オークの接近は臭いでわかる
MsgEn:
Don't forget this smell.
An Orc's approach is given away by its odor.

MsgJp: いつか鼻がバカになるだろうが――
MsgEn: It drives my nose madder by the day.

MsgJp:
その頃まで生きのびていれば
オークごときにやられることはない
MsgEn:
If you manage to survive this ordeal,
there's nothing an Orc can do to you.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦だ
走るぞ
MsgEn:
That's Fort Gritten.
We must hurry.

MsgJp:
急いで――
ほら、オークちゃんが逃げちゃうよ！
MsgEn:
Come on, hurry up!
That little Orc over there is trying to escape!

『たったひとりの人間の野心が世界のありようを
変えてしまったのですから』
MsgEn:
"...for the ambitions of one man
had changed the state of an entire world."

MsgJp: 『まだ消えるわけにはいかない』
MsgEn: "'Tis not yet granted me to wither from the world."

MsgJp: 『レスタニアを愛する者たちよ――』
MsgEn: "Ye who dost cherish this land of Lestania..."

MsgJp: 『堅き砦となり、わたしを守ってくれ』
MsgEn:
"Become thou a steadfast bulwark,

MsgEn:
"The great Order is far more fragile

number of the Arisen, one at a time.

『たったひとりの人間の野心が世界のありようを
変えてしまったのですから』
MsgEn:
"...for the ambitions of one man
had changed the state of an entire world."

is called Lestania,
where beneath the wings of the White Dragon

MsgJp: 竜への崇敬と感謝が文明を育み――
MsgEn:
The civilization grew prosperous, with great
reverence and gratitude to the White Dragon;

MsgJp:
人の叡智は生と死の理すら
乗り越えようとしていた
MsgEn:
its people grew in wisdom enough
to seek overcoming death itself.

MsgJp:
どこからともなく現れた黄金色の竜が
大いなる白竜に戦いを挑んだ
MsgEn:
a Golden Dragon emerged to challenge
the White Dragon in battle.

The battle between the two raged for
over three days and three nights,

MsgJp: 誰もがその様子に固唾を呑んだ
MsgEn:
while the people awaited the
outcome with bated breath.

MsgJp: 四日目の日の出前だった

MsgJp: 祈りが通じたのだろうか――

MsgJp: 白竜の痛撃が黄金の胸を貫き――
MsgEn:
the White Dragon triumphed and
struck down the Golden Dragon,

MsgJp: まばゆい翼は光を失い
MsgEn:
but as the White Dragon's bright
resplendent wings lost their light,

MsgJp: 人々は胸を撫で下ろしたが――
MsgEn:
Though the people breathed
sighs of relief at its triumph,

the White Dragon had suffered
grievous wounds in battle.

MsgJp: 頭を上げ、再び天空に昇ろうとしたが
MsgEn:
The White Dragon raised its head and
tried to soar back into the skies;

MsgJp: 人々は傷ついた白竜の周囲に集い
MsgEn:
The people then gathered
around the injured dragon

MsgJp: やがて白竜は弱々しい声で言った
MsgEn: Before long, the White Dragon said weakly,

MsgJp: 『おまえたちを覚者にしてやろう』
『まだ消えるわけにはいかない』
MsgEn: "'Tis not yet granted me to wither from the world."

MsgJp: 『レスタニアを愛する者たちよ――』
MsgEn: "Ye who dost cherish this land of Lestania..."

MsgJp: 『堅き砦となり、わたしを守ってくれ』
MsgEn:
"Become thou a steadfast bulwark,
and guard me well."

MsgEn:
the White Dragon increased the
number of the Arisen, one at a time.

MsgJp: レスタニアの大地に立とうとしていた
MsgEn: stands on the grounds of Lestania.
We don't know anyone by that name!

MsgJp: 黒き鎧をまといし者よ
MsgEn: O wearer of the black armor.

MsgJp: ここは我が大地、レスタニア

戻ってくんなよ――イテテ――
誰か、治療できるか？
MsgEn:
Don't come back, okay? Ouch...
Can someone treat this?

MsgJp: 無事で良かったって言いましたよね
MsgEn: I said I'm glad you're safe, didn't I?

MsgJp: 状況はなーんにも変わってねえ
MsgEn: The situation hasn't changed at all.

MsgJp:
さっきの、侵食魔とはまるでちがう
新手の魔物だよね
MsgEn:
It's completely different from the previous
corruption monster.
It's a new type of enemy, isn't it?

MsgJp:
これまでとは段違いの強さだ
黒騎士のお仲間だろうよ
MsgEn:
This is a completely different level of strength
compared to before.
They must be one of the Black Knight's comrades.

MsgJp:
おい、隊長
島の調査なんてしてる場合じゃねえぞ
MsgEn:
Hey, Captain.
This is no time to be conducting investigations
on the island.

MsgJp:
黒騎士をおびき寄せてでも、ぶっ倒さねえと
ラチがあかねえ
MsgEn:
I won't rest until I've taken down the Black
Knight, even if I have to draw him out myself!

MsgJp:
隊長、一度戻ろうよ
体勢を立て直して、出直そう！
MsgEn:
Captain, let's go back and regroup once.
We can reassess our position!

Is this it――
This is it――
It's hot, my wounds... they ache...

MsgJp: どうしよう――抑えられない――
MsgEn: What should I do... I can't hold back...

MsgJp:
ほらな！
そうくると思ったぜ！
MsgEn:
See!
I knew it would come to this!

MsgJp: 竜との約束を悔いるがいい
MsgEn: Regret your promise with the dragon!

MsgJp:
なんだこりゃ！
最悪の展開じゃねえか！
MsgEn:
What the hell is this!
This is the worst outcome!

MsgJp: おい、さっさと引き上げるぞ

セシリーを運べ！
俺はロイグだ！
MsgEn:
Move Cecily!
Leave Loeg to me!

MsgJp: 来ます――黒騎士の気配がします
MsgEn: Here it comes - I sense the presence of the Black Knight.

MsgJp: 死に損なったか、セシリー――
MsgEn: Did you fail to die, Cecily...

MsgJp: でも、まるっきり魔物じゃない！？
MsgEn: But it's not entirely an enemy!?

MsgJp: そうまでして蘇りたいかねえ
MsgEn:
Do you really want to go to such lengths just to
be revived?

MsgJp: 所詮、定めにはあらがえぬ！
MsgEn: After all, you can't go against fate!
Are you getting in the way?

MsgJp: その輝きは、生ある世界を見つめるためにある
MsgEn:
The brilliance exists to gaze upon the living
world.

MsgJp: 守れなくて、なんのための覚者だ！
MsgEn:
If I can't protect, what's the point of being an
Arisen?
No one will be lost anymore!

MsgJp: そのために手にした強さだ
MsgEn:
That is the strength I have gained for that
purpose.

MsgJp: その力、今差し出せというのなら――
MsgEn: If you ask me to present that power now...
I will entrust it to you!
There is no dream that cannot be realized!

MsgJp: やはり、フィンダムに乗り込むしかありません
MsgEn: Indeed, there is no choice but to leave for Phindym.

MsgJp:
ゲートの向こう側へ渡り
原因を取り除かなくては――
MsgEn:
Cross over to the other side of the gate and
eliminate the cause—

MsgJp: しばらくの間、時間をください

一方通行のこの、"ゲート"――
わたしの力で、必ず開きます
MsgEn:
This one-way "gate"—
I will definitely open it with my power.

MsgJp:
再び一つとなった覚者たちは
諸悪の根源と目された黒騎士を退けることに成功した
MsgEn:
Once again, the Arisen have come together as one.
They have succeeded in repelling the Black
Knight, who was considered the root of all evil.

MsgJp: しかし、侵食魔が跋扈する状況は、まだ変わらない
MsgEn:
However, the situation where the Infected rampage
is still unchanged.

MsgJp: フィンダム大陸へ渡る準備が粛々と進む中――
MsgEn:
As preparations steadily progress for the journey
to the continent of Phindym...

MsgJp: 覚者たちはひとときの安息を夢見た――
MsgEn: The Arisen dream of a moment of respite...

MsgJp:
クラウスが言うには――
中は、もの凄い力でねじ曲げられた空間か――
MsgEn:
According to Klaus, the interior is a space that
has been bent with tremendous force.

MsgJp:
離れた大地と大地が結ばれるほど
圧縮された空間か――
MsgEn:
It's a space so compressed that distant lands and
ours are connected, right?

MsgJp:
どっちにしても、安全なんか
これっぽちも保証されていないんです
MsgEn:
Either way, there is no guarantee of safety
whatsoever.

MsgJp: これでお別れだったりして――

わたしは、一度通り抜けている
セシリーもな
MsgEn: I have already passed through once, as has Cecily.

MsgJp:
何かあっても、ちょっとばかり
記憶をなくす程度さ
MsgEn:
Even if something were to happen, I'd only lose a
bit of my memory.

MsgJp:
いつまでグダグダ言ってやがる
覚悟決めろ
MsgEn:
Until when are you going to keep blabbering on?
Make up your mind and prepare yourself.

MsgJp: 一体ここで何が起きているんだ？
MsgEn: What on earth is happening here?

MsgJp:
おい、見ろ！
この妖しく輝く礎を――
MsgEn:
Hey, look!
Behold this mysteriously shining Portcrystal...

MsgJp: 斥候からの情報によると――
敵は二手に分かれて待ち受けているそうだ
MsgEn: The enemy is waiting in two different locations.

MsgJp: こちらも隊を二つに分け、迎え撃つ！
MsgEn:
We will also divide the squad into two and
counter-attack!

MsgJp: それぞれの場所まで案内しよう
MsgEn:
I will guide you each to your respective
locations.

MsgJp: 私の側から向かう者はついてこい
MsgEn: Those who are going with me, follow.

MsgJp:
みなさん、ようこそ
ここがわたしの故郷――フィンダムです
MsgEn:
Everyone, welcome.
This is my home - Phindym.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの芯なる樹――この世界の中心だ
でも、病んで、死にかけている
MsgEn:
Phindym's Core Tree - The Center of this World.
However, it is sick and on the brink of death.

MsgJp:
ここはわたしの故郷なんだ
かつてはナバド村と呼ばれていた
MsgEn:
This is my hometown.
It used to be called the Village of Nabhadh.

MsgJp:
子供の頃に流行病があって――
でも、フィンダムには対処法がなくてね
MsgEn:
When I was a child, there was an epidemic...
But, there was no cure in Phindym.

MsgJp: そもそも、病は、報いや罰だと考えられていたんだ
MsgEn:
Originally, illness was thought of as retribution
or punishment.

MsgJp:
ただ死を待つだけの日々――
人がバタバタと死んでいった
MsgEn:
Just waiting for death every day, people died one
after another.

MsgJp: でも、フィンダムは変わりました

怯えて死を待つだけの時代に、父が終止符を
打ったのです
MsgEn:
In an era where people merely awaited death in
fear, my father put an end to it.

MsgJp:
今、父は"芯なる樹"を救うために奮闘しています
フィンダムの未来は明るい――そう信じています
MsgEn:
Now, my father is struggling to save the "Core
Tree".
I believe that the future of Phindym is bright -
what I truly believe.

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"が腐るってのは、竜が病気に
なるようなものか？
MsgEn:
Is it like the "Core Tree" is rotting, causing
the dragons to become sick?

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"と竜は不可分
だから、そう言っても、間違いではない
MsgEn:
The "Core Tree" and the Dragon are inseparable.
So, saying that is not wrong.

MsgJp:
腐敗の原因を作ったのは
どこからか現れた、あの黒騎士だ
MsgEn:
The one who caused the corruption was none other
than that Black Knight.

MsgJp:
黒騎士は倒したから、あとはどうやって
この世界を救うか――だね
MsgEn:
Now that we've defeated the Black Knight, the
only thing left is how to save this world, right?

MsgJp:
精霊竜ウィルミアと話さなくてはなりません
もちろん、父にも帰還を報告しないと――
MsgEn:
I must speak with the Spirit Dragon Willmia.
Of course, I must also report my return to my
father...

MsgJp:
おいおいなんだあれは！？
向かってくるぞ！
MsgEn:
Oh, what is that!?
They're coming towards us!

MsgJp: 竜――精霊竜ウィルミアです！
会いに来てくれるなんて！
MsgEn: To think you came to see me!

MsgJp:
セシリー！？
無事に戻ったというのは本当だったのだな
MsgEn: Cecily!? So it was true that you returned safely.

MsgJp: 一緒に来たってずーっと言ってるじゃねえかよ！
MsgEn: You keep saying that you came together with me!

MsgJp: この方は、レスタニアを護りし白竜の覚者です
MsgEn:
This person is the Arisen of the White Dragon,
who protects Lestania.

MsgJp: あれもレスタニアから来た覚者だと言っている
MsgEn:
They also claim to be an Arisen who came from
Lestania.

MsgJp:
遙か彼方にレスタニアなる大地があり、白き竜と
民が暮らしている
MsgEn:
Far beyond, there is the land of Lestania where
the white dragon and its people live.

MsgJp:
だが、竜と覚者は一対の契り
白き竜には幾人もの覚者がいるなどとは――
MsgEn:
However, there are many Arisen who have formed a
bond with the White Dragon...

MsgJp:
世界は、わたしたちの想像より、ずっと広くて
在り方も多様なのです
MsgEn:
The world is much larger and more diverse
than we can imagine.

MsgJp:
覚者になると同時に姿を消し――
戻って来たと思えば異国と、その覚者の話だ
MsgEn:
Upon becoming an Arisen, they disappeared at the
same time - it's as if they vanished.
Then, when they returned, it was a story of a
foreign land and a new Arisen.

MsgJp: 我らとておまえを信じたい
MsgEn: We want to believe in you.

MsgJp:
おまえたちの言葉が真実だと言うのならば
我らを納得させる、証を見せてほしい
MsgEn:
If you claim that your words are the truth, then
please show us the proof that will convince us.

MsgJp: 古来より伝わる方法で力とその正しさを示すのだ
MsgEn:
Demonstrate your power and its righteousness
through the methods passed down since ancient
times.

MsgJp: これはこれはみなさん――

冗談じゃない――
復讐を台無しにされてたまるか！
MsgEn:
This is no joke—
I won't stand for my revenge being ruined!

MsgJp:
腐った"芯なる樹"とともに
皆、朽ち果ててしまえ！
MsgEn:
With the rotten "Core Tree", everyone, wither
away!

MsgJp:
ロイグ――
あなたが"芯なる樹"を――

故郷が病魔に侵された時――
誰もが、これは理、運命だと、背を向けた
MsgEn:
When our hometown is invaded by the disease,
everyone turned their backs, believing it to be
the order of fate.

MsgJp: 竜も助けてはくれなかった
MsgEn: Even the dragons did not come to help.

MsgJp:
悲しいが、歯を食いしばるしかなかった
このフィンダムで育てば誰もがそうなる
MsgEn:
It's sad, but we had no choice but to grit our
teeth.
Everyone in Phindym goes through the same.

MsgJp:
しかし、苦しむ両親を見ているうちに
背を向けた人々が憎くなった
MsgEn:
However, as I watched my suffering parents, I
began to despise those who turned their backs.

MsgJp: 何もしない竜に失望した
MsgEn: I was disappointed in the dragon that did nothing.

MsgJp:
ほどなく父は気が触れて――
世を呪う言葉を残して死んだ
MsgEn:
Before long, my father lost his sanity—
Leaving behind words cursing the world, he died.

MsgJp: わたしはその言葉に囚われたのさ
MsgEn: I became trapped by those words.

MsgJp: 乞い、願っていると、手段が手に入った
MsgEn:
I begged and wished, and a means came into my
hands.

MsgJp:
ああ――
"芯なる樹"に毒素を植え付けてやった
MsgEn:
Ah...
I implanted toxins into the "Core Tree".

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"を救おうと、おまえたちは右往左往
死は理ではないのか？　運命ではなかったのか？
MsgEn:
In your efforts to save the "Core Tree," you are
all in a state of confusion.
Is death not part of the order? Was it not meant
to be our destiny?

MsgJp:
わかるぞ？
自分たちの命だけは惜しいんだろう？
MsgEn:
Do you understand?
Are you only concerned about your own lives?

MsgJp:
"理"など方便
身勝手な奴らめ
MsgEn:
"Justice" and such are all just excuses, you
self-centered lot!

MsgJp: ロイグ、レスタニアを思い出して？
フィンダムも、あんなふうになれるかもしれない
MsgEn: Phindym, too, could perhaps become like that.

MsgJp: わたしが全力で阻止するからな！
MsgEn: I will do everything I can to stop you!

MsgJp: ウォーウ、ウォウ、ウォウォウォーウ

魔物と化してもなおわたしを慕う
かわいいケモノたちよ――
MsgEn:
Cute little creatures who still adore me even
when I've become a monster...

MsgJp:
――なぜだ！　どういうことだ！？
黒騎士よ！　どこにいる！
MsgEn:
Why! What is happening!?
Black Knight! Where are you?

MsgJp: 今さらわたしを見捨てるのか！
MsgEn: Are you abandoning me now, of all times!

MsgJp:
ロイグが？
黒い霧に――！！
まだ希望は消えていない――
これで――フィンダムは救われます！
MsgEn: With this, Phindym will be saved!
It seems the time has come.

MsgJp:
長く閉ざされていた"精霊の地"
芯なる樹の樹内へ通じる聖門を――
MsgEn:
"The Spirit Land" that has long been sealed is a
sacred gate that leads into the inner part of the
"Core Tree"...

MsgJp: その、選ばれし者が解き開く時が来たのだ
MsgEn: The time has come for the chosen one to unlock it.

MsgJp:
選ばれし者、即ち、覚者！
覚者、即ち、セシリー！
MsgEn:
Chosen one, that is, Arisen!
Arisen, that is, Cecily!

MsgJp: 大地、竜、人の未来はおまえに託された
MsgEn:
The future of the land, dragons, and humanity is
entrusted to you.

MsgJp:
わたしに――
できるでしょうか
おまえには、心強い友がいるではないか
MsgEn: You have a strong friend by your side, don't you?

MsgJp:
精霊竜にも、わたしにもなかったものを
おまえは手に入れたのだ
MsgEn:
You have obtained something that neither the
Spirit Dragon, nor I, have ever had.

MsgJp:
このフィンダムを救うため
力を貸してください
MsgEn: Please lend us your strength to save Phindym.

MsgJp:
わたしと共に――
この大地に、最後の希望を灯すために――
MsgEn:
With me—
To kindle the final hope in this land—

MsgJp: どうか、よろしくお願いします

フィンダムは毒に侵され――
病に倒れかけた大地だった
MsgEn:
Phindym was poisoned, the land on the verge of
falling ill.

MsgJp:
レスタニアから渡った覚者たちは
フィンダムの覚者を助け、戦い――
MsgEn:
Arisen who ventured from Lestania came to fight
alongside Arisen of Phindym.

MsgJp: ついに、大地を癒やす手段を手に入れた
MsgEn: Finally, they obtained a means to heal the land.

MsgJp: そしてフィンダムの未来を託されし覚者――
MsgEn:
And thus, the Arisen entrusted with the future of
Phindym—

MsgJp:
セシリーは《原始の雫》について学び
やがて来る、治療の時を待った
MsgEn:
Cecily learned about the "Primeval Drops" and
waited for the moment of healing to come.

MsgJp:
我々が"精霊の地"と呼んでいるこの先の
土地について説明しておこう
MsgEn:
Let me describe the land beyond, that we call
"The Spirit Land".

MsgJp:
"精霊の地"とは芯なる樹へと続く、樹層一帯
自由に出入りできるのは竜だけだ
MsgEn:
The "Spirit Land" is the area around the
surrounding the Core Tree, which extends to the
canopy.
Only dragons can enter and leave freely.

MsgJp:
我々が出入りするあの門も
普段は、固く閉じてある
MsgEn:
That gate where we enter and exit is usually
tightly sealed.

MsgJp:
芯なる樹は、いまやフィンダム全域に
毒素を送り出す病巣――
MsgEn:
The Core Tree has become an infected hive that
sends toxins throughout Phindym.

MsgJp:
治療のためには樹の中心まで
行かねばならない
MsgEn:
In order to cure it, we must go to the center of
the Tree.

MsgJp:
毒によって侵された根は
この《原始の雫》で浄化できるだろう
MsgEn:
The roots that have been infested with poison can
be purified with these "Primeval Drops."

MsgJp:
おそらく樹内は
魔物の巣窟となっているはず――
MsgEn: Perhaps the tree is a nest of monsters.

MsgJp:
隊長、あなたは先行して魔物を排除し
樹の中心を目指して欲しい
MsgEn:
Captain, I want you to go ahead and eliminate the
enemies and head for the center of the Tree.

MsgJp: 道中の安全を確保する大切な役割ですね
MsgEn:
Ensuring safety along the way is an important
role.

MsgJp: 掃除かあ、嫌いなんだけどなあ

わたしも、後を追い
樹内での手助けをいたそう
MsgEn: I'll follow after and assist you inside the tree.

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》 が手に入ることは二度とない
頼り続けで心苦しいが、よろしく頼む
MsgEn:
We may never get another chance to obtain the
"Primeval Drops."
I'm sorry I keep asking you for help, but I'm
counting on you.

MsgJp:
竜はもう、かつての竜ではない
残念ながら――
MsgEn:
The Dragon isn't what it used to be...
Unfortunately--

MsgJp: 我々は間に合わなかったのだ
MsgEn: We didn't make it in time.
Oh, Arisen, Arisen of the White Dragon.

MsgJp: 頼もしくなりましたね
MsgEn: You have become reliable, haven't you?

MsgJp: 精霊竜の継承、大変にごくろうさまでした
MsgEn:
Thank you very much for your hard work in
inheriting the Spirit Dragon.

MsgJp:
精霊竜が、竜としての理を取り戻したことで
レスタニアの危機は回避されました
MsgEn:
The Spirit Dragon, regaining its draconic
essence, averted the crisis in Lestania.

MsgJp:
しかし、白竜がまだ回復の途上にあることを
思うと――油断は禁物です
MsgEn:
However, I think that the White Dragon is still
in the process of recovering - you can never let
your guard down!

MsgJp:
世界は五大竜と呼ばれる竜たちによって
守られています
MsgEn:
The world is protected by the dragons known as
the Five Great Dragons.

MsgJp: 白竜、精霊竜、そして黒竜――
MsgEn:
The White Dragon, the Spirit Dragon, and the
Black Dragon...

MsgJp:
黒き竜の、闇で蠢く思惑の断片に
あなたも、触れたはずです
MsgEn:
You, too, must have been touched by the fragments
of the black dragon's thoughts stirring in the
darkness.

MsgJp:
残りの二竜も
ほどなく、あなたは知ることになるでしょう
MsgEn:
The remaining two dragons will also soon become
known to you.

MsgJp: レスタニアの、本当の危機はこれからです
MsgEn: The true crisis of Lestania is yet to come.

MsgJp:
強くなりなさい
そう、レオのように――
交わることを禁じられた大陸が――
MsgEn: The continents that were forbidden to intersect...

MsgJp: ――異なる竜の大陸がレスタニアで交差した
MsgEn:
...the continents of different dragons
intersected in Lestania.

MsgJp: 竜たちですら気づいていなかったが――
MsgEn: Even the dragons didn't realize it, but--

MsgJp:
世界は、その瞬間、理という鋳型から
取り出されたのだ
MsgEn:
The world was taken out of the path of Order at
that moment.

MsgJp:
はて――それはいったい誰の仕業だろうか
何を望んだ結果なのだろうか
MsgEn:
Huh... who could have done such a thing?
And what did they want to achieve?

MsgJp:
時にレスタニア歴、３２４年
竜の理を解く、物語は動きだした
MsgEn:
In the year 324 of the Lestania Era, the tale of
unraveling the dragon's order began to unfold.

MsgJp: 見て、あそこ！　空に黒い渦ができてる！
MsgEn:
Look, over there! A black vortex is forming in
the sky!

MsgJp:
何かが――ああ、大地の竜力が
吸い上げられているようです！
MsgEn:
Something... oh, the very Dragon Force of the
land seems to be being drained!

MsgJp: 急いでガラダの元へ向かうぞ！
MsgEn: Hurry, let's head to Gearóid's location!

MsgJp:
やはり以前より状況は悪化しているようだ
魔物がより凶暴になっている
MsgEn:
The situation is getting worse than before.
The monsters seem even more ferocious.

MsgJp: この森のどこかに、礎があるはずなんだ
MsgEn:
There should be a portcrystal somewhere in this
forest.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの礎と同じ力を持つものだ
手分けして探そう
MsgEn:
They possess the same power as that of the
Portcrystal of Lestania.
Let's split up and search.
Oh, is that not a Portcrystal?

MsgJp: これこれ、いつもの、この感じ！
MsgEn: This is it, the usual, this feeling!

MsgJp: リムを使って行き来できるってことだよね？
MsgEn:
Using Rift Crystals allows us to travel back and
forth, right?

MsgJp: 隊長、あそこに入り口が！
MsgEn: Captain, there's an entrance over there!

MsgJp:
セシリー！？
ああ、無事で良かった！
MsgEn:
Cecily!?
Ah, I'm glad you're safe!

MsgJp: 心配かけてごめんなさい

――お父さんはどこですか？
ロイグは戻ってる？
MsgEn:
Where is your father?
Is Loeg back?

MsgJp: ロイグの行方はわからないが――
MsgEn: We don't know Loeg's whereabouts, but――

MsgJp:
ガラダは"芯なる樹"の治療薬、《原始の雫》を求め
三人の戦士とともに、魔の峡谷へと旅立った
MsgEn:
Gearóid and three soldiers set out for the demons
canyon in search of the "Primeval Drop", the cure
for the "Core Tree".

MsgJp: わたしも行かなくちゃ！
気持ちはわかるぞ、セシリー
MsgEn: I understand how you feel, Cecily.

MsgJp:
だが、ガラダに同行したのは屈強の戦士たち
もう少し、信頼してやれ
MsgEn:
But the soldiers who accompanied Gearóid are
strong and reliable.
Trust them a bit more.

MsgJp: 見たところ、お連れさんも疲れているようだ
MsgEn:
From what I can see, it seems like your companion
is also tired, Ser.

MsgJp:
故郷を素通りさせてしまってはガラダに
会わせる顔がない
MsgEn:
I can't face letting Gearóid
see me if I let her pass by my hometown unnoticed.

MsgJp:
わたし――
ここからの眺めが、大好きなんです
MsgEn:
This view from here...
I just love it.

MsgJp:
夜明け前、朝、雨の日、夕方、月明かりの夜――
色々な姿を見せてくれます
MsgEn:
Before dawn, in the morning, on a rainy day, in
the evening, on a moonlit night...
The view changes to show many forms.

MsgJp:
覚者に選ばれた時
誇らしくもあったけど、本当は不安でした
MsgEn:
When I was chosen to be Arisen, I felt proud, but
really anxious.

MsgJp:
託された期待や希望に応えられるのかな？
もう――押し潰されそうでした
MsgEn:
Would I be able to live up to the expectations
and hopes entrusted to me?
I was already--I was about to be crushed.

MsgJp: でも、レスタニアであなたたちと過ごすうちに――
MsgEn:
But, while spending time with all of you in
Lestania...

MsgJp:
覚者の生き方が
ひとつじゃないことを知りました
MsgEn:
I realized that being Arisen doesn't mean having
just one way of life.

MsgJp:
みんなが、それぞれの大切なものを守るため
がんばって、歩いている
MsgEn:
Everyone is doing their best to protect what is
important to each of us.

MsgJp: わたしも、それでいいんだって
MsgEn: I realized, that's enough for me.

MsgJp: 大地が侵食されたせいなのか――
MsgEn: Is it because the land has been corrupted...

MsgJp: このあたりも、殺気立った魔物が多いですね
MsgEn:
There are a lot of hostile creatures around here,
aren't there?

MsgJp: ああ、さっきのも、そんな感じだった
MsgEn: Ah, it felt like that earlier too.

MsgJp: あれがダナ村に突っ込んだら――
MsgEn: If that thing charges into Dana Village—
It will be a huge disaster!!

MsgJp:
おい、隊長とダナ村に連絡だ！
それとセシリーの親父さんにもな
MsgEn:
Hey, contact the captain and Dana Village!
Also, let Cecily's father know!

MsgJp: 暴走が始まりやがった
MsgEn: It's starting to go out of control.

MsgJp:
リズ、エリオット！
雑魚は俺たちで相手するぞ
MsgEn:
Lise, Elliot!
We'll take care of the weaker enemies.

MsgJp: 隊長、アイツを頼んだぜ！
MsgEn: Captain, take care of that one!

MsgJp: し、死んでますよ、大勢死んでます
世の末って、戦場のこと！？
MsgEn: The end of the world is a battlefield!?

MsgJp: どこの戦場だよ！　全部終わっただろうが
MsgEn:
But which battlefield?
Everything is already over, isn't it?
Have we gone back to the Orc War!?

MsgJp:
落ち着こう
わたしたち、オークならお手のもの
MsgEn: Keep calm. We can handle Orcs.

MsgJp: あっちからも！　数が増えてます！
MsgEn: We're flanked!　Their numbers are growing!

MsgJp: おい隊長、指示はねえのか！
MsgEn: Oi Captain, give the order already!
Is that important right now? Do you want to die?

MsgJp: ふんっ（リアクションボイス）
よし！（リアクションボイス）
ふぅ――（リアクションボイス）

MsgEn: If you're discovered here, there will be no next time!

MsgJp:
おい、そろそろ教えろ
ここはどこだ？　どこへ行く？
MsgEn:
Hey, it's about time you told us.
Where are we?　Where are we going?

MsgJp: 質問されるのって、うれしいものだね
MsgEn: How nice to be asked a question.

MsgJp: 最近は、誰も――何も訊いてくれない
MsgEn: Recently, no one... Nobody asks anymore.

MsgJp:
答えを知っても、この世の中が
変わるわけじゃないから――
MsgEn: Getting an answer won't change a thing about this world, so...

MsgJp: 顔を上げて、前を見つめる力を――
MsgEn: Any strength left to lift one's head and face forward...

MsgJp: あの山で燃える炎が焼き尽くしてしまったんだ
MsgEn: The flames upon that mountain have burned it all.

MsgJp: これで信じてもらえた？
全員が覚者だってことだけは信じてもいい
MsgEn: It's fine to believe that everyone is an Arisen.

MsgJp:
じゃあ、次はこっちの番
この世界のこと、教えてくれる？
MsgEn:
Okay, now it's our turn.
Can you tell me about this world?

MsgJp:
ここはアッカーシェラン大陸
火竜様とアッカー王家が統べる地――
MsgEn:
This is the continent of Acre Selund, where the
Fire Dragon and the Acre Royal Family reign...

MsgJp: なぜオークと戦っている？　戦争か？
MsgEn: Why fight against the Orcs? Is it a war?

MsgJp:
戦争――
いや、もっと一方的だ、狩りに近い
MsgEn:
A war...? Nay.
It's more one-sided. We're hunted.

MsgJp: ある日突然黒き竜が現れ、火竜様に襲いかかった
MsgEn:
One day, a black dragon suddenly appeared
and attacked the Fire Dragon.

MsgJp:
覚者だったクレス女王は火竜様となって
まだ間もなく――
MsgEn:
Queen Cress, who was an Arisen, took on the
form of the Fire Dragon and, not long after...

MsgJp: あっというまに決着がつき、火竜様は敗れ――
MsgEn:
In no time, the battle was settled, and the Fire
Dragon was defeated.

MsgJp: 代わりに悪しき竜が生まれた
MsgEn: In its place, the Evil Dragon was born.

MsgJp: 大地は焼かれ、城も落ち――
MsgEn: The land is scorched, the castle has fallen...

MsgJp:
鋼で武装したオーク達により
王国は蹂躙された
MsgEn: The kingdom was ravaged by Orcs, armed with steel.

MsgJp:
人々は、生きのびても
もう希望はないと思っている――
MsgEn:
Even if some of the people survive,
they feel that there's no hope left.

MsgJp: この大地を覆っているのは、絶望
MsgEn: Despair is what covers this land.
That must be difficult to live with.

MsgJp:
隊長、一度レスタニアに戻って相談しませんか？
俺たちにできることが何かあるかもしれません
MsgEn:
Captain, why don't we go back
to Lestania to discuss this?
Maybe there is something we can do.
You won't be able to do that.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜は、レスタニアにも現れ
あなたたちをここへ連れてきた――
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon appeared in Lestania
and indeed brought you all here...

MsgJp:
もしかして疑ってる？
わたしたちが悪しき竜に送り込まれたとか？
MsgEn:
Could it be you suspect that we're agents
sent by the Evil Dragon?

MsgJp:
そうだな――
人質を残せば、帰還を認めよう
MsgEn:
Indeed. If you can choose to leave
a hostage behind, I'll allow your group to return.

MsgJp:
隊長、行ってください
神殿の様子も気になりますよね？
MsgEn:
Captain, please go on ahead.
You're worried about the situation at the Temple, right?

MsgJp: 俺なら大丈夫ですから

覚者が大勢いるということは
ひとりひとりの価値は下がるよね
MsgEn:
The fact that there are so many Arisen means that
each one is worth less.

MsgJp: そんなことはないけど――何が言いたいの？
MsgEn: I don't think so, but - what's your point?

MsgJp: あの隊長って人、あなたを見捨てるかも？
MsgEn: That captain, he might abandon you, you know?

MsgJp: 俺は隊長を知ってるからね

他人への期待や信頼は自分を傷つけるよ
深く、深くね
MsgEn:
Your expectations and trust in others will hurt
you deeply.

MsgJp:
オークどもに捕まった仲間の居場所を突き止めた！
どうする！？
MsgEn:
We have located our friends who were captured by
the orcs!
What are we going to do?!

MsgJp:
どうするって、決まってるでしょ
部隊の人選は任せて
MsgEn:
What are you going to do? It's obvious.
I'll pick out the guys for the unit.

MsgJp: ま、その代わり、そいつは返してもらうぜ
MsgEn:
Well, in exchange, I'm going to ask you to give
it back.

MsgJp: あれ？　意外とあっさり

ここには非戦闘員もいるから
あなたたちを残しておきたくないだけ
MsgEn:
There are non-combatants here, so I just don't
want to leave you all behind.

MsgJp:
隊長、今のが最後の敵兵です！
俺たち、やりましたね！
MsgEn:
Captain, the one we just faced is the last enemy
soldier!
We did it!

MsgJp: おかげで仲間は無事だ
MsgEn: Thanks to that, my comrades are safe.

MsgJp: みんな、疲れてるのかな
解放されたからと言って未来があるわけじゃないもの
MsgEn:
Just because we're liberated, it doesn't mean
there's a future.

MsgJp:
敵の増援が来るかもしれないから
あなたたち、よく見ていてね
MsgEn:
Enemy reinforcements may be on the way.
You guys keep a close watch.

MsgJp: ケガをしている人は、治療を受けて
MsgEn: Anyone who's injured, get treated immediately.

MsgJp: すぐに移動するからね、それまで休んでおいて
MsgEn: We'll be moving soon, so rest until then.
He's not here... or... is he?
What I'm looking for is hope...

MsgJp: 敵軍、来る！　戦車も来るぞ！
MsgEn:
Enemy troops, they're coming! Tanks are coming
too!

MsgJp:
ダメだ、みんな疲れ切っている
急いで引き上げよう
MsgEn:
It's not good, we're all exhausted.
Let's hurry up and pull out.

MsgJp: ガハ！　もう、ヒトはおらぬか
MsgEn: Gahaha! Are there no more humans here?

MsgJp: オークの声だ――気をつけて
MsgEn: It's the voice of the orcs... be careful.

MsgJp: 火竜が死んでから、ヒトはフヌケ
MsgEn:
Ever since the Fire Dragon died, people became
complacent.

MsgJp: グワッ！（リアクションボイス）

偽りの竜の手先となったオークども！
荒野の覇者の誇りはどうした
MsgEn:
Orcs are pawns of a false dragon!
Where is the pride of the champion of the
wilderness?

MsgJp: 焚き火にくべて燃やしてしまったか！
MsgEn: Did you burn it in the bonfire!?

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍だ、加勢する
MsgEn: I am General Meirova, I will assist you.
Phew, everything is taken care of.

MsgJp: そちらの屈強な戦士たちは――
はじめましてメイロワ将軍、俺たちは――
MsgEn: Nice to meet you, General Meirova. We are--

MsgJp:
おぬしたちが、なぜ悪しき竜により
この地へ招かれたのか
MsgEn:
Why were you invited to this land by the evil
dragon?

MsgJp: その真意を探りたいというわけか
MsgEn: So you want to know the truth behind it, huh?

MsgJp: あんたは事の目撃者だって聞いている
MsgEn: I'm told you're a witness to this.

MsgJp:
――親愛なる女王陛下が竜力を継承し
火竜様となってほどなく、あの黒い竜が現れた
MsgEn:
—Shortly after our beloved Queen inherited the
dragon's power and became the Fire Dragon, that
black dragon appeared.

MsgJp:
竜となって間もない火竜様は
反撃も空しく、倒れてしまった
MsgEn:
The Fire Dragon, who had only recently become a
dragon, was powerless to counterattack and fell.

MsgJp:
あたりは暗い闇に包まれ
やがてその闇が消え去ると――
MsgEn:
The area was shrouded in dark shadows,
and then, when the darkness faded away—

MsgJp: そこにはあの悪しき竜がいた

火竜様はおろか黒い竜の姿さえ
どこにもない
MsgEn:
There is no sign of the Fire Dragon, let alone a
black dragon.

MsgJp:
わしは、悪しき竜は火竜様の血肉によって
作られたと信じている
MsgEn:
I believe that the Evil Dragon was created
through the flesh and blood of the Fire Dragon.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜がこの人たちを連れてきた理由は？
心当たりはないの？
MsgEn:
Why did the Evil Dragon bring these people here?
Do you have any idea?

MsgJp:
竜の心などわしにはわからん
それより、王子の行方は？
MsgEn:
I don't understand the heart of a dragon.
But more importantly, where is the prince?

MsgJp: 火竜様であったクレス女王の御一子ネド王子
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo, the only son of Queen Cress, who was
once the Fire Dragon.
He was 12 years old at the time.

MsgJp: 混乱する城下ではぐれてそれっきりだが――
MsgEn:
They got separated in the chaotic castle town and
that was the end of it...

MsgJp: ネド様はわしらの希望だ

おお、来たか
ここが城壁の村ロスギルだ
MsgEn:
Oh, you have come.
This is the village of Rothgill, surrounded by
castle walls.

MsgJp:
世話人にして領主のイェルハルドは
長く王家とともに歩んだ地方豪族
MsgEn:
Lord Gerhard, who has been a steward to the local
nobleman, has been a faithful companion to the
royal family for a long time.

MsgJp:
悪い人間ではないが、猜疑心強く
加えて偏屈な頑固者
MsgEn: Not a bad person, but a suspicious and stubborn.

MsgJp:
何かと面倒な男だからうまく扱わないと
話が進まんから――
MsgEn:
He's a pain in the ass, and if you don't handle
him well,
you're not going to get the story...

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍、遠路はるばる良くいらっしゃいました
MsgEn:
General Meirova, thank you for coming all the way
here.

MsgJp:
おお、イェルハルド！
さあ、中へ入れてくれ！　開門だ！
MsgEn:
Oh, Gerhard!
Now, let me inside! Open the gate!

MsgJp:
旧知のあなたのために門を開くのは
やぶさかでありませんが、はて、その用向きは？
MsgEn:
I would be happy to open the gate for you, my old
friend, but what is the purpose?

MsgJp:
ひとつはネド王子の行方――
盗賊と行動を共にしているとの情報を得た
MsgEn:
One matter is the whereabouts of Prince Nedo...
We have information that he joined the bandits.

MsgJp:
もうひとつはジリアン――
昨日から盗賊の地を目指し、単独行動をとっておる
MsgEn:
The other is Gillian...
She has been on her own since yesterday, heading
for the land of the bandits.

MsgJp:
盗賊が隠れ住む西方のことは
おまえさんたちの方が詳しかろう
MsgEn:
You guys know more about the west where the
bandits hide than I do.

MsgJp:
となればイェルハルド
ここはおまえさんに頭を下げて力を借りるのが得策
MsgEn:
Then Gerhard, we would be wise to bow down to you
and ask for your help.

MsgJp: 得策――たとえ思っても口にしないものですよ
MsgEn:
Prudent... even if you think it, it's something
you don't say aloud.

MsgJp:
しかしまあ、事情はわかりました
そういうことであればさっそく開門――
MsgEn:
Well, I understand the situation.
In that case, I'll get on opening the gates right
away...

MsgJp:
と、したいところですが、実はここよりそう遠くない
場所に、魔物の巣窟ができてしまいましてな
MsgEn:
Well, I would like to do that but the truth is,
not far from here, a den of monsters has appeared.

MsgJp:
開門すれば魔物どもまで入り込んでくるのではと
戦々恐々としているのです
MsgEn:
I'm afraid that if we open the gate, the monsters
will push their way inside.

MsgJp: 回りくどい――回りくどいぞイェルハルド！
魔物を倒せというのだな！
MsgEn: Just defeat the monsters, is that it!?

MsgJp:
そうは申しませんが、倒して頂ければ
中にお招きして、熱いお茶でもお出ししましょう
MsgEn:
I wouldn't say that, but if you defeat them, I
will invite you in and offer you a hot cup of tea.

MsgJp: ネド王子！　よくぞご無事で
MsgEn: Prince Nedo! I'm glad you're safe

MsgJp: イェルハルド殿、ひさしいですね
MsgEn: Lord Gerhard, it's been a while.

MsgJp: 辺境暮らしとはいえ、長き無沙汰をお許し下さい
MsgEn:
Although I live in the frontier, please forgive
me for my long absence.

MsgJp:
気にしないでください
あなたの忠信、城にも届いていました
MsgEn:
Please don't worry.
Your loyalty has reached the castle as well.

MsgJp:
積もる話もあるだろうが
どうだイェルハルド、こうして王子も戻られた
MsgEn:
There must be a lot to catch up on, but how about
it, Gerhard? The prince has returned.

MsgJp: 一緒に戦ってくれるな？
申し上げにくいのですが――
MsgEn: I'm sorry to say this, but--

MsgJp: 王子は、すでに覚者でいらっしゃいますか？
MsgEn: Has the prince already become an Arisen?

MsgJp:
王子は立派な覚者だ
正統なる王家の跡取りにして、竜の器！
MsgEn:
The prince is a fine Arisen.
Rightful heir to the royal family and vessel of
the dragon!

MsgJp: では、王家の秘蹟を見せて頂きたい
MsgEn:
Then, I would like to see The Royal Family
Sacrament.

MsgJp:
王子をお慕いする心情があるからこそ
民にも証を示す必要があるのです――
MsgEn:
It is precisely because of our deep affection for
the prince that we must show proof to the people—

MsgJp:
我らにない力を持つからこそ
民は王子を慕い命さえも捧げます
MsgEn:
It is precisely because he possesses powers that
we do not, that the people revere the prince and
would even lay down their lives for him.

MsgJp:
わかりました
何をしましょうか？
癒しの泉を復活させて頂きたい
MsgEn: I wish to restore the Spring of Healing.

MsgJp: ああ、それも僕が考えるわけか
MsgEn: Ah, so I am the one who will come up with a plan.

MsgJp:
いいか、ロスギルの湖畔を南へと下り
険しき岩肌を抜けたその先に――
MsgEn:
Listen, just south down the shores of Lake
Rothgill through a steep rock face, at the end of
which...

MsgJp:
この地を終焉に導いた忌々しき戦車が
繋がれている
MsgEn:
This cursed tank is chained up, the one that
drove this land to its doom.

MsgJp: 魔軍戦車カトブレパス――
MsgEn: The demonic war machine called Catoblepas...

MsgJp:
ヤツは死肉をたらふく食らうまでは動かねえが
ひとたび動き出せば、大地は絶望と惨劇に包まれる
MsgEn:
He will not move until he has had his fill of
dead flesh.
Once he moves, the land will be enveloped in
despair and misery.

MsgJp: まさに魔軍の持つ最強の兵器だ
MsgEn:
Truly, it is the strongest weapon possessed by
the demon army.

MsgJp: 初めに言っておくがひとりで挑むにはあまりに無謀
MsgEn:
Let me say this from the start: it is far too
reckless to challenge this alone.

MsgJp:
それでもと言うなら、僅かながら
解放軍も協力させてもらおう
MsgEn:
If you still insist, let's try to get some help
from the Liberation Army.

MsgJp: この場所なら奇襲にうってつけですね
MsgEn: This location is perfect for a surprise attack.

MsgJp:
戻って、戦力になりそうなのを連れて来い
少数精鋭たって、この人数じゃあな
MsgEn:
Go back and bring me some guys who might be able
to help.
Even if we're the elite few, we're still a small
group.

MsgJp: 了解！　って、ちょっと待った！
ほら見て！　もう来てる！

仕方ねえ――
隊長、やるんだろ？
MsgEn:
Well, there's no going back now, is there,
Captain?

MsgJp: おまえなど取るに足りん――
MsgEn: You're not even worth my time.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜よ
その言葉――そっくりお返ししましょう
MsgEn:
Evil Dragon...
I shall return those words to you in full.

MsgJp: それがおまえの最後の言葉かぁ！
ウクククク――（漏れる笑い）

MsgEn: But the outcome will not change――

MsgJp:
この絶望の大陸を――
せいぜい楽しむがいい！
MsgEn:
Enjoy this Land of Despair to your heart's
content!

MsgJp: 砦には攻め込まないの？
MsgEn: You're not going to attack the fort?

MsgJp: あわよくばやるって言ってたよね
MsgEn: You said you'd do it if the chance arose, right?

MsgJp:
あれは意気込み
現実じゃ、落としても維持できないもの
MsgEn:
That is mere fervor. In reality, it's something
you can't maintain even if you manage to seize it.

MsgJp:
途中で断念したと思わせて
再度攻撃をしかけた方が陽動は効果的
MsgEn:
It is more effective to make them think you have
given up halfway and then attack again as a
diversion.

MsgJp:
ここはもういいから
あなたたちは奇襲部隊に参加して
MsgEn:
We're good here.
You guys can join the ambush unit.

MsgJp:
ジリアンは残るの？
次はもっといっぱいオークが来るんじゃない？
MsgEn:
Will Gillian stay?
Won't more Orcs come next time?

MsgJp: それが目的だから、望むところだよ
MsgEn: That's exactly my objective; it's what I desire.

MsgJp:
やっと着いたよ――
ほら、あれが――
MsgEn:
Finally, we're here.
Hey, look, over there...

MsgJp: わあーー（リアクションボイス）
わーー（リアクションボイス）
ほおーー（リアクションボイス）
で？　メガドは今、どんな状態なんだ？
MsgEn: So, what's the current situation in Megado?

MsgJp:
敵の本拠地になっている――
それ以上は分からない
MsgEn:
It has become the enemy's stronghold ――
I don't know anything more than that.

MsgJp:
わたしの父もメガドの防衛部隊だった――
真っ先に逃げたみたいだけれどね
MsgEn:
My father was also a member of Megado's defense
force ――
It seems he was one of the first to flee.

MsgJp:
そうなんだ――
お父さんには会えてないの？
MsgEn:
I see--
You haven't seen your father?

MsgJp:
父は逃げた――
それ以上の興味なんてない――
MsgEn:
My father ran away--
I'm not interested in anything more than that--
Prince Nedo! I'm glad you're safe.

MsgJp: 彼らはメガドの守護兵です
MsgEn: They are the guardians of Megado.

MsgJp: どうか顔をあげてください

僕を逃がすために戦ってくれた
あなたたちの勇姿はけっして忘れません
MsgEn:
I will never forget the bravery of those who
fought to set me free!

MsgJp:
なんとありがたいお言葉
亡き同僚たちにも聞かせてやりたかった――
MsgEn:
What kind words!
I wish my fallen comrades could hear them.

MsgJp:
メガド陥落後――なんとか神殿だけはと
粉骨砕身して参りましたが
MsgEn:
After the fall of Megado...
I somehow made it to the temple.

MsgJp:
オークと異なる、恐ろしき者が現れ
一同は総崩れに――
MsgEn:
A ferocious one appeared, different from the
orcs,
and we all scattered in fear...

MsgJp: 真っ黒な鎧に身を包んだ恐ろしい騎士です
MsgEn: A fearsome knight dressed in pitch-black armor.

MsgJp: あん！？　真っ黒な鎧だあ？

黒い鎧は珍しくもないでしょうけど
ひとりで戦況を変えるほどの騎士は――
MsgEn:
Black armor is not uncommon, but a knight capable
of changing the course of a battle by himself
is...

MsgJp:
あの、フィンダムを乱した黒騎士ってこと？
闇に送り返したのに？
MsgEn:
Is that the Black Knight who disrupted Phindym?
Wasn't he sent back into the darkness?

MsgJp:
本格的に俺たちの出番になりそうだな――
なあ隊長
MsgEn:
Looks like we're in for a real treat...
Hey captain!

MsgJp: 時に、そこにいるのはジリアンか？
MsgEn: At times, is Gillian present there?

MsgJp:
父上は我々をここへ寄越すために戦い、散った
誠に立派な最期であった
MsgEn:
Father fought and died to bring us here, and it
was a truly honorable end.

MsgJp: 辛い報せだが――伝えておこう――
MsgEn:
I know this is hard news, but I'm here to tell
you...

MsgJp: ほう、ウワサは本当だったか
MsgEn: Oh, so the rumors were true.

MsgJp:
キサマがここへ来たといこうコトは
王子はこの先だというアカシ！
MsgEn:
Your coming here is proof that the prince is
ahead!

MsgJp:
王子の前に、まずはキサマから
なぶり殺してくれるわ！
MsgEn:
Before the prince, I'll make sure to beat you to
a pulp first!

MsgJp: 見ろ！　墓所の入り口が秘蹟で開かれている！
MsgEn:
Look! The entrance to the graveyard is opened by
mysterious power!

MsgJp:
王子がひとりで竜と会って
笛を吹いて力を継承したとする
MsgEn:
Imagine the prince meeting the dragon alone and
played the flute to inherit its power.

MsgJp:
すると、どうなる？
悪しき竜の姿をした魔物は残るんだよね？
MsgEn:
Then what happens?
The enemy in the form of the Evil Dragon will
remain, right?

MsgJp: 魔物は王子を襲うだろうな
MsgEn: The enemy will surely attack the prince.

MsgJp:
竜の力を継承したばかりで
王子は勝てるのか？
MsgEn:
After the Prince inherited the Dragon Force,
won't he be able to win?

MsgJp:
王子はすぐに竜になって
敵を倒せると思い込んでいるやも知れぬ――
MsgEn:
The prince might think that as soon as he obtains
the Dragon Force, he will be able to defeat the
enemies.

MsgJp:
故に皆を巻きこまず
ひとりで戦おうと覚悟してしまったのか――
MsgEn:
He may have decided to face the enemy alone and
fight without involving others.

MsgJp:
んなこたあ、王子の首根っこをひっつかんで
聞き出せばいいだろが！　ほら、行くぞ！
MsgEn:
We just need to grab the prince by the scruff of
the neck and interrogate him! Come on, let's go!

MsgJp:
ケッ、なんてことだ
――おまえが救世主に見えるぜ
MsgEn:
H-hey, what the hell...
You do look like a Savior, though.

MsgJp: この先にいるんですよ手強いのが――
MsgEn: There's a formidable one up ahead...

MsgJp:
実はね、わたしたちじゃあ
手も足も出なくて隊長を待っていたの
MsgEn:
Actually, to tell you the truth, we were all
waiting for the Captain, and we couldn't do much
ourselves.

MsgJp:
不甲斐ない我が身を嘆いていても仕方がない
この一戦、あなたに託すよ
MsgEn:
There's no point in lamenting my unworthiness.
I'll leave this one to you.

MsgJp: うわっ！！（リアクションボイス）
んっ――うっ――（リアクションボイス）

俺はいいから
早くネド王子のところ――
MsgEn:
It's fine with me.
Let's go to meet Prince Nedo right away.

MsgJp:
俺はね、こういう時が来たら潔く諦めようと
常々思っていたんだ
MsgEn:
I, uh... I always thought that when a time like
this comes, I should surrender gracefully.

MsgJp: そういうの、似合わないよ
隊長、エリオットは私たちが運ぶから
ああ、隊長は俺たちの後ろを頼むぜ
MsgEn: Yeah, the captain's got our backs.

MsgJp: 今日、私たちはついに、この地まで敵を追い込んだ
MsgEn:
Today, we have finally cornered the enemy to this
land.

MsgJp: 絶望の雲を打ち払って希望の光を取り戻そう
MsgEn:
Let's strike away the clouds of despair and
reclaim the light of hope.

MsgJp:
アッカー家の方々は優れた王そして覚者であり
素晴らしい竜となられました
MsgEn:
The members of the Acre's Royal Family have been
excellent kings and Arisen and thus have become
great dragons!

MsgJp:
しかし、全ての方がそうであったわけではないのです
中には力に呑まれ、異形と堕ちた存在も――
MsgEn:
But not everyone was the same.
Among those, there were also some who were
devoured by the power and morphed into strange
beings, who then fell to depravity.

MsgJp:
忌むべき異形は常に正しき竜によって
封じられ、その存在を知るのはごく限られた者のみ
MsgEn:
Those repulsive abominations were sealed by the
righteous Dragon, and only a small number of
people are aware of their existence.

MsgJp: しかし、今は彼の存在を封じる竜が不在
MsgEn:
However, there is no dragon to seal his existence
now.

MsgJp:
さらに悪しき竜の干渉により、その力が不安定に
なっているという報告も入ってきております
MsgEn:
We have also received reports that the evil
dragon's interference has destabilized its power.

MsgJp:
この地を――
そしてアッカー王家の威信を守るため
MsgEn:
To protect this land—
And to uphold the honor of the Acre royal family.

MsgJp:
何としても彼の存在を
表に出すわけにはいかないのです
MsgEn:
No matter what, his existence cannot be revealed
to the public.

MsgJp: 今日、私たちはついに、この地まで敵を追い込んだ
MsgEn:
Today, we have finally cornered the enemy to this
land.

MsgJp: 絶望の雲を打ち払って希望の光を取り戻そう
MsgEn:
Let's strike away the clouds of despair and
reclaim the light of hope.

MsgJp:
まあ、レオたちも戻っているわけだから
なんとかなったんだろうな
MsgEn:
Well, Leo and the others have returned,
so things must've have worked out.

MsgJp: さて――俺の名はファビオだ

ここに立って、初陣を生きのびた覚者に
声をかけている
MsgEn:
I stand here, calling out to the newly Arisen who have
survived their first battle, and offer guidance

MsgJp: ほら、あそこ――白竜が眠る《謁見の間》だ
MsgEn:
Look, over there... The Audience Chamber where the
White Dragon slumbers.

MsgJp:
外から戻ったらまずあそこへ
顔を出した方がいい
MsgEn:
Before leaving on your travels, it would be wise
to first make an appearance there.

MsgJp: 行かなくてもいいが、行った方がいいぞ
MsgEn: You don't have to go, but it would be better if you did.

MsgJp:
《謁見の間》の雰囲気は独特だからな
時々行っておかないと顔を出しづらくなる
MsgEn:
The Audience Chamber has a unique atmosphere,
so it's easy to feel uneasy if you haven't
been there in awhile.

MsgJp:
じゃあ、行ってこい
また、あとでな
MsgEn:
Well, off you go.
I'll see you later, I'm sure.

MsgJp:
よう！　あ、忘れたか？
ファビオだよ、ファビオ
MsgEn: Hey! Oh, did you forget? It's me. Fabio, Fabio!

MsgJp:
《謁見の間》はどうだった？
独特の雰囲気だろ？
MsgEn:
How was the Audience Chamber? It has a unique
atmosphere, doesn't it?

MsgJp:
気後れしないためには、なるべく早く
一人前の覚者になる必要がある
MsgEn:
To avoid feeling intimidated, it is necessary to
become a full-fledged Arisen as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
そのための、ちょっとしたコツを教えてやろう
まず、街を歩きまわって他人の話をよく聞くんだ
MsgEn:
So, I'll teach you a little trick for that.
First, walk around the city and listen to what
others have to say.

MsgJp: 特に、北東にある宿場区の宿屋――
MsgEn:
In particular, the Inn at the Relay Station
District to the northeast—

MsgJp:
そこにいるアーチボルトとレンテン――
この二人には必ず会っておけ
MsgEn:
You must meet the two individuals there—Archibald
and Renton.

MsgJp:
戦闘での動き方や、戦技スキルの習得
そして転職など――
MsgEn:
Combat strategies, learning battle skills, and
vocation changes—

MsgJp:
有益な話をしてくれるはずだ
アーチボルトとレンテン――忘れるなよ
MsgEn:
I'm sure they'll give you some useful advice.
Archibald and Renton - don't forget.

MsgJp:
ああ、そうだ
今から宿場区へ行ってふたりに会ってくるといい
MsgEn:
Oh yeah, you can go to the Relay Station
now and see them both.

MsgJp:
まず、顔を覚えてもらうんだな
それが終わったら、また話そう
MsgEn:
First, introduce yourself so they can remember
your face.
Then, after that, let's talk again.

MsgJp:
とりとめのない話を――ごめんなさい
わたしには現実の生活がないから――
MsgEn:
Sorry for the rambling --
I don't have a real life --

MsgJp:
ただ、白竜様と人々を繋ぐだけの
日々だから――時に空想が過ぎるのです
MsgEn:
However, my days are merely spent connecting Lord
White Dragon with the people—sometimes, my
imagination runs too wild.

MsgJp:
大切な仕事ではあるけれど
わたし自身が何事かをなすわけでありません
MsgEn:
It is indeed a vital task, yet I myself do not
accomplish anything of significance.

MsgJp:
巫女ではなくて覚者だったら
こんなことは考えないでしょうね
MsgEn:
If I were an Arisen instead of a priestess, I
wouldn't think about such things.

MsgJp:
レオやイリスやあなたみたいに
たとえ戦場でも充実した時を過ごせる――
MsgEn:
Being able to enjoy fulfilling moments on the
battlefield, like Leo, Iris, and you—
I have a feeling that's the case.

MsgJp:
もちろん、覚者として生きることは
大変なことだと思っています
MsgEn:
Of course, I believe that living as an Arisen is
a difficult thing.

MsgJp: でも、想像の中なら、楽しんでもいいですよね？
MsgEn:
But it's okay to enjoy it in your imagination,
right?

MsgJp:
たとえば、ガルドノック砦から戻って
あなたと一緒に街を歩いて――
MsgEn:
For example, after returning from the Gardnox
Fortress, walking the street with you--

MsgJp: あら？　今日は少しだけ夢がかないました
MsgEn:
Oh? Today, my dream came true, even if only a
little bit.
--I think it's time for us to go back.

MsgJp: あの――今日はありがとう

レスタニア暦３２２年――
オーク戦争の続く混迷の最中
MsgEn:
The year 322 of the Lestania calendar.
In the midst of the ongoing chaos of the Orc Wars.

MsgJp: 新たに一人の覚者が誕生した
MsgEn: A new Arisen has been born.

MsgJp:
多くの命を引き換えにして
大いなる野望は打ち砕かれた
MsgEn:
At the cost of many lives, the grand ambition was
shattered.

MsgJp:
戦火が残るレスタニア大陸
竜の理は巡り続ける
MsgEn:
The war-torn continent of Lestania.
The dragon's order shall continue to circulate.
In the year 323 of the Lestania calendar

MsgJp:
激しい嵐が残していったのは
記憶を失くした異国の少女
MsgEn:
The fierce storm left behind a girl from a
foreign land who had lost her memory.

MsgJp: 二つの大地を繋ぐ、運命の少女であった
MsgEn: She was a girl with a fate to connect two worlds.

MsgJp:
二つの大地、二柱の竜
抗えぬ理が招く、別れと再生
MsgEn:
Two worlds, two dragons.
Inevitable order brings separation and rebirth.

MsgJp: レスタニアにまた、新たな危機が訪れようとしていた
MsgEn: A new crisis was looming over Lestania.

MsgJp: 世界のあり方はひとつではありません
MsgEn: The nature of the world is not singular.

MsgJp: どの道を選ぶのか――それとも新たな道を探すのか
MsgEn:
Which path will you choose—or will you seek a new
one?

MsgJp: 大いに時間をかけて選びなさい
MsgEn: Take your time and choose wisely.

MsgJp: 未来へと歩む人々の、その先頭にいるのはあなたです
MsgEn:
You are at the forefront of those who walk
towards the future.

MsgJp:
ここにいる顔ぶれを覚えておけ
レスタニアを動かす重要人物たちだ
MsgEn:
Remember that these are faces of the people who
are key to keeping Lestania running.
Leo - Leader of the White Winged Arisen.
Gerd - Captain of the White Guard Knights

MsgJp: レオ、自分で言うかなぁ
MsgEn: Leo, awful bold to say that about yourself, no?

MsgJp:
イリス――
自覚もなく俺の右腕でいられると思うな
MsgEn:
Iris...
You can't call yourself my right hand without
having realized that, can you?

MsgJp:
地位が欲しくて
ここにいるわけじゃあないんだけど？
MsgEn: I'm not here because I'm looking for status, you know?

MsgJp:
さあさあ、揉め事は外でな
オークどもを巻き添えにしてやるがいい
MsgEn:
Now, now, you can settle this outside.
Feel free to involve the orcs as well.

MsgJp: 我に心臓を捧げしものよ――
MsgEn: Noble soul that has bequeathed thine own heart to me...

MsgJp:
我が力は失われ――
動くこともままならぬ――
MsgEn:
My strength has waned...
My body will not heed my call..

MsgJp: おまえたちに預けよう――
MsgEn: I shall entrust it to thee...

MsgJp: このレスタニアを守ってくれ
おのが目で、全てを見るのだ
MsgEn: Witness everything in this land with thine eyes unclouded.

MsgJp:
いいところに来てくれた
ひとっ走り、テル村まで行ってほしいんだ
MsgEn:
You've come at a good time. I need you to make a
quick trip to Tel Village.

MsgJp:
魔物退治の依頼に応じたのだが
ちょっとした手違いがあった
MsgEn:
I accepted a request to exterminate some monsters,
but there was a slight mistake.

MsgJp:
すでに騎士団が討伐隊を出したことを知らずに
おれは覚者を送り込んでしまった
MsgEn:
Not knowing that the knights had already sent out
a strike team, I mistakenly sent the Arisen.

MsgJp:
こういうことは揉め事の原因になりやすい上に
あろうことかガルドリンを行かせてしまったんだ
MsgEn:
These kinds of things can easily lead to
disputes, and to make matters worse, I sent
Gurdolin as well.

MsgJp:
拳から生まれた覚者ガルドリン
魔物退治の腕は一流だが粗野な性格でな――
MsgEn:
The Arisen Gurdolin, born from fists. A
first-rate monster hunter with a rough
personality—

MsgJp: 騎士団とのいさかいはなるべくなら避けたい
MsgEn:
We would prefer to avoid any disputes with the
Knight Order if possible.

MsgJp:
急ぎ、帰還するようにガルドリンに伝えてくれ
活躍の場はすぐに用意すると言い添えてな
MsgEn:
Tell Gurdolin to hurry up and return, with
assurance that we'll have him back in action as
soon as possible.

MsgJp: テル村は神殿を出たら南東に――
MsgEn:
Once you leave the Temple, Tel Village is to the
southeast—

MsgJp:
いや、自分で地図を確認した方が
頭に入るだろう
MsgEn:
No, you'd be better off checking the map yourself
to get it in your head.
Well then, I'm counting on you.

MsgJp: ああ、ポーンのことだよね
MsgEn: Ah, you're referring to the Pawns.

MsgJp:
ごめん、新人の指導はわたしの役目だけど
今、忙しいんだ
MsgEn:
Sorry, I know it's my job to mentor newbies, but
I'm busy right now.

MsgJp:
ほら、アークの調査団に参加したくて
こそこそ根回し中――
MsgEn:
See, I've been sneaking around trying to get in
on the Ark survey team.

MsgJp:
で、悪いんだけど、ひとりで《ポーン郷》へ
行ってくれる？
MsgEn:
So, I'm sorry, but can you go to Pawn Cathedral
by yourself?

MsgJp:
ポーンのことは《ポーン郷》へ行かないと
始まらないんだよね
MsgEn:
To begin the pawn-related stuff, you must go to
the Pawn Cathedral.

MsgJp: 行き方はテル村にいるアルフレドに聞くといいよ
MsgEn:
It's best to ask Alfred in Tel Village for
directions.

MsgJp:
彼とは一度会ってるでしょ？
ハイデル平原のエリアマスター、アルフレド
MsgEn:
Alfred, the Area Master of the Hidell Plains.
You've met him before, right?

MsgJp:
エリアを取り仕切る歴戦の覚者だから
親しくしておいて損は無し――
MsgEn:
He's a seasoned war veteran who runs the area, so
it's good to be friendly with him.
Ah, this is confidential, you know.

MsgJp: 暗き深淵を渡りし戦徒（せんと）よ
MsgEn: Oh, Myrmidons who have crossed the dark Abyss.

MsgJp:
この者を覚者と認め――
ポーンとして契り――
MsgEn:
I acknowledge this one as an Arisen.
I swear myself as their Pawn.

MsgJp: リムストーンの誓いを立てたまえ
この者の忠実なしもべとなり――

常に従い――
ともに戦野を駆け巡らん
MsgEn:
Always follow...
And together, we shall race across the
battlefield.

MsgJp:
ああ、ワールドクエストはどうだった？
――うまくいったみたいだね、じゃぁ別件いいかな
MsgEn:
Oh, how was that World Quest?
It looks like it went well! By the way, I've got
another matter.

MsgJp:
実はわたし《そよかぜのリング》が欲しいって
頼まれたんだけど、忙しくてさ
MsgEn:
Actually, I was asked to procure a Zephyr Ring,
but I've been too busy.

MsgJp:
あれ？　ポカンとしてる？
そうか、まだ知らないんだよね
MsgEn:
Huh? You seem bewildered. Oh, I see, you still
don't know, do you?

MsgJp:
ええと、つまり、ポーンのクラフト能力で
アイテムを作って欲しいって話なんだけど――
MsgEn:
Um, so basically, I want you to craft an item
using your Pawn's abilities――

MsgJp:
もちろん、あんたのポーンでね
その気になったら声をかけてよ
MsgEn:
Of course, with your pawns.
Give me a shout when you're ready.

MsgJp:
お！　ポーンと契約できたんだ
まずはおめでとう、じゃあ次は――
MsgEn:
Oh! You made a contract with a Pawn
First of all, congratulations, now the next step
is--

MsgJp:
あ、ここにいたんですね！
こんにちは！　わたしはセネカ――
MsgEn:
Ah, you were here!
Hello! I am Seneka――

MsgJp: ちょっと――わたしが話しているんだけど？
MsgEn: Wait a sec - I'm the one doing the talking.

MsgJp:
あなたはなんと、ワールドクエストに
挑戦できることになりました！
MsgEn: You can now take on World Quests!

MsgJp:
レオさんの計らいですよ？
良かったですね！　うれしいです？
MsgEn:
It was arranged by Ser Leo, wasn't it? You're
pleased, I take it!

MsgJp: あのね、セネカ――ああもう！
まあ、そういうことなの

ワールドクエストの情報はレスタニアニュースで
知ることができて――
MsgEn:
You can find information about World Quests
from Lestania News.

MsgJp:
そのニュースを担当しているのが
このセネカってわけ
MsgEn:
And the one responsible for that news is none
other than Seneka.

MsgJp:
ここの下の広場の、掲示板の前にいますから
いつでも来て下さいね
MsgEn:
I'll be in front of the bulletin board in the
Plaza below here, so please come by anytime.

MsgJp:
ってわけ
頑張れ、新人！
MsgEn:
That's it for now.
Good luck, newcomer!

MsgJp:
天から降ってきたという
《大石塊（アーク）》の話はしたよな？
MsgEn:
I told you about the Monolith (The Ark) that fell
from the sky, didn't I?

MsgJp:
調査団を出したことも
たぶん、知っているだろう
MsgEn:
You've probably heard that we sent out an
investigation team to look into it.

MsgJp:
実は、その連中が期限を過ぎても
戻らないんだ
MsgEn:
In fact... the investigation team hasn't returned
yet, even after the deadline has passed...

MsgJp:
護衛部隊はイリスだから問題はないだろうが
調査団長はあのクラウスだ
MsgEn:
The escort unit is with Iris, so there shouldn't
be any issues. However, the investigation team
leader is that Klaus.

MsgJp:
好奇心に負けて――あるいは手柄を求めて
深入りした結果、危機的状況に陥ってしまった
MsgEn:
Their curiosity got the better of them, or
perhaps in search of fame and glory, they delved
too deep and found themselves in dangerous
conditions.
This is a highly plausible scenario.

MsgJp:
加えて、護衛隊は
覚者と白騎団の混成なんだ
MsgEn:
And, the escort team comprises both Arisen and
White Knights.

MsgJp:
俺の心配は
尽きないというわけだ

MsgEn: If you would be so kind

MsgJp:
どうか調査団の皆さんを
無事に連れ帰ってください
MsgEn:
Please bring back the investigation team members
safely.

MsgJp:
あなたは近年まれに見る
頼もしい覚者だと――
MsgEn:
You are a reliable Arisen, a rare sight these
days...

MsgJp:
レオ様はじめ、皆さんから
うかがっています
MsgEn:
We, and especially Leo, are very impressed with
you.

MsgJp:
いや――やはりまだ荷が重い
俺が行こう――
MsgEn:
No--it's still too heavy a burden.
I'll go--

MsgJp:
オークの臭いが
強くなっています！
MsgEn: The scent of Orcs is ever getting stronger!

MsgJp:
うむ――難しい判断だが――
よし――

やはり、おまえに
《大石塊（アーク）》へ行ってもらおう
MsgEn: I still need you to go to the Ark.

MsgJp:
目的は調査団を連れ戻すことだ
いいな？
MsgEn:
The goal is to bring the investigation team back.
Okay?

MsgJp:
その貴き力を
わたしにくださいますか？
MsgEn: Would you bestow that noble power upon me?

MsgJp:
集いし者たちよ――
レスタニアを愛する者たちよ――
MsgEn:
Oh, people who have gathered here. People who
love Lestania!

MsgJp:
長き眠りの時代は終わり――
まどろみの時代が始まるらしい――
MsgEn:
The era of the long sleep is over...
Seems like the age of repose is beginning...

MsgJp:
力はまだ戻らぬ――
しかし――眠りは――終わった
MsgEn:
The power has not yet returned—However—the
slumber—has ended.

MsgJp:
白竜様！
騎士団一同、お待ちしておりました！
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon!
The knights have been waiting for you!

MsgJp:
覚者たちよ――
待たせたな――
MsgEn:
Arisen ones—
I have kept you waiting—

MsgJp: ああ、なんて神々しいの？――良かったね、イリス
MsgEn: Ah, how divine!... Good for you, Iris

MsgJp: うわ～！　こんな瞬間に立ち会えるなんて――
MsgEn: Wow～! To be able to witness such a moment...

MsgJp: 白竜様――どうか甥っ子にもご加護を――
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon, please bestow your blessings
upon my nephew as well...

MsgJp: どうか――どうかレスタニアに安定を――
白竜よ――お慕い申し上げます――
MsgEn: White Dragon, I offer you my deepest adoration.

MsgJp:
アークでの出来事は
クラウスから聞いた
MsgEn: I heard what happened at the Ark from Klaus.

MsgJp: わたしからきつく叱っておいた
MsgEn: I gave him a good scolding.

MsgJp:
反省もしていることだし
あとは任せてくれ
MsgEn:
Since you are also reflecting on your actions,
please leave the rest to me.

MsgJp:
それでジョゼフ――アークとはいったい
なんなのだ？
MsgEn: So Joseph, what the hell is with The Ark?

MsgJp: 詳しいことはクラウスの報告書――
MsgEn: The details are in Klaus's report...

MsgJp:
見聞したことを細大もらさず記すようにと
命じたものを待つことにしたいが――
MsgEn:
I ordered them to record every detail of what
they saw in detail, but they haven't come back
yet..

MsgJp:
この段階ではっきりしているのは
あれは何者かが作った装置だということ
MsgEn:
At this stage, only one thing is certain... that
it is a device created by some unknown being.

MsgJp:
用途は不明だが、あれを作った者に
心当たりがある
MsgEn:
I don't know what it's for, but I have an idea
who made that thing.

MsgJp:
しかし、これもやはりクラウスの報告を
待つことにしよう
MsgEn: But I'll still wait for Klaus' report on this one.

MsgJp: 勿体ぶるじゃないか、ジョゼフ

もし、あれの創造主が
思った通りの人物であれば
MsgEn:
If the creator of that is the kind of person I
think he is,

MsgJp:
その名を軽々しく口にしたくはないのだ
実に――実に忌まわしい名だからな
MsgEn:
I do not wish to utter that name lightly, for it
is indeed――a most accursed name.

MsgJp:
さっきイリスを見かけたよ
連れ帰ってくれてありがとう
MsgEn:
I saw Iris earlier.
Thank you for bringing her back.

MsgJp: キノザは遠かっただろう？

君が出発してから気軽に
頼みすぎたと反省したんだ
MsgEn:
Since you departed, I've reflected on how I've
been too cavalier in asking for favors.

MsgJp:
それなのに君は嫌な顔ひとつせず――
本当にありがとう
MsgEn:
Even so, you did not show a hint of
displeasure—truly, thank you.

MsgJp:
イリスは冴えない顔をしていたけど
あとは僕が話してみるよ
MsgEn:
Iris had a gloomy expression, but I'll try
talking to her later.

MsgJp:
あの、弾けるような笑顔を
取り戻してもらわなくちゃね！
MsgEn: We need to get that bright smile back, you know!

MsgJp:
かつてこのレスタニアは
黄金郷メルゴダを首都として――
MsgEn:
Lestania, in the past, was a golden land with
Mergoda as its capital...

MsgJp:
この上ない繁栄の時代を
おくっていた

理に従い、竜が選び出した
ひとりの覚者ゴルゴラン
MsgEn:
Following the order of this world, the dragon
chose a single Arisen, Golgorran.

MsgJp:
彼が竜の指導の下、王となって
世を治めた
MsgEn:
Under the guidance of the dragon, he became king
and governed the world.

MsgJp:
その王の手足となって
都市の生活を支えたのが――
MsgEn:
Those who became the hands and feet of the king
and supported the life of the city were――

MsgJp:
そう――
錬金術師のディアマンテスだ

ディアマンテスは
野心を咥えて生まれたような男でな――
MsgEn:
Diamantes seems like a Man who was born clutching
ambition—

MsgJp:
まあ、その野心があったからこそ
偉大な錬金術師になれたともいえるが――
MsgEn:
Well, one could say that it was that ambition
that made him a great alchemist--

MsgJp:
そもそも錬金術は世の理の外にあるものを
掴もうとする研究――
MsgEn:
Alchemy is the study that seeks to grasp what
lies beyond the order of the world.

MsgJp:
となると、あの男が道を外れたのも
当然かもしれん
MsgEn:
With that in mind, it's only natural that the man
strayed from his path.

MsgJp:
ディアマンテスは王をそそのかして
あろうことか、白竜を裏切らせたのだ
MsgEn:
Diamantes tempted the king and, what's more,
betrayed the white dragon.

MsgJp:
人間が竜を支配すべきだと
ゴルゴランに説いたのだな
MsgEn:
He preached to Golgorran that humans should rule
over dragons.
And at the end of it all--

MsgJp:
錬金の秘術を使って
王を竜に変えてしまった
MsgEn:
Using the secret arts of alchemy, he transformed
the king into a dragon.

MsgJp:
ゴルゴランが覚者として
白竜から受け取っていた竜力――
MsgEn:
Golgorran, having received the Dragon Force from
the White Dragon as an Arisen—

MsgJp:
その竜力を術で増幅した
不完全な竜――
MsgEn:
That Dragon Force was amplified by magic,
creating an imperfect dragon.

MsgJp:
完全を求めて彷徨う――
人でも竜でもない亜竜――
MsgEn:
Seeking perfection, wandering—
Neither human nor dragon, a lesser dragon—

MsgJp:
そう――あの、彷徨える《黄金竜》が
ゴルゴランのなれの果てだ
MsgEn:
Indeed, that wandering Golden Dragon is what has
become of Golgorran.

MsgJp:
黄金竜と白竜が戦った――
３００年と少し前のことだ
MsgEn:
The Golden Dragon and the White Dragon fought --
A little over 300 years ago.
In the midst of the battle――

MsgJp:
白竜は背後でうごめく
理の破壊者ディアマンテスに気がついた
MsgEn:
The White Dragon noticed Diamantes, the destroyer
of order, writhing behind him.

MsgJp:
悪しき錬金術師が支配する
メルゴダをこの大地から消し飛ばした
MsgEn:
Banish Mergoda, the land ruled by wicked
alchemists, from this land.

MsgJp:
黄金の輝きもろとも――
文字通り、消した
MsgEn:
Even the golden glow--
literally obliterated it.

MsgJp: ちょうどいい――おまえも聞いてくれ

へえ、出世したね
それはともかく、レオ――
MsgEn: Well, you've risen in the ranks. Anyway, Leo—

MsgJp:
自分としては――
楽観視すべきではないと思う
MsgEn:
As for myself, I don't think we should be
optimistic.

MsgJp:
あの臭いは――
ただの攻撃臭ではない
MsgEn:
That smell... it's not just the smell of a
standard attack.

MsgJp:
おまえが言うなら
その通りなんだろうよ
MsgEn: If you say so, then it must be true.

MsgJp:
よし――
増援部隊を編成しよう
MsgEn: Alright... Let's organize a reinforcement squad.

MsgJp:
巡回に出ている覚者たちを
呼び戻して――
MsgEn: Call back the Arisen who are on patrol--

MsgJp: 時間がかかりそうだな
MsgEn: That's going to take some time.

MsgJp:
レオ統率――
なぜ我々に声をかけない
MsgEn:
Commander Leo --
Why don't you call out to us?

MsgJp:
万が一グリッテン砦が陥落したら
ここもただでは済まない
MsgEn:
Should Fort Gritten fall, this place will not be
spared either.

MsgJp:
白騎団と覚者の混成部隊は
何かと問題があるからな――
MsgEn:
There are always problems with a mixed unit of
the White Knights and the Arisen...

MsgJp:
両者の確執は
一部の覚者たちの態度が問題だ
MsgEn:
The conflict between the two sides is caused by
the attitude of some of the Arisen.

MsgJp: 落ち度は我々覚者の方にある
MsgEn: The fault lies with us, the Arisen.

MsgJp:
しかし、我々は
白竜とともに生きる同志のはず
MsgEn:
However, we are supposed to be comrades living
alongside the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
わかった、ヴァネッサ
おまえの言うとおりだ

では、ゲルト白騎団長
砦へ騎士達を送ってくれ
MsgEn:
Well then, Commander Gerd, send the knights to
the fort.

MsgJp:
ただし、ここにも人員を残す
まどろむ白竜の、最後の防衛線だ
MsgEn:
However, we must leave personnel here as well.
This is the final line of defense for the
slumbering White Dragon.

MsgJp:
くそっ――勝つには勝ったが
見たか、オークどもの自信と勢いを
MsgEn:
Damn it... We won, but did you see the confidence
and momentum of those Orcs?

MsgJp:
おれたちにもっと力があれば――
いや、本来ならば、あるはずなんだ
MsgEn:
If only we had more power --
No, by all rights, we should have.

MsgJp:
覚者が一般の者より
優れているのは――
MsgEn:
The Arisen are superior to ordinary people in
that—

MsgJp:
竜の力を継承できるという――
その一点のみ――
MsgEn:
The ability to inherit the power of the dragon—
That alone—

MsgJp:
なのに、おれたちの竜は――
白竜は半ば眠りの中、しかも石化が進行中だ
MsgEn:
But our dragon...
The White Dragon is half asleep and in the
process of being turned to stone.

MsgJp:
なんとかして――
竜の力を譲り受けなくては――
MsgEn:
We must do something -- we have to inherit the
power of the dragon --

MsgJp:
《ブラッドオーブ》が起こす奇跡では
まったく足りない――時間がかかり過ぎる
MsgEn:
The miracles caused by the 《Blood Orb》are not
enough―― It takes too long.

MsgJp:
白竜に力強く目覚めてもらう方法が
必ずあるはずだ
MsgEn:
There must be a way to awaken the White Dragon to
their full potential.

MsgJp: それを見つけなくては――

ああ、クラウスと話したか――
イリスのことだな？
MsgEn:
Oh, you talked to Klaus--
about Iris, right?

MsgJp:
おまえもメイリーフを連れ去ったのは
あいつだと――
MsgEn:
You also believe that she's the one who abducted
Mayleaf.

MsgJp:
いや、いい
何も言うな
MsgEn:
Ah, no. Good.
You don't need to say it.

MsgJp:
実は――たった今
イリスからの伝言が届いた
MsgEn: Actually, I just received a message from Iris.
She wants to meet at the Temple of Purification.

MsgJp:
ここしばらくあいつが
思い悩んでいることには気づいていた
MsgEn:
I've noticed her being worried about something
recently.

MsgJp:
レオ――居場所がわかっているなら
早く会いに行った方がいい
MsgEn:
Leo... If you know her whereabouts, it's best to
go see her soon.

MsgJp:
いいだろう――
《禊の神殿》へ行く
MsgEn:
All right.
Let's go to the "Temple of Purification".

MsgJp: おまえも準備ができたら来てくれ
MsgEn: You can join us when you're ready.

MsgJp:
覚者にもすでに通達があったはずだが――
その様子ではまだだな？
MsgEn:
I'm sure the Arisen was already notified, but...
The situation looks like it has not been resolved
yet, has it?

MsgJp:
オークの大軍がここに向かっている
きわめて攻撃的な集団だ
MsgEn:
A large group of orcs is heading this way. They
are very aggressive.

MsgJp:
騎士団主導で迎撃隊を編成しているが
覚者の協力も不可欠
MsgEn:
We are organizing a defensive team led by the
Knights. However, the participation of the Arisen
is essential.

MsgJp:
貴殿は必ずや参加してくれるものと
信じているぞ
MsgEn: I am certain you will join us.

MsgJp:
しかし、これはまだ下では他言無用だ
神殿全体が大混乱になるからな
MsgEn:
However, do not speak of this to anyone else
below, for the entire Temple will be thrown into
chaos.

MsgJp:
今こそ覚者の務めを果たす時
白竜様のご恩に報いるのは今しかない
MsgEn:
Now is the time to fulfill the duties of the
Arisen.
It is now or never to repay the debt of gratitude
to the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
もちろん、この神殿に集う者たちも
我らの保護を必要としている
MsgEn:
Of course, those gathered in this temple also
need our protection.

MsgJp:
おい、事を起こすぞ
オークの巣窟に攻め込む
MsgEn:
Listen up, it's time to act!
