We're going to attack the orcs' lair.

MsgJp:
おまえは遠征部隊の頭数にはいっているから
売り込みは無用だ
MsgEn:
You're in the head count for the expeditionary
force, so no sales pitch needed.

MsgJp:
キースヒルトの命を奪われてからというもの
情報収集に努めているが――
MsgEn:
I've been trying to gather information since
Kieshildt's life was taken--

MsgJp: 今のところ大きな変化は報告されていない
MsgEn:
There have been no reports of significant changes
at this time.

MsgJp: オークどもがあいつの命をいつ、どこで――
MsgEn: When and where did the Orcs take his life?

MsgJp:
どのような目的で使う気なのか――
未だに謎のままだ
MsgEn:
What purpose they intend to use it for--
remains a mystery.

MsgJp: しかし、いつまでも待ち続けるわけにはいかない
MsgEn: However, we can't keep waiting forever.

MsgJp:
敵の本拠、ガルドノック砦を突いて
キースヒルトの命を奪還するんだ
MsgEn:
We'll strike at the enemy's stronghold, Gardnox
Fortress, and reclaim the life of Kieshildt.

MsgJp:
実に楽しそうだが
わたしは誘ってもらえないのか？
MsgEn: It seems delightful, but am I not to be invited?

MsgJp:
ヴァネッサは留守を頼む
昨今の戦いで騎士が減ってしまってな――
MsgEn:
Vanessa, please stay.
We've lost a lot of knights in the last few
battles...

MsgJp:
俺たちの作戦の結果、ここが危険に晒される
可能性も考えなくてはならない
MsgEn:
We must consider the possibility that our
strategy could expose this place to danger.

MsgJp:
それは責任重大だな
いいだろう――ここは忘れて存分に戦え
MsgEn:
That carries a heavy responsibility.
Very well—forget everything here and fight to
your heart's content.

MsgJp: 加えて､ひと言あるが、いいか？
MsgEn:
Additionally, I have one more thing to say, if
that's okay?

MsgJp:
運があるようなら、腐れオークどもを逃がすな
根絶やしにしても誰も文句は言わない
MsgEn:
If fortune favors us, do not let those rotten
Orcs escape. Exterminate them, and no one will
complain.

MsgJp: もとより、そのつもりだ
MsgEn: Of course, that's the plan from the beginning.

MsgJp: だが、少々、厄介な問題がある
MsgEn: But there's a bit of a problem.

MsgJp:
ガルドノック砦は難攻不落――
侵入さえ、困難だろう
MsgEn:
Gardnox Fortress is impregnable—
even infiltration would prove difficult.

MsgJp:
その困難を乗り越える方法を
俺たちで見つけ出す必要がある
MsgEn:
We need to find a way to overcome that difficulty
ourselves.

MsgJp:
手分けをして、その方法を探そう
おまえは《ドラワンの村》で情報を集めてくれ
MsgEn:
Let's split up and search for a method. You
gather information in Drawan Village.

MsgJp:
誇り高き者の命――
どうか白竜様へ
MsgEn:
The life of a proud one...
Please, to the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
理を乱す者の手が――
鈍色の手がすでに伸びている――
MsgEn:
The hand of the one who disrupts order――
The dull-colored hand is already reaching out...

MsgJp:
その手の主を――
我は知っている――
MsgEn: I know the master of that hand...

MsgJp:
類い希な知力を持つが――
その執念の他、学ぶことなし
MsgEn:
Possessing a rare intellect, yet—
apart from his obsession, he learns naught.

MsgJp:
レオ――
その名を、どこで？
MsgEn: Leo... Where have I heard that name before?

MsgJp:
イリスからだ
あなたは知っていたのか？

ああ――
書物の中の住人としてな
MsgEn:
Ah...
As an inhabitant within the pages of a tome...

MsgJp: 何事だ！？　この衝撃は何事！？
MsgEn: What's happening!? What is this shock!?

MsgJp: もしや――再びアークが現れたのか？
MsgEn: Could it be — has The Ark appeared once again?

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様――僕は反対です
破壊よりも利用することを考えるべきで――
MsgEn:
Master Joseph... I disagree. We should consider
utilizing rather than destroying it--

MsgJp:
クラウス、それ以上は言うな
錬金術の復活を叫ぶ者をここに置くわけにいかん
MsgEn:
Klaus, speak no further. We cannot allow those
who cry for the revival of alchemy to remain here.

MsgJp:
わたしに意見するのは構わぬが
あれを利用したいなどと二度と口にするな
MsgEn:
I don't mind if you voice your opinion, but never
speak again about wanting to use it.

MsgJp:
どれほど魅力ある秘術でも
人を惑わす力には手を出してはならんのだ
MsgEn:
No matter how alluring the secret arts may be,
one must not meddle with powers that lead people
astray.

MsgJp:
以来、新しいレスタニアの歴史が始まり
現在に至っている
MsgEn:
Since then, a new chapter in the history of
Lestania has begun, leading up to the present.

MsgJp:
かつてより繁栄しているとも
平和だと言うつもりはないが――
MsgEn:
It may be more prosperous than before, but I have
no intention of claiming it's peaceful—

MsgJp:
この愛おしい世界にまた脅威が現れた
ディアマンテスは諦めていなかったのだ
MsgEn:
A new threat has emerged in this beloved world.
Diamantes has not given up.

MsgJp:
となれば我々がすべきことはひとつ！
脅威――即ち、飛来したアークの排除である
MsgEn:
If that's the case, there is only one thing we
should do! Deal with the threat—namely, to
eliminate the incoming Arks.

MsgJp:
アークはレスタニアに仇なす厄災を運ぶ船
放置すればアークが次のアークを呼ぶ
MsgEn:
The Ark is a vessel that brings calamities upon
Lestania. If left unchecked, the Ark will summon
the next Ark

MsgJp:
皆で知恵を出し合い破壊の方策を見つけ出し
力を合わせて事を為すのだ
MsgEn:
Let us all pool our wisdom to find a strategy of
destruction, and by combining our strength,
accomplish this task.

MsgJp: ジョゼフ様、僕の進言は無視ですか！？
MsgEn: Master Joseph, are you ignoring my advice!?

MsgJp: クラウス、場をわきまえよ

この場での発言は――
わたしに楯突くのとは訳が違うぞ
MsgEn:
What you say here-- is not the same as
challenging me.

MsgJp:
察するに――例の噂が関係あるのか？
ここに錬金術師の子孫がいるとかいないとか――
MsgEn:
It seems to be related to that rumor, doesn't it?
Whether there's a descendant of an alchemist here
or not...

MsgJp:
血で継承されるものなどありません
その者の言動で判断すべきです
MsgEn:
There is nothing inherited through blood. One
should be judged by their actions and words.

MsgJp: 話は聞かせてもらった
クラウス――ここはジョゼフに従おう

ジョゼフ、アークを破壊する方法を
探す必要があると言ったな
MsgEn:
Joseph, you said we need to find a way to destroy
the Ark.

MsgJp:
それはあんたとクラウス――
必要であれば騎士団に任せてもいいか？
MsgEn:
That's up to you and Klaus--
Can we leave it to the Knights if necessary?

MsgJp:
俺たち覚者には休息が必要だ
アークへの遠征でそれが身にしみた
MsgEn:
We Arisen require rest; that much became clear to
me on our expedition to the Ark.

MsgJp:
おまえがそんなことを言うとは
よほどのこと――
MsgEn:
For you to say such a thing, it must be something
significant—

MsgJp:
ああ、任せてくれ
クラウス、ここはレオに免じて――いいな？
MsgEn: Ah, leave it to me. Klaus, for Leo's sake—alright?

MsgJp:
さあ、準備は整った、アークへ行こう
俺と、おまえ――あとは――
MsgEn:
Alright, preparations are complete; let's head to
the Ark. It's you and me—and what's left—

MsgJp:
部隊の規模はどうするつもりだ
見たところ覚者は出払っているようだ
MsgEn:
What are the plans for the size of the Unit? It
seems that the Arisen are all out on duty.

MsgJp:
むろん、騎士団からも兵は出せるが
敵の目的が我々の命ということであれば――
MsgEn:
Certainly, the Knight Order can deploy soldiers,
but if the enemy's aim is our very lives—

MsgJp:
ゲルト騎士団長――そのとおり
もし多勢で攻めて被害が出れば
MsgEn:
Ser Gerd, the leader of the Knights... That's
right. If we attack with a large force and suffer
casualties...

MsgJp:
それは我々の損失だけではない
敵に利することになるからな
MsgEn: It is not just our loss; it benefits the enemy.

MsgJp: よって、この作戦はごく少数で決行したい
MsgEn:
Therefore, I would like to carry out this
operation with only a small number of people.

MsgJp:
加えて、検討してほしいことがある
敵はさらなる命を求めて作戦を展開するだろう
MsgEn:
Additionally, there is something I would like you
to consider. The enemy will likely deploy
strategies in pursuit of taking more lives.

MsgJp:
それを考えると、やはり、ここは安全ではない
敵襲に備えるべきだと思う
MsgEn:
Considering that, this place is not safe. I think
we should prepare for enemy attacks.

MsgJp: メイリーフ嬢がまた狙われるということか？
MsgEn:
Does this mean that Miss Mayleaf is being
targeted again?

MsgJp:
可能性は高い
ゲルト騎士団長――あなたにお任せしたい
MsgEn:
The likelihood is high. Knight Commander Gerd—I
would like to entrust this to you.

MsgJp:
もちろんだ
グリッテンの連中と連携して万全の体制を作ろう
MsgEn:
Sure.
We'll work with the guys from Gritten to make sure
everything is in place.

MsgJp:
では、俺はすぐにでも出発する
攻撃部隊はアークで合流しよう
MsgEn:
Then, I will leave immediately. The attack force
will meet at the Ark.

MsgJp:
くそっ――
このゲルト、一生の不覚
MsgEn:
Damn it—
This lapse will haunt me for a lifetime, Gerd.

MsgJp:
貴殿らの留守中
下に魔物どもが侵入してな
MsgEn: While you were away, monsters invaded from below.

MsgJp:
すぐに撃退したのだが
空をまたアークが横切ったのだ
MsgEn:
We quickly repelled them, but another Ark crossed
the sky.

MsgJp:
第三のアークが、この上を飛んで行った
その間に、あの女がぬけぬけと――
MsgEn:
The third Ark flew over this place, and during
that time, that woman, without a care in the
world――

MsgJp:
ゲルト、おまえの責任ではない
魔物と新アークの飛来で混乱の中
MsgEn:
Gerd, it's not your fault. It's chaos caused by
the arrival of monsters and the new Ark.

MsgJp:
見知った顔との再会にミシアルも
油断したのだろう
MsgEn:
Mysial must have let her guard down when she
reunited with a familiar face.

MsgJp: ジョゼフさま！　早くミシアル様を
MsgEn:
Master Joseph! Please hurry and bring back Ms
Mysial.

MsgJp: ミシアルがどうしたというのだ

ミシアル様がわたしの代わりに！
連れていかれちゃった！
MsgEn:
Mysial took my place!
He took her away!

MsgJp:
"メルゴダの深淵"まで
ズールの命を持って来いって
MsgEn: Bring the life of Zuhl to the Mergoda Abyss.

MsgJp:
イリスだよ――
イリスが来たの

そうか――こうなってしまっては
覚悟を決めるしかないようだな
MsgEn:
It seems I have no choice but to steel my resolve
now that it has come to this.

MsgJp: さあメルゴダの深淵での出来事を教えてくれ
MsgEn: Now, tell me what happened in the Mergoda Abyss.

MsgJp:
――嗚呼、ミシアル
なんということを――
MsgEn: Ah, Mysial, what have you done...

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様、もうこうしてはいられません
ミシアルの覚悟に報いることを考えましょう
MsgEn:
Master Joseph, we can no longer remain idle. Let
us consider how to honor Mysial's resolve.

MsgJp:
ふむ――そうかもしれんな
我々に残された魔物の命
MsgEn:
Hmmm--maybe so.
The demon lives we have left.

MsgJp:
その命で白竜がまた羽ばたいてくれるのであれば
すべての犠牲は報われる――
MsgEn:
If those lives can make the White Dragon soar
once again, then all sacrifices will be
rewarded...

MsgJp:
違うんです！
その命は第三のアークに捧げるんです
MsgEn:
You've got it wrong! This life is to be dedicated
to The Third Ark.

MsgJp:
ズールは死ぬ間際に
「ゲートを開く」と言ったとか
MsgEn: Before he died, Zuhl said "Open the gate".

MsgJp:
おそらく、そのゲートの向こうに
ディアマンテスがいるのでしょう
MsgEn: Perhaps, Diamantes is beyond that gate.

MsgJp:
ならば、こちらから行ってやろうでは
ありませんか
MsgEn: Well then, shall we not go there ourselves?

MsgJp:
馬鹿なことを言うな！
今後のことは――
MsgEn:
Do not speak such foolishness! As for what comes
after—

MsgJp:
会議などで時間を浪費している
場合ではありません！
MsgEn: We don't have the time to waste in meetings!

MsgJp:
クラウスよ、落ち着け
せめてレオの意見を聞いてからでも遅くはない
MsgEn:
Klaus, calm yourself. It wouldn't be too late
even if we were to listen to Leo's opinion first.

MsgJp: ――なんだと？　レオが姿を消した！？

命の器はレオが持っているんだね？
だったらレオは僕と同じことを――
MsgEn:
Leo has the Vessel of Life, doesn't he? If that's
the case, then he must be doing the same thing as
me...

MsgJp:
クラウス、忘れたのか？
イリスの身に起こったことをもう忘れたか
MsgEn:
Klaus, have you already forgotten what befell
Iris?

MsgJp:
レオに限って――
いや、早くレオを見つけなくちゃ！
MsgEn:
Not Leo of all people—
No, I must find Leo quickly!

MsgJp: 作戦の概要はジョゼフ殿から聞いた
MsgEn:
I heard the outline of the operation from Master
Joseph.

MsgJp:
我々騎士団はメルゴダ周辺を
跋扈する魔物を引き受ける
MsgEn:
Our order of knights will take care of the
monsters that roam around Mergoda.

MsgJp:
貴殿らが背後を気にすることなく
ディアマンテスに向かえるようにな
MsgEn:
So that you may head towards Diamantes without
having to watch your back.
Come, let us head to Mergoda!

MsgJp:
わたしからはもう何も言うことはない
無事の帰還を祈る
MsgEn:
I have nothing more to say.
I pray for your safe return.

MsgJp:
行ってらっしゃい！
わたしは白竜様にお祈りします
MsgEn:
Take care!
I will pray to the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
ディアマンテス――
これはディアマンテスの命――
MsgEn: Diamantes— This is the will of Diamantes—

MsgJp:
親愛なる覚者たちよ――
よくやった
レスタニアの善き民たちよ――

我は汝らを誇りに思い――
そして、感謝を捧げる――
MsgEn:
I take pride in you all—
And thus, I offer my gratitude—

MsgJp:
こうして目覚めてなお、我の復活には
今しばらくの時間が必要だ――
MsgEn:
Even after awakening like this, it will take a
little more time for my revival -

MsgJp:
しかし、必ずかつての力を取り戻し――
天空を舞ってみせよう――
MsgEn:
However, I will definitely regain my former
power— And soar through the skies—

MsgJp:
それまで――
今日の喜びを忘れるな
MsgEn:
Until then--
Remember the joy of today.

MsgJp: もちろんです！　けっして忘れません！
MsgEn: Yes, of course! I will never forget!

MsgJp:
白竜の世よ、永遠なれ！
さあ、白竜とともに歩もうではないか！
MsgEn:
May the era of the White Dragon be eternal!
Come, let us walk alongside the White Dragon!

MsgJp:
ふむ――実は、お前にぜひとも調べてもらいたい
ことがあってな
MsgEn:
Hmm—actually, there's something I really need you
to investigate.

MsgJp:
"竜王の指輪"――
その魔器の名を聞いたことがあるか？
MsgEn:
Have you heard of the magic artifact known as the
Wyrmking's Ring?

MsgJp:
かつて、大陸に覚者が一人だった時代――
代々受け継いできた強い竜力を秘めた指輪だ
MsgEn:
In an era when there was but a single Arisen on
the continent—
It is a ring that conceals a potent Dragon Force,
passed down through generations.

MsgJp:
それは３００年以上前、邪なる者により失われた
はずだった
MsgEn:
It should have been lost to the evil one over 300
years ago!

MsgJp:
だがその指輪の存在について、ミシアルは懸念を
持っていたようでな
MsgEn:
However, it seemed that Mysial had concerns about
the existence of that ring.

MsgJp: その存在を、幽かに感じると――
MsgEn: And to faintly sense its presence...

MsgJp:
どうも嫌な予感が拭えん
そこで、お前に調査を頼みたいのだ
MsgEn:
I can't shake a bad feeling about this.
So, I need you to do some research for me.

MsgJp:
指輪にかつて力を注がれた３つの地
"竜力の渦"と呼ばれる場所を
MsgEn:
There are three places where the power was once
poured into the ring, called the "Whirls of Dragon
Force."

MsgJp:
ただし、指輪の力を察知するには
各地で力を示す必要があるという
MsgEn:
However, to sense the power of the ring, it is
said that one must demonstrate their strength in
various places.

MsgJp: 難しい頼みだが、どうか引き受けてくれ
MsgEn: It's a difficult request, but please take it.

MsgJp:
覚者よ――
厄災の兆しがある
MsgEn: Arisen... There are signs of disaster.

MsgJp:
忌まわしき力の証――
《竜王の指輪》の波動を感じるのだ――
MsgEn:
A testament to a detestable power—I sense the
pulsation of the Wyrmking's Ring—

MsgJp:
あの指輪を最後に持ちえたのは
３００有余年前の、ひとりの覚者――
MsgEn:
The last to possess that ring was an Arisen, over
300 years ago—

MsgJp:
指輪はその者とともにレスタニアの大地から
消えたはずだが――
MsgEn:
The ring should have vanished from the land of
Lestania along with its bearer—

MsgJp: 混乱の時代に再び震えだしたようだ
MsgEn: It seems to tremble once more in the age of chaos.

MsgJp:
覚者よ――《竜王の指輪》を探し出し
破壊してしまうのだ
MsgEn: Arisen, seek out and destroy the Wyrmking's Ring.

MsgJp:
過ぎたる力は世を乱す
これ以上の混乱は手に余ろうからな
MsgEn:
Excessive power disrupts the world.
We cannot afford any more chaos.

MsgJp: 孤島に現れし黒き鎧の騎士――
MsgEn:
A knight clad in black armor,
appearing on that lonely isle...

MsgJp:
あやつは――
レスタニアの災いとなる闇を背負いし者
MsgEn:
That one carries the darkness...
that brings calamity to Lestania.

MsgJp:
覚者よ――
我が目となり、兜に隠された素顔を探れ
MsgEn:
Arisen... become mine Eyes and seek out
the true face hidden beneath the helm.

MsgJp:
わたしは――少しばかり、力を使いすぎた
しばし――休む
MsgEn:
I have... used a bit too much power.
I shall rest for a while.

MsgJp:
白竜直々の、特別な使命に相応しい者は
おまえしかいないだろう
MsgEn:
There is no one more suitable for the special
mission bestowed by the White Dragon than you.

MsgJp:
もちろん、ひとりでとは言わん
配下には――
MsgEn:
Of course, you won't be alone.
You'll have under your command...

MsgJp: おい、エリオット！　エリオットはいるか！？
はい、ジョゼフ様！　ただいま！
MsgEn: Yes, Master Joseph! I've just arrived!

MsgJp:
わたしの下働きをさせていたが
外を知る良い機会だ
MsgEn:
He was my assistant, but now is a good opportunity
for him to learn about the outside world.

MsgJp: 後ろにいるリズは――おそらく顔見知りのはず
MsgEn: Following behind is Lise. You've probably met before.

MsgJp: 覚者人生をやり直したいとのことだ
MsgEn: She wants a fresh start as an Arisen.

MsgJp:
こんにちは
いよいよ、わたしたちの時代が来たって感じ？
MsgEn: Heya. Doesn't it feel like it's our time to shine?

MsgJp:
これを機会に新しい覚者人生を行こうって
思ってるんで、よろしく
MsgEn:
This feels like the perfect chance to start a whole
new life as an Arisen, and I hope for your support.

MsgJp:
生まれ変わった気でやるから
期待してね～！
MsgEn:
I'll approach this like I've been reborn.
It's gonna be great～!

MsgJp:
生まれ変わるって――
覚者はそう簡単に死にませんよね
MsgEn: To be reborn... Death doesn't come easily to Arisen, does it?

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様のお側にいましたから
精神修行だけはたっぷり積んでいます
MsgEn:
Having been by Master Joseph's side, I have indeed
devoted much time to spiritual training.

MsgJp:
この二人に加えてガルドリンをつけよう
今しがたまでここにいたのだが――
MsgEn:
In addition to these two, Gurdolin will go too.
He was just here a moment ago...

MsgJp: 性格に疑問ありですね
MsgEn: I have doubts about his character.

MsgJp:
何事も経験だ
何しろ、我々が求めているのは――
MsgEn:
Experience is everything.
After all, here is our common goal...

MsgJp:
レオの後任として覚者をまとめる
重責の担い手だからな
MsgEn:
As Leo's successor, they now bear the heavy
responsibility of leading the Arisen.

MsgJp:
レオ統率は、やっぱり戻らないんですか？
やれやれ
MsgEn:
Is Commander Leo not coming back after all?
Oh dear.

MsgJp:
このような事態でも姿を見せないとなれば
我々とともに歩む気は、もう、ないのだろう
MsgEn:
If he does not show himself amidst such a crisis,
it must mean he no longer wishes to walk alongside us.

MsgJp: となれば、おまえが頼りだ
MsgEn: Such is the case, so the duty is now yours.

MsgJp: 一隊の長として、すぐさま任務にあたってくれ
MsgEn:
As the leader of the squad, please attend to your
mission at once.
In the year 323 of the Lestania calendar

MsgJp: 後に「侵食の大災」と呼ばれる戦いは幕を開けた
MsgEn:
The battle later known as the "Great Plague of
Corruption" began.

MsgJp: これは、時代と竜に翻弄される覚者たちの物語である
MsgEn:
This is the story of the Arisen who are
manipulated by the era and the dragon

MsgJp:
おまえから、大きな力を感じる
善とも悪ともつかぬが――
MsgEn:
I feel great power from you.
Neither good nor evil, but...

MsgJp: その力、我がレスタニアに及ぼす影響は大きい
MsgEn:
That power has a significant impact on our
Lestania.

MsgJp:
この地の行く末を変えてしまうほどの力が
おまえには宿っているようだ
MsgEn:
It seems that you possess a power capable of
altering the fate of this land.

MsgJp: おそらく――竜の力であろう
MsgEn: Most likely... it is the power of a dragon.

MsgJp:
本来交わることなき竜と竜の力が交わった
言わば、おまえはその交点
MsgEn:
The power of the dragon and the dragon's power
that never originally intersected have
intersected.
You are the intersection, so to speak.

MsgJp: 黒騎士がわたしを求めるのはそのせいですか？
MsgEn: Is that why the Black Knight seeks me?

MsgJp:
白竜様――その深き叡智で
わたしの進むべき道をお教えください
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon, with your profound wisdom,
please teach me the path I should take.

MsgJp: わたしは――ここにいてはいけないのです

魔物を呼び寄せ、みなさんを危険に
さらしてしまいます
MsgEn:
By calling these monsters, all are exposed to
danger.

MsgJp:
おまえを追う者どもが竜に連なる者ならば
このレスタニアに安全な地など存在せぬ
MsgEn:
If those who pursue you are connected to the
dragon,
then there is no safe place in Lestania for you.

MsgJp: そんな気がしてましたよ
MsgEn: I had a feeling that was the case.

MsgJp:
神殿に集う者たちよ
この娘――命を賭して守るのだ
MsgEn:
Ye who gather at the Temple,
protect this maiden with your lives.
Cecily, the girl from a foreign land.

MsgJp:
この者たちを信じ、ともに歩み
おまえの内から失われた真実を取り戻せ
MsgEn:
Believe in these people, walk together with them,
and regain the truth that was lost within you.

MsgJp: ありがとうございます！
隊長さん――相談があります
MsgEn: Captain, I have something to discuss.

MsgJp: わたしの記憶は、まだ戻りそうにありません
MsgEn:
My memories still seem unlikely to return, as of
yet.

MsgJp: 黒騎士に追われる理由――
MsgEn:
The reason why I am being chased by the Black
Knight—

MsgJp:
せめてそれだけでも思い出せないものかと
努力しているのですが――
MsgEn:
I am doing my best to at least remember that
much...

MsgJp: やはり時間がかかりそうです
MsgEn: It seems it will still take some time.

MsgJp:
それなのに、ここにこうしていると――
居場所を黒騎士やズールに知られたら――
MsgEn:
And yet, if my whereabouts were to be known by
the Black Knight or Zuhl...

MsgJp:
みなさんをまた危険な目に
あわせてしまうことになります
MsgEn: It would put all of you in danger again.

MsgJp:
わたしはどこか遠くへ行かねばなりません
みなさんを巻きこまずにすむ、遠い、どこかへ
MsgEn:
I must go somewhere far away. Somewhere distant
where I won't involve everyone.

MsgJp:
このレスタニアに安全な場所などない
白竜様のお言葉、覚えてるよね？
MsgEn:
There is no safe place in Lestania. Do you
remember the words of the White Dragon?
I will try testing my strength.

MsgJp:
隊長を、どこかの島へ飛ばしてしまった力――
あの力を自分に使ってみたいのです
MsgEn:
The power that sent the Captain to some unknown
island...
I want to use that power for myself.

MsgJp:
見極めなきままに力を放てば
おまえはその力に呑まれてしまうだろう
MsgEn:
If you unleash your power without discernment,
You will surely be consumed by that power.

MsgJp:
人は弱い
時にその弱さは世界を危うくする
MsgEn:
People are weak.
At times, that weakness can endanger the world.

MsgJp: 他に方法がないのです！

ならば、おまえの記憶が戻ったなら
力の解放を許そう
MsgEn:
If your memories have returned, then I shall
allow the release of your power.

MsgJp:
記憶を取り戻し、それでも尚
力が必要だと信じるならば一度だけ
MsgEn:
If you're determined to recover your memories and
still believe you need power, then just this once.

MsgJp: それまでは、けして、ならぬ
MsgEn: Until then, it is absolutely forbidden.

MsgJp:
悔しまぎれの捨て台詞であればと願っていたが
ズールめ、真実を言い残していたらしい
MsgEn:
I had hoped it was just a desperate parting
remark, but it seems Zuhl spoke the truth.

MsgJp:
各地からの報告によると
侵食魔による被害はこれまで以上に深刻だ
MsgEn:
According to reports from various regions, the
damage caused by the Corruption is more serious
than ever before.

MsgJp:
かくなる上は騎士団、覚者隊の区別なく
一丸となって事に当たろうではないか！
MsgEn:
Given the circumstances, let us unite as one,
regardless of whether we are knights or Arisen!

MsgJp:
貴殿らは、少数精鋭の利を活かし
遊撃隊として戦場（いくさば）を駆け巡るがいい
MsgEn:
You should make use of your small elite force and
roam the battlefield as a strike team.

MsgJp:
転戦に次ぐ転戦ということになろうが
貴殿ならやれるはずだ
MsgEn:
Even if it means constantly changing
battlefields, you should be able to do it.

MsgJp:
今、セシリーたちが出て行きました
リズもやけに張り切っていて――
MsgEn:
Cecily and the others have already left. Lise
seems unusually eager as well...

MsgJp:
次は南の集落を回るつもりらしいです
俺は、隊長が戻る頃かと思って――
MsgEn:
It seems they plan to visit the southern village
next. I thought they would return when the captain
comes back...

MsgJp:
大変です！
メルゴダに侵食魔が現れたとの報せです！
MsgEn:
It's urgent! There's a report that an infected
has appeared in Mergoda!

MsgJp: メルゴダか――住民たちでなんとかならんのか？
MsgEn: Can't the residents of Mergoda handle it somehow?

MsgJp: 彼らが錬金術師だからですか？
MsgEn: Is it because they are alchemists?

MsgJp: 錬金術師がどうなろうと構いませんか！？
MsgEn:
Are you that indifferent to the fate of the
alchemists!?

MsgJp:
メルゴダもレスタニアの一部です
他の地域と同じに扱わねばなりません！
MsgEn:
Mergoda is also part of Lestania. It must be
treated the same as other regions!

MsgJp:
区別することが
彼らの心に闇を作るのです
MsgEn:
Making a distinction creates darkness in their
hearts.

MsgJp:
クラウスの言うとおりだ
貴殿はメルゴダへ行くがよい
MsgEn: Klaus is right. You should go to Mergoda.

MsgJp:
親交の深い貴殿が行けば
かの地の連中も心強いだろう
MsgEn:
If someone with a close relationship like you
goes, it will give them courage.

MsgJp: 他は我々騎士団に任せてくれ！
MsgEn: Leave the rest to our order of knights!

MsgJp:
じゃ、俺は騎士団を手伝いますよ
隊長は安心してメルゴダへ行ってください
MsgEn:
Well then, I'll assist the knights. Captain,
please go to Mergoda without worry.

MsgJp: 無事の帰還、なによりだ
MsgEn: A safe return is the most important thing.
The knight order's achievements are excellent!

MsgJp:
加えて、グリッテン砦の大掃除完了との
報告がたった今入った
MsgEn:
In addition, a report has just come in that the
cleaning of Fort Gritten has been completed.

MsgJp:
隊長！　南は完全制圧！
わたしとセシリーの手柄だからね！
MsgEn:
Captain! The south has been completely subdued!
It's all thanks to me and Cecily's
accomplishments!

MsgJp: ひぃひぃ言ってたぜ、こいつ
メルゴダに黒騎士が現れたと聞きました
MsgEn: I heard that the Black Knight appeared in Mergoda.

MsgJp: ご無事で――なによりです
MsgEn: I'm glad you're safe—above all else.

MsgJp:
さて――皆の尽力で
最悪の状況からは脱したというところだな
MsgEn:
Now, with everyone's efforts, we have managed to
escape from the worst conditions.

MsgJp: だが、侵食魔がゼロになったわけじゃねえ
MsgEn:
However, it doesn't mean that the corruption has
been reduced to zero.

MsgJp: 黒騎士も相変わらずです
MsgEn: The Black Knight is still the same as ever.

MsgJp: みんな、もう少し前向きになろう？
MsgEn: Everyone, let's try to be a little more positive.

MsgJp: セシリーの記憶が戻ればなあ
MsgEn: If only Cecily could regain her memories.

MsgJp:
おまえの記憶がどうあろうと
敵がいる限り我々は戦い続ける
MsgEn:
No matter what your memories may be, as long as
there are enemies, we will continue to fight.

MsgJp:
それは白竜の御前に集う者の責務であり――
戦いの果てにある世界は夢であり、希望だ
MsgEn:
It is the duty of those who gather before the
White Dragon's presence—
The world that lies at the end of the battle is a
dream, and a hope.

MsgJp: 嵐とともに始まったレスタニアの危機
MsgEn: The crisis of Lestania began with the storm.

MsgJp:
人々は、怖れ、おののいたが
騎士団の活躍に明日を見いだし――
MsgEn:
The people, filled with fear and trembling, find
hope in the actions of the Knight's Order, and
look towards a brighter tomorrow.

MsgJp: 覚者の奮闘に、白竜の加護を感じた
MsgEn:
They felt the blessings of the White Dragon
through the efforts of the Arisen.

MsgJp: 黒騎士とその配下のズール――
MsgEn: The Black Knight and their subordinate, Zuhl...

MsgJp:
渡来してきた魔物たちの暗躍に
不安な日々は続くだろう
MsgEn:
The days of unease continue as the enemy
creatures brought forth from afar conspire in the
shadows.

MsgJp:
しかし、レスタニアの人々は今――
自分たちは無力ではないことを感じ始めていた
MsgEn:
However, the people of Lestania now... were
beginning to feel that they were not powerless.

MsgJp: さて、あれからの侵食魔と島の状況だが――
MsgEn:
Now, regarding the situation of the Infected and
the island...

MsgJp:
その時々で対処しているとはいえ
侵食魔どもが押し寄せる動きは相変わらずだ
MsgEn:
Although we are dealing with them accordingly
each time, the movements of the encroaching demons
remain unchanged.

MsgJp:
加えて、セシリーを狙う黒騎士――
島の調査もまだまだこれから
MsgEn:
Moreover, with the black knight targeting
Cecily—there's still a lot of investigation left
to do on the island.

MsgJp:
セシリーか、せめてレオのところの
ロイグの記憶が少しでも戻れば――
MsgEn:
If only some of Loeg's memories could return,
even if it's just about Cecily or Leo...

MsgJp:
隊長、急いで島へ！
ガルドリンが死んじゃいます！
MsgEn:
Captain, hurry to the island!
Gurdolin is about to die!

MsgJp:
魔赤島の調査で
見たこともない魔物が――
MsgEn:
During the investigation of Bloodbane Isle,
we encountered enemies that we have never seen
before.

MsgJp:
そいつが強すぎて――
出直そうとしたら退路を断たれて
MsgEn:
They're too strong—when I tried to retreat, my
escape route was cut off.

MsgJp: 俺を逃がすためにあの人――

エリオット、もういい
傷の手当てをしなさい
MsgEn:
Elliot, that's enough.
Please get your wounds tended to.

MsgJp: 島へ渡ってくれ――ガルドリンを頼む
MsgEn:
Please, make your way to the island— I'm counting
on you, Gurdolin.

MsgJp:
隊長さん――白竜様、ジョゼフ様、皆様――
お話があります
MsgEn:
Captain... Lord White Dragon, Master Joseph,
everyone... I have something to discuss.

MsgJp:
ロイグとわたしの記憶を突き合わせたのですが
新しいことは何も思い出せませんでした
MsgEn:
After comparing Loeg's and my memories, I
couldn't recall anything new.

MsgJp:
ただ、ロイグはあの島の光――
光源を間近で見たそうです
MsgEn:
However, Loeg saw the light of that island up
close.

MsgJp: みなさん、一緒に島へ渡りませんか？
MsgEn:
Everyone, why don't you come across to the island
with us?

MsgJp:
俺が黒騎士ならあそこで待ち伏せる
敵の思うつぼだろうよ
MsgEn:
If I were the Black Knight, I'd ambush them over
there.
That's what the enemy wants.

MsgJp: 今のままじゃ勝てないよね
MsgEn: We can't win as we are now, can we?

MsgJp:
何か新しい――武器とか魔法とか作戦とかが
必要じゃない？
MsgEn:
Do we need something new - like weapons, magic,
or tactics?

MsgJp: もしもの時は、わたしを置いて逃げてください
MsgEn:
If something happens, please leave me behind and
escape.

MsgJp:
わたしを手に入れるか――あるいは亡き者にすれば
黒騎士はこの地を去るに違いありません
MsgEn:
If you capture me—or if you kill me—the black
knight will surely leave this land.

MsgJp: 逃げる！？　君を置いて！？

逃げる、逃げねえで揉めてる間に
全滅――ああ、目に浮かぶぜ
MsgEn:
Running away, arguing instead of fleeing—total
annihilation while we're at odds. Ah, I can see it
now.

MsgJp: あの島は我が加護の外――
MsgEn: That island is beyond my protection――

MsgJp: 精霊竜の覚者セシリーよ――
MsgEn: Cecily, the Arisen of the Spirit Dragon――

MsgJp:
おまえが継承を受けた竜力はごくわずか――
フィンダムの習わしか？
MsgEn:
The Dragon Force you have inherited is only a
small amount...
Is it a tradition of Phindym?

MsgJp: 継承の最中に黒騎士が現れました
MsgEn:
The Black Knight appeared during the inheritance
process.

MsgJp:
そこで精霊竜は、大地の一部と一緒に
転移させることで――
MsgEn:
There, the Spirit Dragon, along with a portion of
the land, would be transposed...

MsgJp: わたしを、襲いかかる黒騎士から守ったのです
MsgEn:
They defended me against the attacking black
knight.

MsgJp:
わたしは巻きこまれただけらしい
特別な理由があるのではないかと期待したが
MsgEn:
It appears I was just drawn into it. I hoped
there might be some special reason.
In the end... there was nothing.

MsgJp:
自分と同じ境遇の人がいてくれて
どれほど心強かったか――
MsgEn:
Having someone in the same situation as me was
such a source of strength...
Did you figure out how to get home?

MsgJp:
フィンダムへの道を切り開く力なら
すでに精霊竜から授かっています
MsgEn:
If it's the power to carve a path to Phindym you need,
I have already received it from the Spirit Dragon.

MsgJp:
でも、黒騎士を倒さねば、どこにいても同じ
――何度でも同じことが起こるでしょう
MsgEn:
However, if we do not defeat the Black Knight,
the same thing will happen no matter where we are,
over and over again.

MsgJp:
白竜様が、帰還をお許しにならなかったのは
そのことにお気づきだったからですね？
MsgEn:
The White Dragon didn't permit your return
because they were aware of that, correct?
So, what exactly is the Black Knight?

MsgJp:
ズールが黒騎士のポーンなら
黒騎士はどっかの竜の覚者ってことだろうよ
MsgEn:
If Zuhl is the Black Knight's Pawn, then the
Black Knight must be an Arisen of some dragon.

MsgJp:
あの甲冑の下にどんな素顔があるのか――
わたしにもわかりません
MsgEn:
What kind of face is there under that armor --
-- I don't know what it is.

MsgJp:
正体なんて、後まわしでいい
とにかく黒騎士を倒さねえと、先が見えねえ
MsgEn:
We can postpone uncovering their identity for now.
The main thing is to defeat the black knight, or
we won't see what lies ahead.

MsgJp: 二竜の覚者が共闘するこの戦いは――
MsgEn:
A battle where two Arisen of different dragons
join forces...

MsgJp: 両大陸への侵略者たる黒騎士との決戦
MsgEn:
The decisive battle against the Black Knight, the
invader of both continents.

MsgJp:
その命運を握るのは、おまえたちだ
――心して、頼むぞ
MsgEn:
The destiny is within your hands.
― I ask you sincerely, proceed with caution.

MsgJp: そうか――レオが黒騎士を――
GmdPath: Leo and the Black Knight have...

MsgJp:
神殿を離れ、新たな力を求めたのは
レスタニアの未来を見据えてのことだった――
MsgEn:
...And Leo left the temple seeking new power,
looking towards the future of Lestania.
If that's the case ――If that's the case, then...

MsgJp:
――時に、セシリーはどうした
島の、歪んだ空間はどうなったのだ
MsgEn:
―― What happened to Cecily in the meantime?
And what about the distorted space on the island?

MsgJp: あれは今、"ゲート"と呼ばれている

その"ゲート"を通り、忌々しい侵食魔どもが
相も変わらず飛んでくる
MsgEn:
Through that Gate, the detestable Infected
creatures continue to fly in without fail.

MsgJp: 黒騎士は倒したのだろう？
直接の関係はなかったのかもしれん

MsgEn: Hmmm... I don't know what to do.

MsgJp:
今しがた島のゲートが開通したと
使者が伝えてきた
MsgEn:
Just now, a messenger came and informed us that
the island's Gate has opened.

MsgJp:
懸念されたセシリーの消耗は、さほどではない
とのことだ
MsgEn:
It seems that Cecily's exhaustion is not as
severe as feared.

MsgJp: だが、ゲートが安定し続ける保証はない
MsgEn:
However, there is no guarantee that the gate will
remain stable.

MsgJp:
セシリーはすぐにでもフィンダムへ、渡りたいと
主張しているらしいが
MsgEn:
Cecily seems to be insisting on crossing over to
Phindym as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
向こうで万が一のことが起これば
我々への影響は計り知れない
MsgEn:
If anything were to happen over there, the impact
on us would be immeasurable.

MsgJp:
セシリーたちとフィンダムへ渡り、護衛し
状況の把握――実地の調査を行う者が必要だ
MsgEn:
We need someone to cross over with Cecily and the
others to Phindym, provide protection, and gather
information through on-site investigation.

MsgJp: もちろん、おまえ以上の適任はいない
MsgEn:
Of course, there is no one better qualified than
you.

MsgJp:
すでに第一次調査隊――おまえの部下たちは
ゲートの前で待っている
MsgEn:
Your subordinates from the first survey team are
already waiting in front of the Gate.

MsgJp:
幾多の危機を乗り越えたレスタニア育ちの目で
状況を見極めてくれ
MsgEn:
With the eyes of a Lestania-raised individual who
has overcome countless crises, please assess the
situation.

MsgJp:
ここ連日、探索から戻らぬ隊員が
増えているとのことだ
MsgEn:
Every day now, more and more members of the squad
are not returning from the search.

MsgJp:
どうも嫌な予感がしてたまらん
老人の思い過ごしであればいいのだが
MsgEn:
I can't shake this dreadful feeling. I hope it's
just an old man's imagination.

MsgJp:
ともかく事の真相を確かめるために
調査に協力して欲しい
MsgEn:
Anyway, to get to the bottom of this, I need your
help with an investigation.

MsgJp:
段取りについての詳細は神殿にいる
情報に長けた覚者、アイザックを尋ねてくれ
MsgEn:
For detailed information about the arrangements,
please consult Isaac, a knowledgeable Arisen who
resides in the Temple.

MsgJp: ヴァネッサから、かような報告が来ようとは――
MsgEn: To receive such a report from Vanessa—

MsgJp:
禊の神殿深くに封じられていたかの場所は
既に永き眠りから目覚めている
MsgEn:
The location that was sealed deep within the
Purification Temple has already stirred from its
long slumber.

MsgJp:
そして今、混沌とした竜力を再び呼び込まんと
動きだした
MsgEn:
And now, they have begun to move to summon the
chaotic dragon force once more.

MsgJp:
あれを地上に出してはならぬ
かの場所に押しとどめよ
MsgEn:
It must not be released onto the surface. Keep it
contained in there.

MsgJp:
ふむ、神殿にいるアイザックを訪れ
すぐさま準備にとりかかってくれ
MsgEn:
Very well, visit Isaac at the temple and start
making preparations right away.

MsgJp: いましがた使いの者から連絡がきた
MsgEn: I received word from the messenger just now.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの各族長の結託により
"精霊の地"の封印が解かれたようだ
MsgEn:
The unification of the chieftains in Phindym
seems to have led to the release of the seal on
the "Spirit Land".

MsgJp:
もちろん、芯なる樹の奥深くにある
汚染原因を絶つのがその目的だ
MsgEn:
Of course, the purpose is to cut off the cause of
pollution deep within the core of the sacred tree.

MsgJp:
さあ、行きなさい
セシリーが待っているだろう
MsgEn:
Now go.
Cecily will be waiting for you.

MsgJp: 最後まで、強き意志を持って戦うんだ
MsgEn:
Maintain a strong resolve and fight until the
very end.

MsgJp: ふむ――これでは「覚者に理を説く」だな
MsgEn:
I see—this is what it means to "try to reason
with the enlightened."
Like talking to a brick wall...

MsgJp:
どうしました？
何か俺たちに頼みたげな顔ですが
MsgEn:
What's wrong?
You look like you want to ask us something.

MsgJp:
ああ、各地の村々から盗賊の被害を訴える声が
増えてな――
MsgEn:
Yes, more and more villages around the land are
complaining of banditry.

MsgJp: 盗賊を探し出し、村人の財産を取り戻さねばならん
MsgEn:
We must find the bandits and recover the
villagers' property.

MsgJp:
おまえたちを送るほどのことではないと
思っていたが、頼らせてもらうとしよう
MsgEn:
I didn't think it was something worthy of sending
all of you off, but I'll allow myself to rely on
you.

MsgJp: もうエリオット、余計な仕事を！

いいよ、リズは休んでいて
隊長と、隊長の右腕の俺で片付けるから
MsgEn:
Sure, Lise. Take a rest.
The captain and I, his right-hand man, will take
care of it.

MsgJp:
今、聞き捨てならないこと、言ったよね
隊長の右腕がどうのこうの――
MsgEn:
Now, you just said something that can't be
ignored, right?
About the captain's right-hand man...

MsgJp:
まあまあ！
言い争うなら、ほれ、大階段の下でな
MsgEn:
Well, well! If you want to argue, then come on,
under the grand staircase.

MsgJp:
わたしの望みは、村人が安心して
眠れること――ただ、それだけだ
MsgEn:
My wish is for the villagers to be able to sleep
peacefully—that's all.

MsgJp: 被害にあった村からは感謝の言葉が――
MsgEn:
We received words of gratitude from the affected
village...

MsgJp:
それで？
一番手柄はエリオットだって聞いたけど
MsgEn:
And?
--I heard that Elliot was the one who did the
most impressive job.

MsgJp: .ふん、手柄なんざ欲しい奴にくれてやる
MsgEn:
Hmph, I'll leave the credit to someone who wants
it.

MsgJp: 素直に認めてくださいよ
MsgEn: Just be honest and admit it.

MsgJp: 日々の努力が実を結んだということです
MsgEn: It means that our daily efforts have paid off.

MsgJp:
これで俺が隊長の右腕ですね！
ですよね！
MsgEn:
With this, I am the Captain's right hand, right?
Right!

MsgJp: 神殿のみんなにも教えてあげなくちゃ
MsgEn: I have to tell everyone at the temple too.

MsgJp: エリオットの野郎、浮かれ過ぎじゃねえか
MsgEn:
You bastard Elliot, aren't you getting too
carried away?

MsgJp: ちょっと今回いいカンジだからって――
MsgEn: Just because things seem good this time—

MsgJp:
まあまあ――
許してやってくれ

あの子は幼い頃に家族を失い、わしが引き取って
育てたのだが、わしはこの通り多忙だ
MsgEn:
That child lost their family at a young age, and
I took them in and raised them.
But as you can see, I am very busy.

MsgJp:
教育だけは完璧に叩き込んだものの
 寂しい思いをさせることも多かったようだ
MsgEn:
Although I drilled them perfectly in education,
it seems I caused them much loneliness.

MsgJp:
だから、誰かに認められることが
うれしくてたまらないのだろう
MsgEn:
That's why being acknowledged by someone makes
them incredibly happy.

MsgJp:
そんな重そうなもん
抱えているようには見えなかったが――
MsgEn:
Although it didn't look like they were carrying
such a heavy burden...

MsgJp:
普段は気取られないよう自分を作っているところが
あるのだろう
MsgEn:
They probably have a side to them that they
carefully craft to avoid coming off as pompous.

MsgJp:
へぇ～、何よ
ちょっとはかわいいとこあるんじゃない
MsgEn:
Oh, really? What's that about?
Don't you have a cute side to you?

MsgJp: おいおい、上から目線かよ
MsgEn: Hey, hey, don't look down on me like that.

MsgJp: フィンダムの民が薬を作るという話だろう？
MsgEn: Is it about the people of Phindym making medicine?

MsgJp: わたしの考えはこうだ
フィンダムの問題はほぼ解決した
MsgEn: The problem in Phindym has been mostly resolved.

MsgJp:
精霊竜セシリーが目覚めて
竜が復活すれば何も問題はない
MsgEn:
Should the Spirit Dragon Cecily awaken and the
dragon be revived, there would be no problem at
all.

MsgJp:
となれば、これ以上、我々が干渉する必要は
どこにある？
MsgEn:
If that's the case, where's the need for us to
intervene any further?

MsgJp: 聞き捨てなりませんよジョゼフ様
MsgEn: We can't turn a blind eye to it, Master Joseph.

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様もご存知でしょう？
フィンダムは変わろうとしている
MsgEn:
Master Joseph, you must also be aware, right?
Phindym is about to change.

MsgJp:
ちょっとやそっとの病気にかかっても
もう生きることをあきらめたりしない――
MsgEn:
Even if you get a little bit sick,
you don't give up on life anymore--you just keep
on living.

MsgJp:
これは大いなる意識の変革です
手を貸してあげなくては！
MsgEn:
This is a monumental shift in awareness. We must
offer our help!

MsgJp: 急かすと、ろくなことにならん
MsgEn: If we rush, nothing good will come of it.

MsgJp: 正しい指導があれば大丈夫ですよ
MsgEn: With proper guidance, everything will be fine.

MsgJp:
ふん――
フィンダムに骨を埋めるんじゃなかったのか？
MsgEn:
Hmph... I thought I was going to put down my
roots in Phindym.

MsgJp: そんな言い方、やめてください

MsgEn: That's true, people can be unpredictable.

MsgJp:
それはともかく、薬の精製は
順調に進んでいます
MsgEn:
Anyway, the medicine refinement is progressing
smoothly.

MsgJp:
何の心配もいりませんから
それと――
MsgEn: You don't need to worry about anything, and...

MsgJp:
フィンダムの植物とレスタニアの知恵が
生んだかつてない滋養薬です
MsgEn:
A nourishing elixir like no other, born from the
plants of Phindym and the wisdom of Lestania.

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様には、まだまだ元気で
僕たちを指導してほしいですからね
MsgEn:
We still want Joseph, full of energy, to continue
guiding us.

MsgJp: わしで実験するつもりか！
MsgEn: You plan to experiment on me, don't you!
Huh!? Is that how it's going to be?

MsgJp: 素直じゃないねえ、ジョゼフ様
MsgEn: You're not very straightforward, Master Joseph.

MsgJp: でも、元気になったんじゃない？
あんなに優れなかったのに不思議ですね
MsgEn:
It's strange, considering you weren't that great
before.

MsgJp: ジョゼフの一番の薬はクラウスだったのね
MsgEn: Joseph's best medicine was Klaus, huh?

MsgJp: うわっ！！（リアクションボイス）

MsgEn: Look, the eye of a monster!

MsgJp: 精霊竜を討った覚者はおまえか
MsgEn: The Arisen who slayed the Spirit Dragon...

MsgJp: アハァ！？　死にゆく竜に、告げる名などない
MsgEn: Aha!? To a dying dragon, I have no name to give.

MsgJp: ヴァ――（炎を受けるリアクション）
MsgEn: Bah— (Reaction to being engulfed in flames)
Put out the fire! Extinguish the flames!

MsgJp: いきなり出てきて何しやがる！
MsgEn: Who the hell do you think you are!?

MsgJp: ゲヒャアハハハハハ（不敵な笑い）
世の末に招待してやろう――
MsgEn: I shall invite you to the end of the world...

MsgJp: エリオット、リズ！　続け！
うおっ！！（リアクションボイス）
きゃっ！！（リアクションボイス）

行方不明だったネド王子が戻られて
メイロワ将軍もさぞお喜びだろう
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo, who was missing, has returned.
General Meirova will surely be overjoyed.

MsgJp:
おまけに覚者であったとなれば――
ああ、まさに希望そのものだ
MsgEn:
Moreover, if he is also the Arisen— Ah, it's like
hope itself.

MsgJp:
白竜、そして白竜に仕える我々も祝福していると
伝えてくれ
MsgEn:
Tell them that the White Dragon and we, who serve
the White Dragon, are also offering our blessings.

MsgJp:
しかし、こうなってくると、気になるのは
悪しき竜の思惑
MsgEn:
However, when it comes to this, what worries me
is the Evil Dragon's intentions.

MsgJp:
おまえたちをアッカーシェランに放り出したのは
ネド王子をオークどもから救い出すためか？
MsgEn:
Did they send you to Acre Selund to rescue Prince
Nedo from the orcs?

MsgJp: いやいや、そんなことはなかろう――

王子の登場で解放軍は勢い付くはずだ
悪しき竜との戦いも新たな局面を迎えるだろう
MsgEn:
The appearance of the prince should boost the
Liberation Army's morale, and the battle against
the Evil Dragon will enter a new phase.

MsgJp:
おまえたちは状況の中心と最先端を行き来して
出来事の内に外に、目を凝らし、耳をそばだてるのだ
MsgEn:
You'll be at the center of events, going back and
forth within the situation, keeping a close eye
and an open ear, right?

MsgJp: いいな？　さあ、行きなさい

展望城を奪回したアッカーシェラン解放軍の
次の目的は、王都メガドの奪回になろう
MsgEn:
The next objective of the Acre Selund Liberation
Army, which has recaptured Lookout Castle, should
be the recapture of the Royal Capital, Megado.

MsgJp:
一方、大きな拠点を失った悪しき竜とオークどもは
反撃の体制を整え、機会を伺っているはずだ
MsgEn:
On the other hand, The Evil Dragon and the orcs,
who have lost a major base, are regrouping and
waiting for their opportunity.

MsgJp:
激突が予想されるが
解放軍には勢いがあるはず
MsgEn:
A clash is anticipated, but the Liberation Army
has the momentum.

MsgJp:
時を待たず、一気呵成に竜のところまで
攻め込んでくれと思わずにはいられん
MsgEn:
Without waiting, we can't help but push forward
to the dragon's lair all in one go.

MsgJp: っぐ！（リアクションボイス）
ッがああああーー！！（掛け声）
がふッ！（リアクションボイス）
ぐぉぉぉぉ！（リアクションボイス）
竜力が――吸い取られている！？
MsgEn: Is the dragon power being absorbed!?

MsgJp: はーーーっ！（リアクションボイス）
ぐォォォォオ！（苦痛の呻き）

見てる場合じゃねえ！
止めるぞ！
MsgEn:
Stop gawking!
I'm going to put a stop to this!

MsgJp: ふんっ！（リアクションボイス）
うおっ――（リアクションボイス）
きゃっ――（リアクションボイス）
わっ――（リアクションボイス）
くそっ！　このままじゃ――
MsgEn: Damn! It can't go on like this—

MsgJp: ぐぐっ（リアクションボイス）
あなたが屈してはなりません
んっ――（リアクションボイス）
んっ――（リアクションボイス）
んっ――（リアクションボイス）
ぬう――（リアクションボイス）
悲しむ者など微塵も残さぬ――
MsgEn: Not a trace of sorrow will remain—

MsgJp:
ねえ、白竜様が遠いよ？
どんどん離れて行く感じ
MsgEn:
Hey, isn't the White Dragon getting farther away?
It feels like it's moving further and further.

MsgJp: すでに騎士団がブラッドオーブ探しに出発した
MsgEn:
The knights have already set out to search for
Blood Orbs.

MsgJp:
レスタニア中に協力を呼びかける
手はずになっている
MsgEn:
Arrangements have been made to seek cooperation
throughout Lestania.

MsgJp:
ブラッドオーブね――
こんな状態でも効くのか
MsgEn:
Blood Orbs, huh? Do they work even in this
condition?

MsgJp: 他にどんな方法があるというのだ
やっぱり心許ないですね
MsgEn: I'm still not comfortable with this.

MsgJp:
ミシアルよ、いるのだろう？
我々を見守っているのだろう？
MsgEn: Mysial, are you there? Are you watching over us?

MsgJp: 何か伝えたいことはないのか？
MsgEn: Is there anything you want to tell us?

MsgJp:
フィンダムの件で奔走している時
擬竜と戦って、竜力を手に入れましたよね
MsgEn:
When you were busy with the Phindym matter, you
fought the Pseudo-Dragon and gained Dragon Force,
right?

MsgJp: セシリーを助けた時だよね？
同じやり方で白竜を助けるってか？
MsgEn:
Is it possible to save the White Dragon the same
way?

MsgJp: ふん、賭けてみる価値はありそうだ
MsgEn: Hmph, it seems worth a try.

MsgJp: おお、確かにそれはにっくき黒騎士の剣！
MsgEn: Oh, it's indeed the accursed Black Knight's sword!
Offer the sword to the White Dragon!

MsgJp: んっ――（リアクションボイス）
レスタニアの民たちよ――

再び翼を広げられるのは
すべておまえたちのおかげだ――
MsgEn:
The fact that the dragon can spread its wings
once more is all thanks to all of you—

MsgJp:
おまえたちの知恵、勇気を賞讃しよう
そして――感謝しよう
MsgEn:
Let us praise your wisdom and courage, and—show
our gratitude.

MsgJp:
竜は竜のみで生きるにあらず
よくわかった
MsgEn:
Dragons do not live by dragons alone. I
understand that now.
You're being too dramatic, Lord White Dragon.

MsgJp: こら！　なんと無礼なことを！
MsgEn: Hey! What an impolite thing to say!

MsgJp: セシリーの竜力が消えていく――
MsgEn: Cecily's Dragon Force is fading away --

MsgJp: 私たちはやっぱり白竜の覚者なんだね
MsgEn: We really are the Arisen of the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
――白竜はもう大丈夫
やっとそう信じることができるようになった
MsgEn:
The White Dragon is finally okay. I can believe
it now.

MsgJp: 竜無き世を想像した時の恐怖と言ったら――
MsgEn: The fear of imagining a world without dragons—

MsgJp: いや、やめておこう、もう済んだことだ
MsgEn: No, let's stop there. It's all in the past.

MsgJp:
さて、リズが回復の報告と礼にとアッカーシェランへ
行ったのだがすぐに帰ってきてな――
MsgEn:
Now, Lise went to Acre Selund to report on the
recovery and to offer thanks, but she returned
immediately—

MsgJp:
ネド王子のことで相談があるから
隊長もすぐに来るように伝えてくれと――
MsgEn:
There's a discussion about Prince Nedo, so please
inform the Captain to come immediately—

MsgJp:
ガルドリンとエリオットもすでに向こうだ
おまえも早く行ってくれ
MsgEn:
Gurdolin and Elliot are already there. You should
go soon too.

MsgJp: わたしは、おまえたち覚者と人間が絆を結び
MsgEn:
I, along with you Arisen and humans, have formed
a bond.

MsgJp:
力を合わせて困難を乗り越えたことについて
考えていた
MsgEn:
I was thinking about how the Arisen and humans
have formed a bond and overcome difficulties
together.

MsgJp:
万策尽きたと思われた中、わたしを消滅の淵から
救い出したのは他ならぬおまえたちだ
MsgEn:
When all seemed lost, it was you who rescued me
from the brink of extinction.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の、強者の思い上がりに
一矢を報いたのもおまえたち――
MsgEn:
You also retaliated against the arrogance of The
Evil Dragon—

MsgJp:
おまえたち人間の絆が世界を救ってきたのだ
ああ、わたしではない
MsgEn:
The bonds among you humans have saved the world,
not me.

MsgJp:
はて、人々が集い、危機に立ち向かおうとする時
その中心にいたのは誰だ？
MsgEn:
Well, when people gather and face a crisis, who
was at the center?

MsgJp:
人々の先頭に立ち、背中で人々を鼓舞したのは
誰だっただろう――
MsgEn:
Who stood at the forefront, inspiring people with
their back—

MsgJp: わたしは竜力でその後押しをしているにすぎない
MsgEn: I'm just providing support with my Dragon Force.

MsgJp:
ならば、その竜力もおまえに譲れば
このレスタニアは盤石ではないのか――
MsgEn:
Then, if you were to bestow that Dragon Force
upon yourself, wouldn't Lestania be more secure?

MsgJp:
こう考えることは、間違っているだろうか――
理は許すだろうか
MsgEn:
Is it wrong to think this way? Will Order allow
it—

MsgJp:
わからぬことは、知りたいと思うのが
おまえたちだろう？
MsgEn:
What you don't know is what you want to find out,
right?

MsgJp: 倣い、試してみようではないか
MsgEn: Let's try it, then, shall we?

MsgJp: おまえを我が後継者に指名する
MsgEn: I hereby appoint you as my successor.

MsgJp:
たまげたぜ――
次代の白竜はおまえだとよ！
MsgEn: I'm amazed— You're the next White Dragon!

MsgJp: 隊長、すごい！　隊長なら、みんな納得だよ
MsgEn:
Captain, amazing! If it's the captain, everyone's
on board.

MsgJp: 俺――隊長、俺、感激しています

時が満ちるまで、人としての時を――
心ゆくまで過ごすがよい
MsgEn:
Until the time is right, live as a human— Enjoy
it to the fullest.

MsgJp: 今、大陸がひとつ、レオによって滅ぼされたようだ
MsgEn:
Now, it seems the continent has been destroyed by
Leo.

MsgJp: レオの真意は分からぬ
MsgEn: We don't understand Leo's true intentions.

MsgJp: フィンダムに大きな黒い渦が出現しました！
MsgEn: A large black vortex has appeared in Phindym!

MsgJp:
渦のまわりには魔物が集まるらしく
向こうは危機的な状況らしいです！
MsgEn:
It seems that monsters are gathering around the
vortex, and the situation over there is critical!

MsgJp: 黒竜め――ついに動き出したか
MsgEn: The Black Dragon—has finally begun to move.

MsgJp:
黒竜と黒騎士は世界を滅ぼす地固めを
終えたようだ
MsgEn:
The Black Dragon and the Black Knight seem to
have completed their preparations to destroy the
world.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランへの攻撃を時間稼ぎと言い放った
悪しき竜の真意が気になっていたが――
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon's true intentions have been a
concern since they mentioned the attack on Acre
Selund as a diversion, but—

MsgJp: 計画通りに事が進んだその結果がこれか
MsgEn:
Is this the result of everything going according
to plan?

MsgJp: 隊長！　待ってよ！　わたしもいくー！
俺が一番ですよ！　お役に立ちます！
MsgEn: I'm the most qualified! I can be of help!

MsgJp:
あ？　めんどくせ
また、どこかの魔物退治だろ？
MsgEn:
Huh? How bothersome. Is it another monster
extermination somewhere?

MsgJp: ガルドリンは留守番していればいいよ
MsgEn: Gurdolin, you can stay and guard.

MsgJp: 覚者の使命をなんだと思っておるのか
MsgEn: What do you think the mission of the Arisen is?

MsgJp: そんなの、決まっているだろう――
MsgEn: It's bound to be like that, isn't it?

MsgJp: 覚者とは、竜の敵と戦う者！
MsgEn:
The Arisen, they're those who fight against the
enemy of the dragons!

MsgJp: 覚者とは、竜の敵と戦う者！
MsgEn:
The Arisen, they're those who fight against the
enemy of the dragons!

MsgJp: 覚者とは、竜の敵と戦う者！
MsgEn:
The Arisen, they're those who fight against the
enemy of the dragons!

MsgJp:
覚者よ、おまえは感じているか？
暗黒の大陸で脈打つ黒き怨讐を――
MsgEn:
Arisen, can you feel it? The black resentment
pulsing in the dark continent—

MsgJp:
一度は滅した黒竜が、暗黒の力を蓄え
いま一度、大陸全土を闇に呑まんとしている
MsgEn:
The Black Dragon, once defeated, has been
gathering dark power and is now trying to engulf
the entire continent in darkness once again.

MsgJp:
放っておけば、世界は再び終焉へと向かうだろう
黒竜にとっても恐らくこれが最後の抵抗
MsgEn:
If left unchecked, the world will head towards
its end once more. This is probably the Black
Dragon's final resistance as well.

MsgJp:
頼れるのはおまえたち覚者の存在だけだ
勝ち得た未来が消えぬよう、この事態に臨んでくれ
MsgEn:
The only ones we can rely on are the existence of
you, the Arisen.
Please face this situation to ensure that the
future we have attained does not vanish.

MsgJp: ずっとうなされてるんです
真っ黒の鎧を着た、背の高い――
MsgEn: A tall knight dressed entirely in black—

MsgJp:
黒が好きな騎士なら何人かいるけど
とりあえず、この部屋にはいないよ？
MsgEn:
There are a few knights who like black, but for
now, there's none in this room, right?

MsgJp: ただの騎士ではありません

――だろうね
とにかく、落ち着いてよ

君のことは何も知らないけど
少なくとも俺たちは敵じゃない
MsgEn:
I don't know anything about you, but at least
we're not enemies.

MsgJp:
ごめんなさい――
失礼しました
わたしはセシリーといいます

――ここはどこでしょうか
いいえ、わたしはどこにいましたか？
MsgEn: —Where is this place? No, where was I?

MsgJp:
戻らねばなりません
その場所へ連れて行ってください
MsgEn:
I need to go back to that place. Please take me
there.

MsgJp:
ロイグの故郷のフィンダムには
医者がいないんだって
MsgEn:
In Loeg's homeland of Phindym, they don't have
any doctors.

MsgJp:
病気が治る、治らないは運命――
そう言うんだよ？
MsgEn:
Whether the disease is cured or not is fate—
that's what they say, right?

MsgJp: だから、病気は絶対に治して――
MsgEn: So, the disease must be cured, no matter what—

MsgJp:
そんな馬鹿な運命論は捨てるべきだって
教えてあげなくちゃ
MsgEn:
You should throw away such foolish determinism,
I'll have to teach you that.

MsgJp: で、ロイグの病気は赤色症らしいんだ

古い病気で、今は罹る人がいない
つまり治療法も忘れられてしまった――
MsgEn:
It's an old disease, and currently, no one gets
it. That means the treatment has been forgotten—

MsgJp: というわけで、古い病気の知識が必要なの
MsgEn: So, they need knowledge about an old disease.

MsgJp:
ポーン郷のカミュって人が詳しいらしいけど――
隊長、行ってくる？
MsgEn:
There's this person named Camus in Pawn Cathedral
who knows a lot— Captain, will you go?

MsgJp: カミュからの伝言が届いたよ
MsgEn: I received a message from Camus.

MsgJp:
薬、意外と早くできそうだから
でき次第持ってきてくれるって
MsgEn:
The medicine can be made faster than expected,
so they'll bring it as soon as it's ready.

MsgJp: これでロイグは大丈夫！

ありがとう――
みんながわたしのために奔走してくれて――
MsgEn:
Thank you...
Everyone has been working so hard for me...

MsgJp: たとえ病気が治らなくても、この恩は一生忘れない
MsgEn:
Even if the disease can't be cured,
I'll never forget this kindness.

MsgJp:
病人を放っておくような冷たい人は
ここにはひとりだっていないんだから
MsgEn:
In a place like this, no one is so coldhearted
as to leave the sick by themselves.

MsgJp: 族長か王にでもなった気分だよ
MsgEn: It feels like I've become a chief or king.

MsgJp:
この白竜の大陸では
誰でも病気を治して貰えるのかい？
MsgEn:
Can anyone get their illness cured
in this White Dragon's continent?

MsgJp:
病気が平等なら治療も平等
生きたい気持ちはみんな同じでしょ
MsgEn:
If diseases are equal, so shall treatment be.
Everyone has the same desire to live, right?

MsgJp:
いいところだ
ここはとても、いいところだ――
MsgEn:
How great...
This place, it's really nice...
How shall I go about it?

MsgJp:
ありがとうございます
また、助けていただきましたね
MsgEn: Thank you. You've helped me again.

MsgJp:
力がみなぎっています
これは――
MsgEn: I'm brimming with power. This is...

MsgJp:
わたしは――思い出しました
おそらく、すべて
MsgEn:
I... I remember.
I probably remember everything.

MsgJp:
わたしはフィンダム大陸の覚者――
精霊竜ウィルミアの覚者、セシリーです
MsgEn:
I am Cecily, the Arisen of the Spirit Dragon,
Willmia, on the Phindym continent.

MsgJp:
昨日、鳥かごを掃除している時に
ヒルティが飛んで行ってしまったの
MsgEn:
Yesterday, when I was cleaning the birdcage,
Hilty flew away.

MsgJp:
いつもはわたしの肩でおとなしく
しているのに昨日に限って――
MsgEn:
He usually stays quietly on my shoulder,
but just yesterday...

MsgJp:
パメラとあちこちを探したけど
全然見つからなくて――
MsgEn:
I searched everywhere with Pamela,
but I couldn't find him at all...

MsgJp:
夜通し、眠らずに待っていたのね
そしたら、今朝になって帰ってきたんだ
MsgEn:
I waited all night without sleep,
and then he came back this morning.

MsgJp: ホッとしたんだけど、ほら、見て――

ヒルティ、いつもは静かな子なのに
ああして、しきりに鳴いているの
MsgEn:
Hilty, usually a quiet little guy,
is making a lot of noise like that.

MsgJp:
隊長、気づいた？
南の方角を向いて鳴いているでしょ？
MsgEn:
Captain, did you notice?
He's facing south and crying out, right?

MsgJp:
ちょうど、南の森で何かが起きている
という報告が入っているの
MsgEn:
We've just received reports of something
happening in the southern forest.

MsgJp: さあ――行ってみないとね
MsgEn: Well then, let's go check it out.

MsgJp: 覚者の力の源は竜力なんだ
MsgEn: The source of the Arisen's power is Dragon Force.

MsgJp:
だから、竜が力を失うと
覚者も力を失う
MsgEn:
So, if the dragons lose their power,
the Arisen will lose theirs as well.

MsgJp:
遅かれ早かれ、覚者全員に同じことが
起こるんだと思う
MsgEn:
Sooner or later, I have a feeling
the same thing will happen to all Arisen.

MsgJp: 隊長、エリオット、おまえらはどうだ？
俺は幸い、まだ大丈夫ですよ
MsgEn: Luck is on my side, I'm still fine.

MsgJp: そりゃ良かった、あとは頼むわ
MsgEn: That's good, so I'll leave the rest to you.
Ah, Leo sent you, didn't he?

MsgJp:
なるほどこれを砦に――ああ、助かるよ
礼を言っておいてくれ
MsgEn:
I see, in the fortress... Yes.
I appreciate it. Thank him for me.

MsgJp:
ところで、見ない顔だな
いや、このあいだの増援部隊に参加していただろう？
MsgEn:
By the way, you have an unfamiliar face.
Nay, you must have joined the reinforcements
the other day, right?

MsgJp:
――なるほど――そうか――
あれは面目なかった――
MsgEn:
Oh, I see... Ah...
That was shameful...

MsgJp: むろん、白竜の回復が進まずその結果――
MsgEn:
Naturally, as a result
of the White Dragon's slow recovery...

MsgJp:
大地の力は弱まり、オークどもの勢いが
増してきている
MsgEn:
The lands power is weakening,
and the momentum of the orcs is increasing.

MsgJp: とは言えこの状況、なんとか打開しなくては！
MsgEn:
But, even in this situation,
we must find a way to break through!

MsgJp:
そのためにはおまえのような活きのいい
覚者にこそ、力を存分に発揮してほしいのだ
MsgEn:
For that reason, I want willful Arisen like you
to make the most of your abilities.

MsgJp:
レオがおまえをよこしたのも
きっと、顔つなぎのつもりだろう
MsgEn:
Leo probably sent you here
as a mere pawn, I'm sure.

MsgJp:
早速だが、砦を出て川沿いに進んでくれ
橋の近くの洞窟に厄介な魔物が出現するのだ
MsgEn:
Hurry, leave the fortress
and proceed along the river.
There's a troublesome monster
that appears near the bridge in a cave.

MsgJp:
その魔物を、任せる
討伐して、あの一帯の安全を確保してくれ
MsgEn:
I'll leave that monster to you.
Defeat it and secure that area.

MsgJp: ヴァネッサ、この地図に心当たりはないかい？
MsgEn: Vanessa, does this map remind you of anything?

MsgJp: レオが残したものらしいんだ
MsgEn: It seems to be something left by Leo.

MsgJp: ほう――破れているようだが
そう、だからこの地図に関する手がかりが欲しい
MsgEn: Indeed. That's why this map may be our lead.

MsgJp: レオから何か聞いてないかな
MsgEn: Have you heard anything from Leo?

MsgJp:
何も――
ただ、レオのことだ
MsgEn:
Not a thing.
Just about Leo himself.

MsgJp:
解決すべき問題、やり残した任務――
そういうものの記録かもしれない
MsgEn:
Maybe it's records of unresolved issues,
unfinished missions.

MsgJp:
レオが愛用していた、名のある装備が
隠してあるとか？
MsgEn:
Is it hidden, the renowned equipment
that Leo used to favor?

MsgJp:
友の遺品を金に変える気か？
浅ましいぞ
MsgEn:
Are you trying to sell off
your friend's belongings for gold?
That's low.

MsgJp: 隊長、ひとつ頼まれてくれないか
MsgEn: Captain, can I ask this favor of you?

MsgJp:
レオがアジトとしていた場所に
手がかりがあるかも知れない
MsgEn:
There might be a clue at the place Leo used
as a hideout.

MsgJp:
と言っても、この状況では
信じてもらえないか――
MsgEn:
Even so, in this situation,
there's no way you'll believe me.

MsgJp:
まあ、じゅうぶんに怪しいだろうが
少なくとも、悪意はない
MsgEn:
Well, I'm suspicious enough.
At the very least, I harbor no ill will.

MsgJp: ただ、メイリーフを心配している
MsgEn: I have only concern for Mayleaf.

MsgJp:
あの子を神殿から
連れだしたのは
MsgEn: The one who took her from the temple...

MsgJp:
ほら、きみたちがアークと
呼んでいるアレ――
MsgEn: That thing you call the Ark...

MsgJp: あれは、きわめて危険なものでね
あの子を引き離しておきたかった
MsgEn: I wanted to keep that child away from it.

MsgJp:
いや、今のところは
それほど心配しなくていい
MsgEn: No, not at the moment. Don't worry so much.

MsgJp:
メイリーフが無事でいる限り
あれは無害だ
MsgEn:
As long as Mayleaf is kept safe,
what I've done is harmless.

MsgJp:
ゲルト様、ゲルト様
次はお歌を聞いてくださいな！
MsgEn:
Ser Gerd, Ser Gerd,
Next, please listen to this song!

MsgJp:
あの子の相手を頼む
頭がどうにかなりそうだ
MsgEn:
I'll let you deal with her.
My head is about to explode.

MsgJp: まさか、メイリーフ嬢はこいつに！？
MsgEn: No way, Miss Mayleaf is with this guy!?

MsgJp:
来てくれたんですね！？
ありがとうございます！
早くここから出ましょう

しかしメイリーフ嬢――
なぜ、こんな――
MsgEn:
But Miss Mayleaf...
Why, like this...

MsgJp:
森に呼ばれた気がして
ふらりと出たら、つい――
MsgEn:
I felt like the forest was calling me,
and I ventured out, but...

MsgJp: つい奥まで入ってしまって――
MsgEn: I wandered a bit too far...

MsgJp:
怖ろしいトロールのうなり声が
聞こえたんです――
MsgEn: I heard the terrifying roar of a troll, no less...

MsgJp:
びっくりして逃げているうちに
すっかり迷ってしまって
MsgEn:
I got scared and started running,
and I got completely lost.

MsgJp:
ふむ――
無事だったのは本当に幸運でしたな
MsgEn:
Hmph!
You were really lucky to come out unscathed.

MsgJp:
いいえ、ゲルト様と白騎団の皆様が
来てくださったからです
MsgEn:
No, ser. It's thanks to Ser Gerd
and the White Knights who've come to my aid.

MsgJp:
俺の砦によくきたな
目的は――これか？
MsgEn: So, you dare to come to my fort. Is it for this?

MsgJp:
ほう――願いが通じたようだ
迎えに来たぞ、優男
MsgEn:
Hmm, it seems the wish has been granted.
I've come to pick you up, young man.

MsgJp:
ははっ！　泣ける話だ――
が、命を差し出すほどの価値があるのか？
MsgEn:
Haha! It's a touching story...
But is it worth giving up your life for?

MsgJp: オークにはわかるまい

ふははは――知りたくもない
オークで良かった
MsgEn:
Hahaha! I don't want to know about it.
I'm glad I'm an orc.

MsgJp:
悪いがオークの大将よ
もう限界だ――鼻が曲がる
MsgEn:
Sorry, commander.
I've reached my limit—the stench is too much.

MsgJp: 俺達の神殿に招待する
MsgEn: We invite you to our temple.

MsgJp:
神殿の先輩たちには
気づかれていないよね？
MsgEn:
Your temple seniors haven't noticed you,
have they?

MsgJp:
あの人たちは
規則とか前例がないとか――
MsgEn:
Those people...
there are no rules or precedents...

MsgJp:
頭が固いからね
知られると面倒なことに――
MsgEn:
Because they are stubborn.
It would be troublesome if it became known...

MsgJp:
クラウス――
そう悪く言うものではない
MsgEn:
Klaus...
I don't mean to speak ill of them.
Captain Gerd of the White Knights!

MsgJp:
貴殿たちの護衛だ
ジョゼフ殿に頼まれてな
MsgEn: I'm your escort, at the request of Master Joseph.

MsgJp: こっちは、レオに頼まれてさ
MsgEn: I'm here because Leo asked me to.

MsgJp:
あはは――
やっぱりそうなるか
MsgEn: Haha— I knew it would be like this.

MsgJp:
アークの時みたいに
甘やかさないから
MsgEn:
Not like during the Ark...
I won't pamper them this time.

MsgJp: さあ、クラウス、どうするの？
MsgEn: Now, Klaus, what are you going to do?

MsgJp:
はいはい
それでは――
全員で《命の器》を探そう
MsgEn: Let's all look for the "Vessel of Life" together.

MsgJp:
壷か杯のような
かたちをしているはずだ
MsgEn: It should be shaped like a vase or a chalice.

MsgJp: 長く放置されたこの城は――

どちらかというと敵の支配下だ
手分けして《命の器》を見つけよう！
MsgEn:
Is more like under the enemy's control.
We need to divide and find the "Vessel of Life"!

MsgJp: あれだ！　あれが《命の器》！
MsgEn: There it is! That's the "Vessel of Life"!

MsgJp: オマイがアルケミーの継承者とな？
MsgEn: Are you going to become the inheritor of alchemy?

MsgJp: まず我ら騎士団に任せよ！
MsgEn: First, leave it to our knight order!

MsgJp:
この新手の敵の戦いぶり――
しかと検分されたし！
MsgEn:
We have thoroughly examined
this new enemy's fighting style!

MsgJp: ウオオオオオォォォォッッ！
そして新たなる敵への対策――
MsgEn: And prepare for the new enemy—
We need to hurry back to the temple.

MsgJp:
全隊、待機
これより生死の検分に入る！
MsgEn: All units, standby. We're about to check for signs of life!

MsgJp: 貴殿も一緒に来てくれ
いくら腕をあげようとも油断は命取りだ
MsgEn:
No matter how much you improve your skills,
complacency can be fatal.

MsgJp:
レオよ――久しいな
いったい、どこにいた
MsgEn:
Leo... It's been a while.
Where were you?

MsgJp: さあ――なんとも答えにくい質問だ
MsgEn: Well... That's a hard question to answer.

MsgJp: 放浪は、いまだ誰も知らない力を求めてのこと――
MsgEn:
Wandering in pursuit of a power
that no one yet knows...

MsgJp:
しかし、それは何かと問われても
まだ答えを知らない上に――
MsgEn:
But even if I were asked what it is,
I still do not know.

MsgJp:
目下、オレの興味は、フィンダムと呼ばれる
まだ見ぬ大陸にある
MsgEn:
Currently, my interest brings me to
a yet-unseen continent called Phindym.

MsgJp: てめえ、どうしてフィンダムを知っていやがる？
MsgEn: Why do you know about Phindym?

MsgJp:
友人から聞いた
フィンダムから来た、ロイグという男だ
MsgEn:
I heard from a friend about a man named Loeg
who came from Phindym.

MsgJp:
一緒に"飛ばされた"若い娘がいることは
ロイグから聞いている
MsgEn:
There's a young girl who was "sent"
together with him, right?

MsgJp: セシリー、ロイグって知ってる？
その、ロイグに会わせてください
今は無理だと答えておこう
MsgEn: For now, let's answer that it's impossible.

MsgJp:
わたしには果たすべき役割があるはずです
その人が、知っているかもしれません
MsgEn:
There should be a role for me to fulfill.
That person might know about it.

MsgJp:
記憶を取り戻すきっかけを
くれるかもしれません！
MsgEn:
They might give me the opportunity
to regain my memories!

MsgJp:
おまえの目には、ある種の輝きが宿っている
いや、熱で潤んでいるとでも言えばいいのか――
MsgEn:
Your eyes hold a certain kind of radiance,
or should I say they're filled with passion...

MsgJp:
かつて、ふたりの女の目に
同じ輝きを見たことがある
MsgEn:
I've seen the same radiance
in the eyes of two women.

MsgJp: ふたりとも、運命に殉じるかのように、死んでいった
MsgEn:
Both of them died...
As if they were sacrificed to fate.

MsgJp: わたしには関係のないことです！
MsgEn: This has nothing to do with me!

MsgJp:
頭を冷やして出直して来い――
今はそう言うしかない
MsgEn:
Calm down and come back later.
That's all I can say for now.

MsgJp: くそっ！　優男を死なせるな！
MsgEn: Damn it! Don't let him die!

MsgJp: 逃がすな！　　捕まえろ！
MsgEn: Don't let him escape! Catch him!

MsgJp:
もう、メイリーフは
――任せるよ
MsgEn:
Mayleaf's protection...
I'll leave it to you.

MsgJp:
あの器に入れて――
白竜に捧げて欲しい――
MsgEn:
Please put it in that vessel...
Dedicate it to the White Dragon...

MsgJp: 看取られて死ねるなんて――
MsgEn: Passing on with someone by your side...

MsgJp: 考えたこともなかった――
MsgEn: I had never even thought about it...

MsgJp: ハンッ、レオの後釜と目されているらしいな
MsgEn:
Hmph, it seems like I'm being considered
to become Leo's successor.

MsgJp: オークの狩場になんの用だ！
MsgEn: What are you doing on Orc hunting ground!?

MsgJp:
オークの狩場？
バカなこと言わないでよ、ここは――
MsgEn:
Orc hunting ground?
Don't say ridiculous things; this is...

MsgJp:
図に乗るな人間ども――
レスタニアはオークの大陸だ！
MsgEn:
Don't get carried away, you humans!
Lestania is the Orc's continent!

MsgJp:
仮に１００歩ゆずってそうだとしたら――
森をもっと大事にしなさいよ！
MsgEn:
Even if you were to give up 100 steps...
Take better care of the forest!

MsgJp:
おまえらのせいでおれたちオークは
ずいぶん痛手を負った
MsgEn:
Thanks to you people,
we orcs have taken quite a hit.

MsgJp:
かつての勢いを取り戻すには
多くの食料が必要だ
MsgEn:
To regain our former glory,
we need plenty of food.

MsgJp:
ハッハッハッハッハ
邪魔なおまえらも喰らってやるわ！
MsgEn:
Hahaha...
I'll gobble up you meddling folks too!

MsgJp: 隊長、コイツ話にならない！
MsgEn: Captain, this guy is impossible to reason with!

MsgJp: ガハッ――調子に乗りやがって！　人間どもめ！
MsgEn: Gahh, get on with it! You humans!

MsgJp: レスタニアがどちらのものか――
いずれ思い知らせてやるわ！
MsgEn: I'll make you realize it someday!

MsgJp:
動物たちがおびえていた原因は
オークだったのか！
MsgEn:
The reason the animals were frightened
was because of the Orcs!

MsgJp:
ありがとう、君たち
森の危機は去ったようだね
MsgEn:
Thank you, all of you.
It seems the crisis in the forest has passed.

MsgJp: ゲルト団長！？　メイリーフ！？
メイリーフがどうしてもと言って聞かないのでな

ヒルティを使って、オークたちのことを
知らせてくれたんだよね？
MsgEn: You used Hilty to inform us about the orcs, right?

MsgJp:
森を守るため――
みんなを守るため――
MsgEn: To protect the forest―― to protect everyone――

MsgJp: 今でも見守ってくれているんだよね？
MsgEn: They're still watching over us, right?

MsgJp: ありがとう、キースヒルト
グリッテン砦防衛隊への参加
MsgEn: Participation in the Fort Gritten Defense

MsgJp: オーク相手に情けは無用！
斬り、刺し、打ち捨てにして進め！

イリス、どこへ行くの？
ここには何があるの？
MsgEn:
Iris, where are we going?
What's here?

MsgJp:
イリス、やめて！
変だよ、どうしちゃったの？
MsgEn:
Iris, stop it!
Something's wrong, what's happened?

MsgJp:
メイリーフの声だ――
イリスって言ってる――やっぱり――
MsgEn:
It's Mayleaf's voice! She's calling for Iris.
I knew it...!

MsgJp:
メイリーフは俺たちが保護する
渡してもらおう

レオ、まずいんだ
わたし――まずいことになってる
MsgEn: Leo, it's bad. I'm in trouble.

MsgJp:
ほら、最初のアークの調査へ行って――
敵に襲われ、しばらく気を失っていた
MsgEn:
Look, we were investigating the Ark...
I was attacked by the enemy,
and I lost consciousness for a while.

MsgJp: わたしは時々自分がわからなくなる――
毎朝目覚めて最初に思うのは
MsgEn: Every morning, my very first thought was...!

MsgJp: レオ、あんたのことだった

ディアマンテスって男の顔だ
その男が命じるんだ――
MsgEn: That man, Diamantes, is the one commanding it...!

MsgJp:
覚者たちで集まって
誓い合っただろ？
MsgEn: Didn't we, the Arisen, gather and make a pledge?

MsgJp:
そんな思いは封じて
覚者として生きるって――
MsgEn:
Sealing away such thoughts,
living as Arisen...

MsgJp:
だから、頭の中を
支配されちゃったんだ――
MsgEn:
That's why! My mind...
It got taken over...!

MsgJp: ディアマンテスを――愛している

だから彼のために
何でもできるって――
MsgEn: That's why I can do everything

MsgJp:
でも、そんなのウソだ――
わたしが愛しているのは――
MsgEn: But that's a lie! Who I really love is...!
I want you to kill me...

MsgJp:
落ち着け！
落ち着くんだ！
MsgEn:
Calm down!
Get a hold of yourself!
What am I to do now?

Leo, I've changed my mind! 
I don't want this!

MsgJp:
死にたくないよ
神殿に帰りた――
MsgEn:
I don't want to die!
I want to go home to the Temple!

MsgJp:
ここで終わらせよう
イリス――
MsgEn: Let's put an end to this, Iris...!

MsgJp:
その弱さがまた同じことを
繰り返すだろう――
MsgEn:
That weakness will lead to the same thing
happening again...!

MsgJp:
いつかおまえを殺さねばならない
いつか誰かがおまえを殺す――
MsgEn:
Someday, you'll have to be stopped.
Someday, someone will have to kill you...!
In that case, let it be me...!

MsgJp: イリスを助けてあげて？

レオ、みんな――
イリスを追わなくちゃ！
MsgEn: Leo, everyone- We have to follow her!

MsgJp:
いや――
メイリーフの保護を優先する
MsgEn:
No...
Seeing to Mayleafs protection is the priority.

MsgJp:
クラウス、メイリーフ――
おれと一緒に来い

わかっているな？
この神殿の出口で合流しよう
MsgEn:
You understand, right?
Let's meet at the Temple's exit.

MsgJp:
これは古文書によれば導（しるべ）のオーブ
おまえたちが集めた竜の泪を精製したものだ
MsgEn:
This is the Guiding Orb,
according to ancient documents.
It's refined from the dragon's tears
you have collected.

MsgJp: 向かう先には、竜が待っているはずだ
MsgEn:
There should be a dragon
waiting at our destination.

MsgJp: おそらく、慈悲も憐憫の情もない
MsgEn: Most likely it has no mercy or compassion.

MsgJp:
力を欲する覚者のためにのみ生きる
白竜の姿をした怪物
MsgEn:
A monster in the form of a white dragon
that lives only for the power it desires.

MsgJp:
竜の命とて永遠ではない――
人の命は言わずもがな――
MsgEn:
The life of a dragon is not eternal...
Human lives go without saying...
Finite is the nature of the world...

MsgJp:
なぜ我らには無限が与えられなかったのか――
永遠の有無を決めたのは何者だろうか――
MsgEn:
Why weren't we given eternity?
Who decided the existence or absence of eternity?

MsgJp:
理の造物主を知りたくば――
竜になるより道はない――
MsgEn:
If you want to know the creator of Order,
there is no other way than to become a dragon...

MsgJp:
我を倒しても――貴様は有限の存在――
何も変わらぬ――
MsgEn:
Even if you defeat me... Your existence is finite.
Nothing will change...

MsgJp:
ああ――復活か――終わりか――
死にゆく者の――恐怖と快感――
MsgEn:
Ah, revival or the end?
The fear and pleasure of dying...!

MsgJp: 我が輝きは永遠の象徴――
MsgEn: My radiance is a symbol of eternity...

MsgJp: ああ主よ――違うという――のか？
MsgEn:
Oh Lord...
Is it no different...?

MsgJp:
見ない顔だが君たちは
ゲートの向こうから来たのか？
MsgEn:
You have unfamiliar faces.
Have you come from the other side of the Gate?

MsgJp:
はい――僕はクラウス
こちらは覚者――
MsgEn:
Yes... I am Klaus.
And this is an Arisen.

MsgJp:
ゴルゴランの後釜を狙って
来たわけじゃないだろうな
MsgEn: You're not here as Golgorran's successor, are you?

MsgJp:
僕たちはディアマンテスと話し合うために
ここに来たのです
MsgEn: We've come to negotiate with Diamantes.

MsgJp:
はっ！？　話し合うだと？
気は確かか？
MsgEn:
Huh!? Negotiate?
Are you out of your mind?

MsgJp:
そんなことが可能なら
わたしらだってとっくにやってる
MsgEn:
If that were possible,
we would have done it a long time ago.

MsgJp:
それが通じない相手だから
長い闘争の歴史があるわけで――
MsgEn:
He is adverse to reason.
There is a long history of struggle...

MsgJp:
闘争の歴史――ですか
失礼ですが、あなたは？
MsgEn:
A long history...?
My apologies, may I ask about you?

MsgJp:
わたしはテオドール
ディアマンテスを封じた錬金術師の末裔だ
MsgEn:
I am Theodor, a descendant of the alchemist
who sealed Diamantes away.

MsgJp:
他の錬金術師たちと一緒に
日々《封じの玄室》を管理してきた
MsgEn:
Together with other alchemists,
I manage the Sealed Sepulcher day by day.

MsgJp: しかし、時とともに仲間が殺されて――
MsgEn:
However, as time went by,
my comrades were killed...

MsgJp: ディアマンテスの術か――思念か――
MsgEn: Is it Diamantes' magic... or thought...?

MsgJp:
その力は凄まじく、奴の玄室から飛び出した
魔物がどんどん数を増やし――
MsgEn:
His power is tremendous, and the monsters that
emerged from his chamber are increasing rapidly...

MsgJp: その魔物にわたしらは次々と――
MsgEn: We have been falling one by one to those monsters.

MsgJp:
こんなところで立ち話をしていると
わたしらも魔物の餌食だ
MsgEn:
If we keep talking here,
we'll soon become prey!

MsgJp: 工房まで一緒に来てくれ
MsgEn: Come with me to the workshop.

MsgJp:
あそこなら結界があるから
錬金の魔物は近寄らない
MsgEn:
There is a barrier there,
so alchemical monsters won't come near.

MsgJp: あなたと白竜神殿に集う人々の活躍で
MsgEn:
Thanks to you and the people gathering
at the White Dragon Temple,

MsgJp: いにしえの野望は消滅した
MsgEn: The ancient ambition has been eradicated.
The White Dragon of Order has awakened.

MsgJp: 人々は新たな時代の幕開けを信じた
MsgEn: People believed in the beginning of a new era.

MsgJp:
不完全な竜と、竜が生み出した大勢の覚者は
今だ理の外にあり
MsgEn:
The incomplete dragon and the multitude of Arisen
created by thus still fall outside of Order.
It is now the year 322 of the Lestania calendar.
There is still yet to come...

MsgJp: 娘の価値はレスタニア以上とでも？
MsgEn: Is this girl worth more than Lestania itself?

MsgJp: ミシアルを殺してどうする！？
MsgEn: What good does it do to kill Mysial!?

MsgJp: メルゴダが３００年以上の時を経て
MsgEn: It's been more than 300 years since Mergoda...

MsgJp: またこっち側と繋がるんだ

MsgEn: In order for that to happen...

MsgJp:
ズールの濃厚な命が
手に入らないのなら――
MsgEn:
If we cannot obtain a powerful life
such as Zuhl's...

MsgJp:
あの怪物とエルフ――
巫女の命が等価だというのか
MsgEn:
That monster and the elves,
is the priestess' life truly equivalent?

MsgJp:
この世界には二種類の
命があります
MsgEn: There are two types of lives in this world.
Lives that protect those who exist.

MsgJp: 人を守るための命です――
MsgEn: ...Is for the sake of protecting others.

MsgJp: その長命で人を見守り――
MsgEn: They have long lives and watch over people...

MsgJp:
時とともに生じる歪みを
修正する役割を担っているのです
MsgEn: Correcting distortions that occur with time.
Now, that monster called Zuhl is...

MsgJp:
おそらく、あれも、なんらかの
必要があって生み出された命――
MsgEn:
Perhaps, that too is a life
created out of some kind of necessity.

MsgJp:
ゲートを開くのに必要な命は
誰のものでも同じってわけ
MsgEn:
What kind of life is needed to open the gate?
Any one will do the trick.

MsgJp:
ただ、神殿のみんなは
昔からの知り合いだから――
MsgEn:
But seeing as we've all been friends
in the Temple for such a long time...

MsgJp: 取り引きしてやってもいい

ズールの命が入った
命の器を渡せば――
MsgEn:
If you'll be kind enough to hand over
the Vessel with Zuhl's life in it...

MsgJp: ミシアルは返してやる
怪物の命を渡してはいけません
MsgEn: You must not hand over the monster's life.

MsgJp:
わたしは理を守るために
この世界に遣わされました
MsgEn: I was sent to this world to protect Order.

MsgJp:
今、この状況において
あなたたちを守るとは――
MsgEn: Now, as it stands, to protect all of you...

MsgJp: それはいかなることか

こうすることがわたしに残された
唯一の道なのです
MsgEn: This is the only path left before me.

MsgJp:
この世界を脅かす者に
屈してはいけません！
MsgEn: We musn't yield to those who threaten this world!

MsgJp:
ほんの少しの譲歩が
この世界を壊してしまうのです！
MsgEn: The slightest compromise could shatter reality!

MsgJp: ミシアルに影響されちゃったの？
おまえを操る錬金術師の狙いは――
MsgEn: Is it the aim of the alchemist controlling you...

MsgJp: 屈するわけにはいかない
認めるわけにはいかない
それがミシアルの遺志だ
自意識、強すぎないかな？

MsgEn: I didn't like it at all...

MsgJp:
禊の神殿の誓いで――
俺は変わった
MsgEn:
With the oath at the Temple of Purification...
I did change.

MsgJp:
おまえが変わらずに過ごしているのが
理解できず――
MsgEn:
I couldn't understand
how you were still the same...!
I had no choice but to change.
So we passed each other by...
What kind of bastard is he?

MsgJp:
イリスをこの世界から
引き離すなんて――
MsgEn: To pull Iris from this world...
I need to see his face.

MsgJp:
おお――あんたか！
どうしたんだ？

へへっ
コキ使われて嫌になったか
それとも癒やされたいってか？
MsgEn: Or do you want to be healed?

MsgJp:
ああ、イリスを迎えに来たのか
っと、本人登場だ
MsgEn:
Ah, you've come to see Iris.
Oh, speak of the devil.

MsgJp: お迎えだとよ They're here to ferry you away.

――そうか
でも、帰りたくないな
MsgEn:
... Is that so?
Well, I don't want to go back.

MsgJp:
レオたちに会わせる顔がないって？
そんなの、誰も気にしてないだろうな
MsgEn:
Can't bear the thought of facing Leo and the others?'
I doubt anyone cares about that.

MsgJp:
少なくとも俺は気にしていない
幸か不幸かこうして生きているからな
MsgEn:
At the very least, I don't care one bit.
Whether it's for better or for worse, we're still here.

MsgJp:
覚者が死ぬってことは
役目を果たしたってことだ
MsgEn:
The death of an Arisen means they have
fulfilled their duty, to finality.

MsgJp:
だから、そりゃ
ある意味幸せだ
MsgEn: So, in a way, it's fortunate.

MsgJp:
生きてるってことは
まだなーんにもしていない
MsgEn: I'm alive, but I haven't done a thing.

MsgJp:
そういうことにならないか？
背中の荷物はまだ下ろせない
MsgEn:
Won't it come to that?
I can't unload the burden on my back just yet.

MsgJp:
それは――
ある意味、不幸だってことになる
MsgEn: That would be, in a sense, unfortunate.

MsgJp:
はっきりしないね
そういうのは苦手なんだ
MsgEn: I can't make it clear; I'm not good at that.

MsgJp:
はっきりさせてみろ
んで、教えてほしいね
MsgEn: Make it clear then, and I want you to tell me.

MsgJp:
何が幸福か
何が不幸か――
MsgEn: What is happiness? What is sorrow?

MsgJp:
俺はずっと探しているけどな
見つからないんだ
MsgEn:
I've been searching for it all this time,
but I can't find it.

MsgJp: 俺の見たところレオだって――
あいつもまだ迷ってるな

オークとの戦争が終わってみろ
あいつ、抜け殻になるかもな
MsgEn:
Wait 'til the war with the Orcs is over,
and he might become an empty shell.

MsgJp:
イリス
おまえは――どうだ？

ファビオ、誘ってくれて
ありがとう
MsgEn: Fabio, thanks for inviting me out here.

MsgJp:
わたし、先に帰るね
こうしちゃいられないから
MsgEn:
I'll head home first
because I can't do this.

MsgJp:
なまじろき竜の理など――
瞬時になぎ払い、焼き尽くしてくれよう――
MsgEn:
The order of the awakened dragon, in an instant,
it will mow down and burn to ashes—

MsgJp:
帰って貴様の竜に告げるがよい
黄金の竜が復活したとな
MsgEn:
Tell your Wyrm when you return;
the Golden Dragon has been revived.

MsgJp:
世界が我を欲したのか――
我が世界を欲したのか――
MsgEn:
Did the world desire me...
Or did I desire my own world...

MsgJp:
いずれにせよ――我は戻った
この素晴らしきレスタニアにな
MsgEn:
In either case, I have returned to this wonderful
Lestania.

MsgJp:
まずは砦の案内でも――
と思ったが時間がないようだ
MsgEn:
First, I thought I'd guide you to the fort, but
it seems we don't have time.
The general himself is leading the charge.

MsgJp: レオか――レオが来たのか
ヴァネッサ――そっちはヴァネッサだ

おまえはモゴック
オークの中で一番臭い奴だな
MsgEn: You're Mogok, the rankest among the orcs, huh?

MsgJp: 喰え！　喰ってしまえ！
MsgEn: Devour them! Tear them to shreds!

MsgJp: 待て！　二陣に備えるんだ！
MsgEn: Wait! We need to prepare for the second wave!

MsgJp:
まず、残存戦力の確認
そして部隊の再編成――
MsgEn:
First, confirm the remaining forces and then
reorganize the troops—

MsgJp: わかっている――任せてくれ
MsgEn: I understand, leave it to me.

MsgJp:
なんだその顔は
我々では力不足だとでも？
MsgEn:
What's with that face?
Were we insufficient in strength?

MsgJp:
さあ、我々は神殿へ
帰ろうじゃありませんか
MsgEn: Come on, shall we head back to the Temple?

MsgJp: あっちの主力は白騎団です
MsgEn: The main force over there is the Knights Order.

MsgJp:
今みたいな大将級のオークがきたら
どうなることやら――
MsgEn:
I wonder what would happen
if an orc general were to arrive...

MsgJp:
その通りだな
急ぎ、神殿へ戻ろう
MsgEn: That's true; let's hurry back to the Temple.

MsgJp:
白竜の加護と俺の保護――
もはや不要だな
MsgEn:
The White Dragon's blessing and my protection—
are no longer necessary.

MsgJp:
やあ、おかえり――
ジョゼフ様は賛成してくれたんだよね？
MsgEn:
Hello, welcome back.
Joseph approved, right?

MsgJp:
あははは――そう信じて
準備を整えておいたんだ
MsgEn:
Ahahaha, I thought he would,
so I made preparations.

MsgJp: でも――あはは、震えちゃうね
MsgEn: But— ahahaha, I'm trembling, you know?

MsgJp: よし！　封印を解こう！

身を隠せ
俺が操られていると思ったら――わかるな？
MsgEn:
Hide yourself.
If you think I'm being manipulated...
you understand, right?

MsgJp:
レオ――間違ってるって！
心の隙をつかれる可能性があるから――
MsgEn:
Leo...! You're wrong!
Because they could catch you off-guard--

MsgJp:
だから僕らは一緒に行動すべきなんだ
仲間は後始末のためにいるんじゃない！
MsgEn:
We should all work together.
Our comrades aren't just for cleanup!

MsgJp: イリスはどんな夢を見たんだ？
MsgEn: What kind of dream did Iris have?

MsgJp:
ディアマンテスはあいつに
どんな未来を見せたんだ――
MsgEn: What kind of future did Diamantes show to her...?

MsgJp: 俺もその世界を見たかった――
MsgEn: I also wanted to see that world...

MsgJp:
ミシアルが命を賭けて守ろうとした世界――
俺達が生きるべき世界――
MsgEn:
The world that Mysial risked her life to protect...
The world we should be living in...

MsgJp: それよりも素晴らしい世界なのか？
MsgEn: Is it a more splendid world than that?

MsgJp: それとも、ペテンにあったのか――
MsgEn: Or was it all just a deception?
What I desired above all else...

MsgJp: この上なく単純で美しい世界だ
MsgEn:
Was a world as simple and as beautiful
as it could possibly be.

MsgJp:
竜の理から脱して
人間が支配する世界
MsgEn:
A world where humans rule
without the influence of dragons.

MsgJp:
竜がもたらす不合理な
奇跡など起こらない――
MsgEn:
Where the irrational miracles brought about
by dragons simply do not happen...

MsgJp:
人の叡智が導き出した
論理が支配する世界をわたしは欲した
MsgEn:
I wanted a world ruled by the logic
deduced by human wisdom.

MsgJp: そして、その実現のためには――
MsgEn: And, in order to achieve that...

MsgJp: 存在しないはずの竜や――
竜に従わない覚者が必要だった――
MsgEn: Arisen who defy dragons were necessary.

MsgJp: 理を乱す者が必要だったのだ
MsgEn: Those who disrupt the logic were needed.

MsgJp: そのためにイリスを利用したのか！
MsgEn: Is that why Iris was used!
What are the Arisen, in the first place?

MsgJp:
竜が己の都合のために作った
いびつな存在だ
MsgEn:
They are twisted into existence by the dragons
for their own convenience.

MsgJp: 竜が人を支配するために作った――
MsgEn: Created by the dragons to control humans...

MsgJp:
己の世界を継続するための目的で
ただ、それだけのために作った――
MsgEn: For the sole purpose of continuing their world...

MsgJp: 人より優れた存在だとでも思っていたのか？
MsgEn: Did you think you were superior to humans?

MsgJp:
誰が世界を支配しようと
覚者の居場所などどこにもない！
MsgEn:
There's no place for Arisen in the world,
no matter who wants to rule it!

MsgJp:
そのままでいるがよい
邪魔しなければ――
MsgEn:
You can stay as you are,
as long as you don't interfere—

MsgJp: 世界の片隅に置いてやってもいい
MsgEn: I can give you a place in a corner of the world.

MsgJp:
覚者とはなんであるか――
覚者の使命とは――
MsgEn: What are the Arisen? What is their mission?

MsgJp: おまえはひとつの解釈を与えてくれた

俺がずっと考えていたことに対する
解釈だ――
MsgEn:
An interpretation that aligns
with I've been thinking all along—

MsgJp:
では、覚者とはなんだ
聞かせてもらおうか
MsgEn: Then, what are the Arisen? Let me hear it.

MsgJp: 飛べない竜の翼となり
MsgEn: They are the wings of a dragon that cannot fly.
One who cuts down the dragon's foes!

MsgJp:
貴様のようなくそ忌々しい野郎を
ぶっ倒すために俺達はいる！
MsgEn: We exist to beat disgusting bastards like you!

MsgJp: 答えを見つけたのなら――
MsgEn: I see you've found your answer...
...Now die without a care in your heart.
The future... Can't you see it?

MsgJp: 僕？　僕に言ってるのかい？
MsgEn: Me? Are you talking to me?

MsgJp: あんたの遺志なんて知るもんか
MsgEn: I don't give a shit about your legacy!

MsgJp:
あんたは――友達の仇だ
僕は仇が討てて満足さ
MsgEn:
You're— the enemy of my friend.
I'm satisfied with avenging her.

MsgJp: 目指す相手はこの先にいる
MsgEn: The one you're aiming for is up ahead.

MsgJp:
ここに来たのは
もちろん、アレを探して――だよね？
MsgEn:
Of course,
you came here to search for 'that,' right?

MsgJp:
僕もジョゼフさまから聞いたよ
《竜王の指輪》のこと
MsgEn:
I heard about it from Master Joseph too,
the 'Wyrm King's Ring.'

MsgJp:
失われた魔器――それも３００年前だろ
ディアマンテスが絡んでるに違いないよ
MsgEn:
A magical artifact...
that was lost 300 years ago, wasn't it?
Diamantes must be involved in it.

MsgJp:
そう考えてるんだけどさ
問題は、それを何に使ったか――
MsgEn:
I think so too, but the problem is,
what was it used for...?

MsgJp:
さて、これからする話は
僕の単なる推測さ
MsgEn: Now, what I'm about to say is purely speculation.

MsgJp:
この場所、《古の祭祀場》は強い竜力が
渦巻く場所だということは知ってるよね
MsgEn:
Do you know that this place,
the "Ancient Ritual Ground,"
is a place where Dragon Force circulates?

MsgJp: その強い竜力は魔物を引き寄せるだけじゃなく――
MsgEn:
That strong Dragon Force
not only attracts enemies, but...

MsgJp:
君たち覚者の力を高める可能性だって
あると思うんだ
MsgEn:
I think it has the potential to enhance
your power as Arisen.

MsgJp:
ほら、結晶化した竜力はオーブになったり
武具の材料にだってなるだろ？
MsgEn:
See, crystallized Dragon Force can become orbs
or materials for equipment, right?

MsgJp:
きっと、それは３００年前も今も
同じなんじゃないかな
MsgEn:
I'm sure that hasn't changed in 300 years,
even to this day.

MsgJp: だから、気をつけるんだ――

《竜王の指輪》がそういうことに使われたなら
とてつもない危険が待ってるのかも――
MsgEn:
If the 'Wyrm King's Ring' was used
for something like that, there may be
incredible danger waiting ahead...

MsgJp:
僕はこれで帰るけど、どうか無事で
また神殿で会おう
MsgEn:
I'll be leaving now, stay safe
and may we meet again at the Temple.

MsgJp:
やはり覚者どうしだな
お互い、ここに引き寄せられたというわけだ
MsgEn:
Indeed, it seems we Arisen
have been drawn together here.
It's as if we've been ensnared in this place.

MsgJp:
強く感じる、このメルゴダからの
禍々しい波動――
MsgEn: I feel strongly, this ominous wave coming from Mergoda...

MsgJp: この先に、どのような運命が待ち受けていようと
MsgEn: No matter what fate awaits us ahead,

MsgJp: 決して恐れずに立ち向かうんだ
そうすることで見えるものもあるはずだ
MsgEn: If you do, you might miss something.

MsgJp:
なまじろき竜の覚者よ
朽ちた世界を守る無意味さを――
MsgEn:
Arisen of the White Dragon...
The futility of protecting a decaying world...

MsgJp:
我が領域に踏み入る愚かさを――
その身に焼き付けるがよい
MsgEn:
And the foolishness of stepping into my domain...
may it be seared into your very being.

MsgJp:
この世界を統べる我が力は
指輪の力だけではない
MsgEn:
My power that governs this world
isn't merely in the power of the ring.

MsgJp: 壊せるものなら壊してみよ！！！
MsgEn: If you can break it, try it!!!!

MsgJp: 我をうち倒すとは見事だ――

だが、黄金に輝く《竜王の指輪》は
我が不滅の輝きに姿を変えて久しい
MsgEn:
But the golden 'Wyrm King's Ring' has long
transformed into my immortal radiance.
I will return as many times as I want...

MsgJp:
指輪探しにうつつを抜かしながら
貴様たちは扉を開いたのだ――
MsgEn:
While you were busy looking for the Ring,
I opened the door...

MsgJp:
混沌へと続く無限の扉を――
楽しみだな――また会おうぞ
MsgEn:
Endless doors leading to chaos...
I'm looking forward to it... We'll see you soon.
...You've got a long way to go.

MsgJp:
ん？　どうした？
ああ、力が抜けていく――か
MsgEn:
Huh? What's wrong?
Ah, your strength is leaving you... isn't it?

MsgJp:
おまえの初陣はこれで終わりだ
つまり、白竜の加護もここまで
MsgEn:
Your first battle ends here.
Or rather, the White Dragon's blessing ends here.

MsgJp:
あとは自分の力で強くなり――
さっきの力を掴み取るしかない
MsgEn:
After this, you must gain you own strength...
There's no other way to regain the power
you've just felt.

MsgJp: 加えて――いや、あとは神殿で話そう
MsgEn:
Oh, also... actually no,
let's talk back at the temple.

MsgJp:
お気に入りにされたみたい
こき使われちゃうなあ、これは
MsgEn:
He's taken a liking to you.
This one's going to be used and abused!

MsgJp:
おーいー
祝福のはじまりだ！
MsgEn: Hey, it's the beginning of a blessing!

MsgJp: さぁ、不死身のおれとざんざか殺り合おう
MsgEn:
Now, let's clash, you and me, the invulnerable
one.

MsgJp: めいっぱい楽しんでくれよ

イヤだ――
また死にたくない――
MsgEn: I don't want to die again—

MsgJp: オオオオ――おれは不死身だろうに――
俺たちは新たな力を手に入れた
MsgEn: We have obtained a new power.

MsgJp:
この力を合わせて黒騎士と戦えば
きっと倒せるだろう
MsgEn:
If we combine this power and fight the Black
Knight, we can surely defeat him.

MsgJp:
クラウスの伝言だよ
レオがしていることを調べたんだって
MsgEn:
It's a message from Klaus. He investigated what
Leo is doing.

MsgJp:
たった今、隊長が手に入れた力は
混じりっ気なしの、純粋な竜力です
MsgEn:
The power the captain just obtained is pure
Dragon Force, no impurities whatsoever.

MsgJp: 竜力の本質は、癒やしの力だ
MsgEn:
The essence of Dragon Force is the power of
healing.

MsgJp:
黒騎士を倒せるかどうかわからねえが
セシリーを助けることならできるかもしれねえ
MsgEn:
I don't know if we can defeat the Black Knight,
but we might be able to save Cecily.

MsgJp: 俺なら、まず、そっちに賭けるね
あいつらが、賭けに勝つことを祈ろうか
MsgEn: Shall we pray that they win the bet?

MsgJp:
擬竜は白竜の力で存在していたんだ
そんな予感はしたけどね
MsgEn:
Pseudo-dragons existed with the White Dragon's
power. I had a hunch like that.

MsgJp: 全財産賭けてなかったか？
MsgEn: Didn't you bet your entire fortune on it?

MsgJp: 再び目覚めし渦の流れ――
MsgEn: Once again, the flow of the awakening vortex...

MsgJp: 断ち切る事など最早叶わぬ
MsgEn: It's no longer possible to cut it off.

MsgJp: 父と一緒に旅立った人です
MsgEn:
The person who set out on a journey with my
father.

MsgJp: ひどい傷です――ここで一体何が――
MsgEn:
It's a serious wound... What on earth is
happening here...?

MsgJp:
ごめん――遅かったね、お父さん
ごめんね――
MsgEn: I'm sorry— I'm late, Dad. I'm sorry—

MsgJp:
戻るぞ
セシリー、村の受け入れ態勢を整えろ
MsgEn:
Let's go back. Cecily, prepare the village for
the reception.
In the depths of the temple—

MsgJp: 命に代えてもここから出すなッ！
MsgEn:
Even if it costs us our lives, don't leave this
place!

MsgJp: 残った者はこれだけか――
よく持ち堪えてくれた――
手を貸してくれるのか、我らに――
MsgEn: Will you lend us a hand—

MsgJp:
良かった――予想よりたくさんあります
これだけあれば芯脈も浄化できるはず――
MsgEn:
Good— there are more than expected. With this
many, we should be able to purify the Core Vein—

MsgJp:
いいえ、とにかく、早く戻りましょう
父やみんなが心配しています
MsgEn:
No, anyway, let's hurry back. Father and everyone
are worried.

MsgJp:
でも、あの――ひとつだけ言わせてください
隊長――ありがとう
MsgEn:
But, um, just let me say one thing, Captain—
thank you.

MsgJp: フィンダムの竜――精霊竜のウィルミアです
MsgEn: The dragon of Phindym— the Spirit Dragon, Willmia.

MsgJp:
うん――
竜って、やっぱり、なんていうか美しいよ
MsgEn:
Yeah— dragons, they're beautiful in their own
way, after all.

MsgJp:
ケッ！　今は魔物だ！
美しい花にはトゲも毒もある――そう思え！
MsgEn:
Tch! Right now, it's a monster! Beautiful flowers
have thorns and poison— think that way!

MsgJp:
ウィルミア――
わたしがわかる？　ぜんぶ、もらいにきたよ
MsgEn:
Willmia...
Do you understand me? I've come to take it all.
If you would be so kind

MsgJp: ありがとうございました

"芯なる樹"が元に戻っても、竜がいなくては――
フィンダムは――癒やされません――
MsgEn:
Even if the 'Core Tree' is restored, without the
dragon— Phindym won't be healed—

MsgJp: それが――覚者である――わたしの――
竜になる前に――出会えて――良かった――
MsgEn: Before becoming a dragon— I'm glad I met you—

MsgJp:
芯なる樹――
聖なる不思議な場所――
MsgEn: The 'Core Tree'— a sacred and mysterious place—

MsgJp:
この大いなる樹内は
全ての出来事を記憶している
MsgEn: This grand tree remembers all events within it.

MsgJp: そう、精霊竜ウィルミアとの戦いも――
MsgEn:
Yes, even the battle with the Spirit Dragon
Willmia—

MsgJp: 芯なる樹が呼び覚ますウィルミアは
MsgEn: The Willmia awakened by the 'Core Tree'—

MsgJp: 過去を遥かに超えた試練となるだろう
MsgEn: Will likely become a trial far beyond the past.

MsgJp: さぁ、その内なる竜力を研ぎ澄まし
MsgEn: Now, sharpen your inner Dragon Force.

MsgJp: 試練に立ち向かうのです

団長！
ここにもほどなく魔物が押し寄せます！
MsgEn:
Captain! The monsters are approaching this place
shortly too!

MsgJp: 援軍は必ず来る、持ちこたえるんだ
MsgEn: Reinforcements will definitely come; hold on!

MsgJp: ただいまよりこの場を放棄
MsgEn: From now on, I abandon this place.

MsgJp: まだ我らに逆らう、ヒトが残っていようとは――
MsgEn: Even if there are still humans opposing us—

MsgJp: 砦に囚われていた村人たちは解放したぞ
MsgEn:
The villagers who were trapped in the fortress
have been freed.

MsgJp: おぬしらのおかげでティネス砦奪回だ！
