MsgEn: Thanks to you, we have recaptured Fort Thines!

MsgJp: 将軍、残念ながらネド王子はいないようです
MsgEn:
General, unfortunately, Prince Nedo doesn't seem
to be here.

MsgJp: そうか――しかし砦は今やわれらの物
MsgEn: I see— but now the fortress is ours.

MsgJp: ジリアン、急ぎこの草笛の主を調べよ！
MsgEn:
Gillian, quickly investigate the owner of this
grass flute!

MsgJp: これは王家に伝わる"契りの歌"だ
MsgEn:
This is the 'Song of Covenant' passed down in the
royal family.

MsgJp: 王族以外で知る者はほとんどおらんはず
MsgEn:
There should be very few people who know it other
than the royal family.

MsgJp: 将軍、草笛を吹いていたのは少女だ
MsgEn:
General, the one playing the grass flute was a
young girl.

MsgJp:
笛の調べは数日前、村に立ち寄った少年が
教えてくれたらしい
MsgEn:
The melody of the flute was apparently taught by
a boy who visited the village a few days ago.

MsgJp: その少年は、盗賊と一緒にいたって
MsgEn: That boy was with thieves at the time.

MsgJp: ネド王子！　王子に間違いないぞ！
MsgEn: Prince Nedo! There is no doubt about it!

MsgJp: しかし盗賊などと行動を共にしていたとは解せぬ
MsgEn:
However, I can't understand why he was with
thieves.

MsgJp:
ふむ――奴らのアジトに出向くしかないようだ
準備を整え、西へ出発するぞ
MsgEn:
Hmm— we should head to their hideout. Prepare and
get ready to leave for the west.

MsgJp: 今日のところは、皆しっかりと休んでくれ
僕の命はもうおまえたちの手にある
MsgEn: My life is already in your hands.

MsgJp: この期に及んで命乞いはしない
MsgEn: I won't beg for my life at this point.

MsgJp:
でも、ひとつだけ頼みがあります
ベルタと話をさせてほしい
MsgEn: But I have one request. I want to speak to Bertha.

MsgJp:
ベルタがしてくれた恩に
僕は報いることができそうにない
MsgEn:
I'm never going to be able to repay Bertha for
what she's done for me.

MsgJp: ひと言、謝りたいんです
MsgEn: I have to apologize to her, in a single word.

MsgJp: ほう、まだ仲間がおったか――
MsgEn: Oh, there are still comrades, huh――

MsgJp: くだんの覚者とは――貴様か――
MsgEn: So, you are the Arisen in question――you?――

MsgJp: ほう、やるもんだね、異国の覚者ってのは
MsgEn: Oh, you're quite the fighter, foreign Arisen.

MsgJp: ネド王子！　よくぞご無事で――
MsgEn: Prince Nedo! I'm glad you're safe――

MsgJp: 盗賊よ、王子が世話になったな
MsgEn: Thieves, the prince was indebted to you.

MsgJp:
王家が滅んだら
盗む相手がいなくなるからね
MsgEn:
If the royal family is destroyed, there won't be
anyone left to steal from, you know.

MsgJp: 盗みなど、やめればよかろうに
MsgEn: Why don't you just quit stealing?

MsgJp:
ベルタ――
僕を守ってくれて本当にありがとう
MsgEn:
Bertha—
Thank you so much for protecting me.

MsgJp:
あなたたちのことはジリアンから聞きました
ご尽力に感謝します
MsgEn:
We heard about you from Gillian. We're grateful
for your efforts.

MsgJp:
この国の悪しき炎が
レスタニアに及ばないよう――
MsgEn:
To prevent the evil flames of this country from
reaching Lestania—

MsgJp:
出来る限りのことは
させて頂くつもりです
MsgEn: We intend to do whatever we can.

MsgJp:
覚者が大勢いるなんて
なんだか少し――羨ましいです
MsgEn:
To have so many Arisen...
It's a bit... enviable.
That radiance is proof of being an Arisen!

MsgJp: 覚者に囲まれ、眠りし力が共鳴したとでもいうのか
MsgEn: Surrounded by Arisen, the dormant power resonated.

MsgJp:
やはりわしの思った通りだった！
女王様は密かに王子を覚者にされていたのだ――
MsgEn:
As I suspected!
The queen secretly turned the prince into an
Arisen.

MsgJp: 希望が、さらなる未来まで繋がりましたぞ！
MsgEn: Our hope has extended to an even greater future!

MsgJp:
僕が、この国の正統な覚者に――？
でもメイロワ将軍
MsgEn:
Am I the legitimate Arisen of this country...?
But General Meirova...

MsgJp:
僕はまだ子供で――
知恵も力もまったく足りません
MsgEn:
I'm still just a child— I lack both wisdom and
strength.

MsgJp: アッカーの名に恥じぬ戦いはできるのでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Can I fight without bringing shame to the name of
Acre?

MsgJp:
王子――
わしらにお任せ下さい

レスタニアからの頼もしい援軍とともに、敵に
奪われたもの、何もかも取り返してお見せしましょう
MsgEn:
With reinforcements from Lestania, we'll recover
everything that has been taken by the enemy.

MsgJp:
滅びの道を歩んでいたアッカーシェランに
希望の火が灯った
MsgEn:
Hope has ignited in Acre Selund, which was on the
path to destruction.

MsgJp: しかし、人々は思わずにはいられない
MsgEn: However, people can't help but wonder.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜によって蹂躙された大地に芽吹いた希望が
白竜の覚者たちによってもたらされたものならば――
MsgEn:
If the hope that sprouted in the land ravaged by
the evil dragon was brought by the Arisen of the
White Dragon—

MsgJp:
この地に彼らを呼びつけた悪しき竜の意図は
いったいどこにあるのだろうか
MsgEn:
What could be the evil dragon's intention for
bringing them here?

MsgJp:
竜の心を知るには――
人はまだ小さき者に過ぎないのだろうか
MsgEn:
Is it possible that we still don't understand the
dragon's heart?

MsgJp: 悪しき竜に与する魔物どもよ
MsgEn: Oh, wicked creatures aligned with the evil dragon.

MsgJp:
絶望の淵より這い上がりし、我らの刃を
受けるがいい！
MsgEn:
Rise from the abyss of despair, and receive our
blades!

MsgJp: この国に貴様らの居場所などありはせん
MsgEn: You have no place in this country.

MsgJp: さあ、奴らを叩き出すぞ！
あれ？　みんな深刻な顔をしていますね

先の谷で悪しき竜と対峙した時
ネド王子は、あの竜の正体を見切ったの
MsgEn:
When Prince Nedo faced the evil dragon in the
previous valley, he saw through its true nature.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の竜力は、火竜様のものだから
王子は継承できることがわかったのね
MsgEn:
Since the Evil Dragon's Dragon Force belongs to
the Fire Dragon, the prince realized he could
inherit it.

MsgJp:
だけど、悪しき竜がやすやすと
竜力を手放すとは思えないな
MsgEn:
However, it's hard to believe the evil dragon
would easily relinquish its Dragon Force.

MsgJp:
そう――
だから竜を倒さなくちゃいけない
MsgEn: Right— that's why we need to defeat the dragon.

MsgJp: 控え目に言って――簡単じゃなさそうだね
MsgEn: To put it mildly, it doesn't seem easy.

MsgJp:
簡単ではないが、多少は楽にする秘策が
あると言ったらどうする
MsgEn:
It's not easy, but what if I told you there's a
secret plan that could make it somewhat easier?

MsgJp: もったいぶるんじゃねえ

効果に確証があるわけではない
ここは慎重にならせて頂こう
MsgEn:
I can't be sure it will work effectively, so we
should proceed with caution.

MsgJp:
ともあれ、秘策の実行にはまず、王都メガド
そして火垂れ山への道筋を開かねばならぬ
MsgEn:
In any case, before we can execute this secret
plan, we need to first clear a path to the Royal
Capital, Megado, and then to Firefall Mountain.

MsgJp:
展望城の奪還は、その道筋を開くため
避けては通れんのだが
MsgEn:
Recapturing the Lookout Castle is necessary to
open the path, there is no way around it.

MsgJp: 幾分、敵の兵力が多すぎる――
MsgEn: But it seems the enemy forces are quite numerous.

MsgJp: オークの部隊が集結しているらしいね
MsgEn: An orc unit has gathered there, it seems.

MsgJp:
そこで提案です
わたしはロスギルへ戻り――
MsgEn: So here's my proposal: I'll return to Rothgill—

MsgJp: 兵をまとめて"嘆きの湿原"へ進軍します
MsgEn:
We will gather troops and march together to the
"Wailing Wetland".

MsgJp:
そして湿原の、敵の野営地に攻撃を
しかけてやるのです、となれば――
MsgEn:
And if we were to launch an attack on the enemy's
camp in the marshlands...

MsgJp:
展望城の戦いに飢えたオークどもは
勇んで戦場へと向かうはずです
MsgEn:
The orcs, eager for a fight, should head to the
battlefield.

MsgJp:
おそらく、城の守りは手薄になりますから
その隙に奇襲部隊が侵入すれば――
MsgEn:
With the castle's defenses likely weakened during
that time, our surprise attack squad can enter—

MsgJp: イェルハルド、素晴らしい！
わたしもイェルハルドと行くよ

おぬしたちも行ってもらえぬか？
派手に暴れて愚かなオークどもを騙してやるのだ
MsgEn:
Could we go too?
We'll make a spectacle and deceive those foolish
orcs.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドたちが動いたよ
戦力をジリアンと二分して暴れているらしい
MsgEn:
Gerhard and his team have already moved out,
dividing the forces with Gillian and wreaking
havoc.

MsgJp:
エリオットが陽動部隊に加わってくれたから
さぞ心強いことだろうよ
MsgEn:
Eliott joined the diversion squad, so they should
be quite powerful.

MsgJp:
展望城に集結していたオーク達が
ついに、嘆きの湿原へと向かいました！
MsgEn:
The orcs that had gathered at Lookout Castle have
finally headed to the Wailing Wetland!

MsgJp:
おお――陽動は成功
つまり、城は今、がら空きだ！
MsgEn:
Great— the diversion was a success, which means
the castle is now empty!

MsgJp:
あんな大きなお城――
本当に陥とせるかな
MsgEn: Such a big castle... Can we really capture it?

MsgJp: あの城の先にしか、未来も、希望も無い
MsgEn: Beyond that castle, there is no future, no hope.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの覚者たちよ
ここまで来れたのも、おぬしらの力添えあってこそだ
MsgEn:
Arisen of Lestania, we've made it this far
because of your support.

MsgJp:
隊長さん、王家の通路からの侵入が成功すれば
一気に城壁の内側に出られるはずです――
MsgEn:
Captain, if the intrusion from the royal passage
succeeds, we should be able to reach the inside of
the city walls in one go—

MsgJp: 僕たちも急ぎ出陣しましょう
ネド王子の姿が見えん！　どこだ！？
MsgEn: I can't see Prince Nedo! Where is he?!

MsgJp: 勝手な行動は慎んでもらわないと～！
MsgEn: I won't tolerate any reckless actions!

MsgJp: でも、王子の良いところでしょ？　さあ、隊長！
MsgEn:
But that's one of the prince's charms, isn't it?
Now, Captain!

MsgJp: フゥッ！！（リアクションボイス、唸り声）
天晴れ、レスタニアの覚者隊！
ネド王子と解放軍もね
MsgEn: Prince Nedo and the Liberation Army, too.

MsgJp: わたしの出番はなしだね
MsgEn: I have no role left, huh?

MsgJp: 遅いわ！　して、各地の状況は？
MsgEn:
Too late! So, how's the situation in various
places?

MsgJp:
敵の動きが活発になっているの
ロスギルの村、ベルタのアジトあたりも危ない
MsgEn:
The enemy is getting more active. The village of
Rothgill and Bertha's hideout are in danger.

MsgJp: 何か対策を考えないと――
MsgEn: We need to come up with a plan...

MsgJp:
僕が赴くことで状況が変わるなら
行かせてください
MsgEn:
If my presence can make a difference in the
situation, please let me go.

MsgJp:
皆の苦労の時に、砦でジッとしているわけには
いきません
MsgEn:
We can't just sit back in our forts when everyone
else is struggling.
I can't.

MsgJp:
いやはや――王位を継承するということは
こういうことなんですねえ
MsgEn:
Well, that's it— inheriting the throne is a tough
job, but also a rewarding one, isn't it?

MsgJp: もう、ますます応援しちゃう！
MsgEn: It's the people's trust that carries us forward.

MsgJp: 今、未来は私たちの手中にある
MsgEn: Now, the future is in our hands.

MsgJp: ここを落とし、またひとつ
MsgEn: Let's capture this place, and another one falls.

MsgJp: 新たな希望を積み上げよう
MsgEn:
Let us stack up new hope and build another layer
of hope.

MsgJp:
オークの将よ！
ここまでだ！
シュワアッ！　小賢しい！
嘆きの湿原は囮だったというわけか――
MsgEn:
So, it seems that the Wailing Wetland 
was a decoy after all...

MsgJp: 王家アッカーの名のもと
MsgEn: In the name of the Royal House of Acre.

MsgJp: この城とこの国の民を返して貰います！
MsgEn:
I will reclaim this castle and 
the people of this land!

MsgJp: ――ゴハァッ、ギ様のガオォ、忘れんぞォ！
MsgEn: Gah! I won't forget that roar!

MsgJp:
骸の将を、討ち破ったぞ！
皆勝ちどきを上げよ！
MsgEn:
We've defeated the Necro Master!
Everyone, raise your victory cries!

MsgJp: オオーー！！（リアクションボイス）
オオーー！！（リアクションボイス）
オオーー！！（リアクションボイス）

オークが――オークたちが
次から次へと城を出て行きます！
MsgEn:
- Orcs keep pouring out of the castle, 
one after another!

MsgJp:
見せてもらったよ
凄いとは聞いていたけどまったくその通りだ
MsgEn:
Ser, I've seen it now.
I had heard it was amazing, 
but it's exactly as they said.

MsgJp:
この国にもまだ希望が残っている
それが実感できたわ
MsgEn:
There's still hope left in this country.
That is the feeling I have come to grasp.

MsgJp:
隊長、皆さん――
ありがとうございます

あとは陽動に出てた奴らが
生きてるといいがな――
MsgEn:
I hope those guys who went out as a 
diversion are still alive.

MsgJp:
エリオットとジリアンがいるんだもん
うまくやってるんじゃない？
MsgEn:
With Elliot and Gillian here, 
they're probably doing well, right?

MsgJp: すぐに部隊を回収させましょう
次に目指すのは、いよいよ王都メガドです
MsgEn:
What we're aiming for next is 
finally the Royal Capital, Megado.

MsgJp:
レスタニア勢の活躍で、ネド王子と解放軍は
展望城を取り戻すことに成功した
MsgEn:
The Lestanian forces' heroic efforts enabled 
Prince Nedo and the Liberation Army to 
successfully reclaim Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
士気上がる人々の間から、砦から城へ
拠点を移すべきだという声があがり――
MsgEn:
With the boost in morale, there's talk of shifting
our base from the fort to the castle—

MsgJp:
ネド王子が承認すると同時に人々は
せわしげに働き始めた
MsgEn:
As soon as Prince Nedo approved, 
the people set to work.

MsgJp:
勝利への道はまだ半ばであることを知っていたが
以前と比べて人々の顔は明るい
MsgEn:
Although I knew we were only halfway to victory,
the people's faces are brighter than before.

MsgJp:
ひとりひとりの胸の中に
しっかりと、希望が根付いていたのだ
MsgEn:
Within each person's heart, 
hope had firmly taken root.

MsgJp: 王子の姿をした仮初めの希望ではなく
MsgEn: Not a fleeting hope in the guise of a prince,

MsgJp:
それぞれが思い描く、それぞれの未来の姿が
希望になったのだ
MsgEn:
but hopes are now shaped by the futures
 they each envision.

MsgJp: これから先のことは、将軍から聞いてる？
MsgEn:
Has the General told you what's 
going to happen from here on out?

MsgJp:
この使役獣で、人の足では越えられない
切り立つ岩山を強行して北の大地へ入る
MsgEn:
With this beast of burden, 
we will force our way over sheer rock mountains 
that cannot be crossed on foot,
entering the northern lands.

MsgJp:
街道の関所は敵の制圧下にあるので
過酷な道を選ぶことになってしまいました
MsgEn:
The checkpoint on the path is under enemy control,
so we've been forced to choose a harsher route.

MsgJp:
毎度毎度――
もう慣れてきたぜ
MsgEn:
Over and over—
I'm starting to get used to it.

MsgJp: この獣、突然暴れたりしないんですか？
MsgEn: Isn't there a risk of this beast going berserk?

MsgJp:
大人しいヤツを選んでみたつもり
保証はないけどね――
MsgEn:
I selected a quiet one, thinking it through. 
There's no guarantee though...

MsgJp: さあ、準備が出来たのなら出発するよ
MsgEn: Now, if you're ready, we're off.

MsgJp:
隊長、ジリアン
どうかお気をつけて

MsgEn: It looks like everyone is here.

MsgJp:
それでは、将軍
王都メガド奪還作戦の説明をお願いします
MsgEn:
Then, General,
Please explain the operation to reclaim 
the Royal Capital of Megado.

MsgJp:
まず――
神殿を脱出した兵たちを救出して、我が軍に加える
MsgEn:
Firstly—
Rescue the soldiers who escaped from 
the temple and add them to our army.

MsgJp:
助け出した彼らを、城周辺に配備して
メガド突入時の陽動を任せる予定だ
MsgEn:
I plan to deploy those we rescued 
around the castle to create a diversion 
during the invasion of Megado.

MsgJp:
先の石塔にいた守護兵たちのように
逃げ延びた兵は、案外いるかも知れませんね
MsgEn:
Just like the guardians at the stone tower before,
there may be quite a few soldiers 
who managed to escape.

MsgJp:
そして――
北の地の盗賊たちに、王都潜入の協力を要請する
MsgEn:
Next, I'll ask the northern bandits 
to help me infiltrate the royal capital.

MsgJp:
北の盗賊とは面倒だね
でも、あたしらより王都への侵入には長けている
MsgEn:
The Northern bandits are troublesome, 
but they're more adept at breaching the capital 
than we are.

MsgJp:
王家を悩ませた悪党どもを頼るのはシャクだが
背に腹はかえられない
MsgEn:
It's unpleasant to rely on the scoundrels who 
troubled the royal family,
but desperate times call for desperate measures.

MsgJp:
ふん、交渉が心配だ
――いいだろう、あたしが行くよ
MsgEn:
Hmph, I'm uneasy about the talks.
—Very well, I'll go myself.

MsgJp:
んじゃ、さっさと動こうぜ
俺たちの動きもいつまで隠せるか分からねぇ
MsgEn:
Well then, let's move quickly. 
We don't know how long we can keep our 
movements hidden.

MsgJp:
それでは一度解散としよう
隊長、ジリアンとともに、頼んだぞ
MsgEn:
Let's disband for now.
Captain, Gillian, I'm counting on you.

MsgJp: 外の音、臭いがわかるだろうか
MsgEn: Can you recognize the sounds and smells outside?

MsgJp:
メガドでの敗戦の後――これを機にと
オークどもが大挙し攻め寄せてきたのだ
MsgEn:
After the defeat at Megado, 
taking this opportunity, 
the Orc horde launched a full-scale attack.

MsgJp: 控え目に言っても劣勢
MsgEn: To put it mildly, we are outnumbered.

MsgJp:
でも――
軍を率いてるのは、あの"戦の将"
MsgEn:
But... the person leading the
army is that "War Master"

MsgJp: 見方を変えれば絶好の好機
MsgEn:
From a different perspective, 
it's a great opportunity.

MsgJp:
うむ、奴を仕留めることができれば
メガドは将を失うことになる
MsgEn:
Mm, if we can take him down, 
Megado will be leaderless.

MsgJp:
あんたたちは、まず、遊軍として
城内の敵を掃討しておくれ
MsgEn:
Begin by clearing the castle of enemies as a
reconnaissance unit.

MsgJp: 王子はあたしとメイロワで守ってみせるよ
MsgEn: I'll protect the prince with Meirova.

MsgJp: わたしも遊軍として動くね
MsgEn: I'll be part of the reconnaissance unit too.

MsgJp:
この展望城――再びオークには渡せません
皆さん、よろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
Lookout Castle—
We cannot let it fall to the orcs again.
Everyone, I count on you.

MsgJp:
いいか、ジリアン
王子の行方不明は他言無用だ
MsgEn:
Listen, Gillian,
don't tell anyone else the prince is missing.

MsgJp:
まだ横たわる闇は大きく
結末の見えない戦いが控えてはいたが――
MsgEn:
The darkness still looms large,
and a battle with no clear end is ahead, but—

MsgJp:
今はただ白竜の復活を喜ぶ時とばかりに
レスタニアの人々は歌い、踊った
MsgEn:
For now, the people of Lestania sang and danced,
rejoicing in the revival of the White Dragon.

MsgJp: しかし、彼らはまだ知らなかった

アッカーシェランの覚者であるネド王子の
秘めたる計画を
MsgEn:
... The secret plans of Prince Nedo, 
the Arisen of Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
いいか、ジリアン
王子の行方不明は他言無用だ
MsgEn:
Listen, Gillian,
don't tell anyone else the prince is missing.

MsgJp:
まだ横たわる闇は大きく
結末の見えない戦いが控えてはいたが――
MsgEn:
The darkness still looms large,
and a battle with no clear end is ahead, but—

MsgJp:
今はただ白竜の復活を喜ぶ時とばかりに
レスタニアの人々は歌い、踊った
MsgEn:
For now, the people of Lestania sang and danced,
rejoicing in the revival of the White Dragon.

MsgJp: しかし、彼らはまだ知らなかった

アッカーシェランの覚者であるネド王子の
秘めたる計画を
MsgEn:
... The secret plans of Prince Nedo, 
the Arisen of Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
心配かけちゃいましたね
それで、王子はやっぱり――
MsgEn:
I'm sorry for causing concern.
So, the prince is indeed—

MsgJp:
王子のことは気掛かりだが――
これ以上、事態を引き伸ばすことも叶わぬ
MsgEn:
I'm concerned about the prince, but—
we can no longer afford to delay the situation.

MsgJp:
王子の足の運びを考えると、あと少しで
悪しき竜の元へ辿り着くはずだよ
MsgEn:
Considering the prince's pace, he should be
reaching the Evil Dragon soon.

MsgJp:
全てが予定通りという訳にはいかなかったが
我らと大陸の未来は決することになろう
MsgEn:
While things didn't go exactly as planned, 
our fate, and that of the continent 
will be decided.

MsgJp:
ずっと、悪しき竜に踏み潰されるか
焼き殺されることばかり考えていたんだ
MsgEn:
I've been constantly thinking about either being
crushed or burned alive by the Evil Dragon.

MsgJp:
ほら、エリオットを残して隊長たちが
レスタニアに帰って――
MsgEn:
Look, with Elliot left behind and the captain
and others returning to Lestania—

MsgJp:
また戻ってきた、あの日までね
あの日、わたしは、本気で希望を信じることにした
MsgEn:
I came back again, up until that day.
On that day, 
I resolved to genuinely believe in hope.

MsgJp:
あなたたちがいなかったら
わたしはここまで戦えなかった
MsgEn:
Without you all, 
I couldn't have fought to this point.

MsgJp:
レスタニアじゃあな、事が終わる前に
礼を言うのはひどく縁起が悪いんだ
MsgEn:
In Lestania, thanking someone before
things are finished is considered bad luck.

MsgJp: そうなの？　じゃあ、取り消すよ
MsgEn: Really?　Then I take it back.

MsgJp:
では隊長、いよいよですね
精一杯、王子の力になってあげましょう
MsgEn:
Well then, Captain, it's finally time.
Let's do our best to help the prince!

MsgJp:
きっと、うまくいくよ
理由はわからないんだけど――
MsgEn:
I'm sure it'll work out.
I don't know why--

MsgJp:
近くに隊長を感じると、勇気とか力が
湧いてくるんだよね
MsgEn:
When the captain is near, I feel my courage and
strength growing.

MsgJp: ああ、まるで竜の加護の如くってやつだな
MsgEn: Ah, it's like the dragon's blessing, isn't it?

MsgJp: 隊長は不思議な人だね
MsgEn: The Captain is a strange person.

MsgJp:
さあ、思い残すことがなくなったんなら――
出発するぞ
MsgEn:
Now, if you've got nothing left to think about--
we're off!

MsgJp:
フィンダムで起こったことは
レスタニアの使者の方から聞いています
MsgEn:
The Lestanian emissaries have told me what
happened in Phindym.

MsgJp:
これがどれほど深刻な事態なのか
わかっているつもりです
MsgEn:
I believe I grasp the severity
of this situation.

MsgJp:
火竜の竜力は今、僕の中にあります
黒竜を倒すということであれば――
MsgEn:
The Fire Dragon's power now resides within me.
If it's to defeat the Black Dragon—

MsgJp: 大陸の各地に闇の魔物が現れました！！
MsgEn: Dark beasts have emerged throughout the continent!

MsgJp:
すでにメイロワ将軍が中心となって
対応に当たっていますが――
MsgEn:
General Meirova is already leading the response efforts,
but—

MsgJp:
同時にメガド上空に大きな黒い渦が出現し
このままでは王都が闇に呑まれてしまいます！
MsgEn:
At the same time, 
a large black vortex has appeared above Megado, 
and if things continue like this,
the royal capital will be engulfed in darkness!

MsgJp: わかりました、すぐに向かいます
ああ、わかってる、任せろ！

王子、大丈夫
やっつけてから、話の続きをしよう
MsgEn:
Prince, everything will be fine. 
After we handle this,
we can continue talking.

MsgJp: さぁ、行きましょう、隊長！
城内の敵がやけに少ない
MsgEn: There are awfully few enemies in the castle.

MsgJp: それにしても少ねえぞ
MsgEn: Even so, there are fewer than expected.

MsgJp: 隊長、黒騎士はいったいどこに――
MsgEn: Captain, where the hell is the Black Knight...

MsgJp: 迷うな！　将の首を目指すぞ！
MsgEn:
Don't get lost! 
We're going for the general's head!

MsgJp:
もうひと押し――
離れずに固まって動くよ！
MsgEn:
One more push—
stay close and move together!
I might not be feeling well either—

MsgJp:
ガハハハ！　愚かなヤツラめ
まんまとかかりおったわ！
MsgEn:
Gahaha! You fools,
you fell for it completely!

MsgJp: 黒き騎士の力を思い知るがいい！
MsgEn:
You will come to understand the power of 
the Black Knight!

MsgJp:
無念――！！
引き上げるぞ！

退路を失えば全滅するぞ！
全員、来た道を戻れ！　退却だ！
MsgEn:
If we lose our way out, we're done for!
Everyone, return the way you came! Fall back!

MsgJp:
見ての通り、このあたりのオークは追い払った
戦の将を討ったお陰で、メガドの戦力は落ちている
MsgEn:
As you can see, the Orcs around here are gone.
Taking down the War Master 
has weakened Megado's forces.

MsgJp: ジリアンの獅子奮迅の活躍に心が震えました
MsgEn: Gillian's heroic efforts moved me deeply.

MsgJp:
そこに隊長たちが参戦してくれるのですから
我々の勝利は確実
MsgEn:
Now that you captains are joining the battle,
our triumph is certain.

MsgJp: ここは一気に押し込むべきと思いますが
MsgEn:
I believe now is the time 
for a decisive push forward.

MsgJp: 集いし我が臣民、いや同志たちよ
MsgEn: Gather together, my subjects, nay, comrades.

MsgJp:
皆の知る通り、この地は絶望の沼に
沈みかけていました
MsgEn:
As we all know, this land
was about to sink into a swamp of despair.

MsgJp:
僕らは敗北と死に慣れてしまって
心を奮い立たせる術を忘れてしまっていた
MsgEn:
We became so used to loss and death,
we forgot how to stir our hearts.

MsgJp:
でも、そんな日々はもう終わります
活気と笑顔でいっぱいの王都メガドを思いだそう！
MsgEn:
But those days are coming to an end.
Let's remember Megado, full of life and smiles!

MsgJp:
それはすぐそこにあるんだ
少し手を伸ばせば、取り戻すことができるんだ
MsgEn:
It's right there.
If we just stretch out a bit, we can reclaim it.

MsgJp:
僕らのメガドにやつらの居場所はない！
さあ、皆で追いだしてやろう！
MsgEn:
There's no place for them in our Megado!
Come, let's drive them out together!

MsgJp: うおーー！！！（雄叫び、リアクションボイス）
おーー！！（雄叫び、リアクションボイス）
おーー！！（雄叫び、リアクションボイス）
おーー！！（雄叫び、リアクションボイス）
おーー！！（雄叫び、リアクションボイス）
貴様！　そこをどかんか！
この場所はアッカー家当主ネド王子のものだ
MsgEn: This is the property of Prince Nedo of House Acre.

MsgJp: ふん、傷深くして、動けんか！
MsgEn: Hmph, have your wounds left you unable to move!?

MsgJp: 来ると思っていたぞ、白竜の覚者よ
MsgEn:
I knew you would come, 
Arisen of the White Dragon.

MsgJp: ふんっ！（リアクションボイス）
グウゥッ！！！（リアクションボイス）
ンンッ！！！（リアクションボイス）

クッ、待っていたとでも言うのか？
傷で動けなかったくせに
MsgEn:
Hmph, did you think I was waiting for you?
I couldn't move due to my injuries.

MsgJp: 傷？　この身は空ろだ
MsgEn: Injuries? I am a mere shell.

MsgJp: 空（から）？　そもそもあんた何者！？
MsgEn:
A shell? 
What are you, to begin with!?

MsgJp: 黒き竜に連なる、理から外れた者
MsgEn:
One who is beyond order,
connected to the Black Dragon.

MsgJp: 理の中の貴様らには理解できまい
MsgEn:
Those of you who are limited by order
cannot grasp it.

MsgJp: それよりもあの男の居場所を知りたくはないか？
MsgEn:
More than that, 
wouldn't you like to know where that man is?

MsgJp: わたしに剣を突き立て、危うくしたあの男――
MsgEn:
The man who drove me to the brink 
by thrusting a sword into me—

MsgJp: 暗闇の海で溺れかけているわ
MsgEn: He's drowning in a sea of darkness.

MsgJp:
ふざけんなよ――
話はてめえをぶっ倒してからだ！
MsgEn:
Don't mess with me—
we'll talk after I've taken you down!

MsgJp: ぬんっ（リアクションボイス）
たわむれは、ここまでだ――

MsgEn: This isn't good, we should flee!

MsgJp: うわっ（リアクションボイス）
はっ！！（リアクションボイス）
はっ（リアクションボイス）
うっ――（リアクションボイス）

MsgEn: You are not to be forgiven!!!

MsgJp: あなたたちとの時は黄金のように輝いていた
MsgEn: The moments with you were as bright as gold.

MsgJp: ううん、まるで希望のように――
MsgEn: No, it was like hope itself—

MsgJp:
剣はこっちにある――
目的は果たせたみたいだ
MsgEn:
The sword is over here --
it looks like the goal has been achieved

MsgJp:
ジリアン――
君が無事で良かった――

おお――
この光景を何度夢に見たことか――
MsgEn:
Oh--
how many times I've dreamed of this sight--

MsgJp:
いい風が吹いてきたよ
ほら、オークどもの臭いが消えていくだろう？
MsgEn:
A good wind is picking up.
See, the smell of the orcs is fading away, right?

MsgJp: 一度、展望城へ戻り、次の作戦を練るとしよう
MsgEn:
Let's go back to the Lookout Castle 
and plan our next strategy.

MsgJp:
ふむ――
これまで何度も口にしてきたはずだが――
MsgEn:
Hmmm--
I'm sure I've mentioned this many times before--

MsgJp: ついに覚悟を決めねばならん時が近付いている
MsgEn:
The time when we must finally 
make up our minds is approaching.

MsgJp: 立ち止まることも許されませんね
良く言いましたぞネド王子！
さあ、我ら、力を合わせて悪しき竜を倒すのだ
MsgEn: Now, we must join forces and slay the evil dragon!

MsgJp:
散った命と流れた血を刃（やいば）に変えて
邪悪な竜に突き立ててやろうではないか！
MsgEn:
Let us turn the scattered lives and spilled blood 
into blades and drive them into the evil dragon!

MsgJp:
戦いの準備はこちらでしておきますから
早くレスタニアへ！　白竜様の下へ！
MsgEn:
We'll prepare for the battle here, 
so hurry to Lestania!
To the White Dragon's side!

MsgJp: ネド王子はまだ見つからないよ
MsgEn: Prince Nedo hasn't been found yet.

MsgJp: しかし、ここに来た形跡はあるな
MsgEn: However, there are traces of him coming here.
What do you mean by traces?

MsgJp:
ここには古くより王家に伝わる
竜骨の笛が祀られていた
MsgEn:
This place has long enshrined a dragon bone flute
that has been passed down through the royal family.

MsgJp:
原初の竜の骨で作ったと言われているが
真偽はわからん
MsgEn:
It is said to be made from the bones 
of the primordial dragon,
but the truth is unknown.

MsgJp:
その笛がなくなっているということは――
王子はここに来たのだろうよ
MsgEn:
The fact that that flute is missing...
I'm sure the prince has been here.

MsgJp: その笛にはどんな意味があるんです？
MsgEn: What is the meaning of that flute?

MsgJp:
重要な意味がある――
我々が竜に挑むための秘策そのものだ
MsgEn:
It carries vital significance...
It is the very key to our strategy 
against the dragon.

MsgJp:
――竜から覚者への竜力の継承は
竜骨の笛の音に乗せて行われるのだ
MsgEn:
...The dragon's power is passed to the Arisen
through the sound of the dragon bone flute.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の正体が我らの火竜様の血肉と
竜力だと考えれば――
MsgEn:
If we consider that the true nature of the Evil Dragon
is the blood and power of our Fire Dragon...

MsgJp:
ネド王子が笛の音の力を借りて
竜力を継承できる可能性が高い
MsgEn:
There is a strong possibility that Prince Nedo
can inherit the Dragon Force through with the flute.

MsgJp:
竜力を奪ってしまえば、悪しき竜は
竜のかたちをした魔物に過ぎない
MsgEn:
If you take away the Dragon Force, the Evil Dragon
is just a monster, in the shape of a dragon.

MsgJp:
あとは我らが総力を結集して
その魔物を倒せばよい
MsgEn:
After that, we can gather all our strength 
and defeat that monster.

MsgJp:
メガドを奪回した夜も
王子には、再度ご説明申し上げた
MsgEn:
The night we took back Megado,
I made sure to explain it to the Prince again.

MsgJp:
それを知った上で王子は単独行動を選んだ――
わからないな――
MsgEn:
Knowing that, the Prince chose to act alone...
It's unclear why...

MsgJp: あんまり悠長にしている時間はねえぞ
MsgEn: We don't have much time to waste.

MsgJp: 次に王子が向かう先を考えようぜ
MsgEn: Let's figure out where the Prince is headed next.
Impressive, Arisen of the White Dragon—

MsgJp: だが、我を滅ぼすことはこの世から闇を消すに等しい
MsgEn:
However, destroying me is akin to 
erasing the darkness from this world.

MsgJp: 戦の将は討ち果たしたぞ！
MsgEn: The War Master has been defeated!

MsgJp: 勝った！　オークたちが撤退して行く！
MsgEn: We won! The orcs are retreating!

MsgJp:
レスタニアの覚者らよ
おぬしらの力あっての勝利！
MsgEn:
Arisen of Lestania,
your might brought us this triumph!

MsgJp:
さあ、次はわしらが力になろう
レスタニアで何か起こったのであろう？
MsgEn:
Now, we shall support you.
Has something occurred in Lestania?

MsgJp:
――以上が、白竜様とレスタニアの
様子です
MsgEn:
...This is the current situation
with the White Dragon and Lestania.

MsgJp:
隊長が戻ってきてくださったので
すっかり問題は解決したものだと――
MsgEn:
I thought the matter was resolved
with the Captain's return...

MsgJp:
レスタニアの白竜と覚者達が
今なおそのような事態にあるとは――
MsgEn:
To think that Lestania's White Dragon and Arisen
are still in such dire straits...

MsgJp:
そしてメガドに居座るという
黒き鎧の騎士――
MsgEn:
And the black-armored knight
who lingers in Megado...

MsgJp:
しかし、これで我々の目的は一致したと
いうわけだ
MsgEn: But now our goals are aligned.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランとレスタニアという
２本の槍で――
MsgEn: With the two lances of Acre Selund and Lestania...

MsgJp: 黒騎士を討ち、メガドを取り戻すのだ
MsgEn: Defeat the Black Knight and reclaim Megado.

MsgJp: 隊長、皆で力を合わせて黒騎士を倒しましょう！
MsgEn:
Captain, let's join forces and 
defeat the Black Knight together!

MsgJp:
悪しき竜によるアッカーシェランへの侵攻は
失敗に終わり――
MsgEn:
The invasion of Acre Selund by 
the Evil Dragon ended in failure...

MsgJp:
そして、フィンダム、アッカーシェランに続いて
ここレスタニアでも竜の力の継承が行われた
MsgEn:
And then, following Phindym and Acre Selund,
the dragon's power was also passed on,
here in Lestania.

MsgJp: 新たな時代の扉が開こうとしていたのだ
MsgEn:
The door to a new era was 
on the verge of opening.

MsgJp:
しかし、まだ、混沌の元凶は消えず
闇の中で渦巻いていた
MsgEn:
Yet the source of the chaos still lingered, 
swirling in the dark.

MsgJp:
人は古来より闇を怖れながらも
惹きつけられてきた
MsgEn:
Throughout history,
mankind fears the shadows,
yet is also pulled towards it.

MsgJp:
理を巡る根源的な問いの答えが
闇の中に隠されていると信じる者は――
MsgEn:
Those who think the truth behind the laws of order
lies concealed in the dark...

MsgJp: いつの世も絶えたことはない
MsgEn:
Such people have never ceased to exist
throughout the ages.
Do you want to debug it?

MsgJp: どっちのモーションを見る？
どのモーションを見る？
MsgEn: Which motion would you like to see?

MsgJp: 000 ナイトウォーカー待機LOOP
003 尋問対象に語りかける
015 PL側を向く～選択待ち待機LOOP
MsgEn:
015 Facing the PL side – 
Awaiting selection, standby LOOP

MsgJp: 025 PLの視点を変える（尋問失敗）
どのモーションを見る？
MsgEn: Which motion would you like to see?

MsgJp: 030 ゴロツキ　尋問開始時　座り待機
MsgEn: 030 Thug Sit back and wait when the interrogation starts

MsgJp: 040 ゴロツキ　ピンチ時　座り待機
MsgEn: 040 Thug - Sitting and Waiting During Emergency
Is this your first time interrogating?

MsgJp:
尋問では、欲しい情報を引き出すことが目的だ
そのために、質問したり
証拠となるアイテムを突きつけたり
時には脅して口を割らせることが必要となる
MsgEn:
In an interrogation, 
the goal is to extract the desired information. 
To achieve this, you must ask questions, 
present evidence, and sometimes use threats
to force a confession.

MsgJp:
――まぁ、実際やってみるのが早いだろう
まずは、コイツに聞いてみたい《話題》を
選択してくれ
俺が聞き出してやるからな
MsgEn:
—Well, it's probably best to just try it out. 
First, 
choose a "topic" you want to ask this guy about. 
I'll get the information for you.

MsgJp: そうだな、今日はここまでにしよう――
MsgEn: Well, I guess that's it for today--

MsgJp:
と、いつもなら言いたいところだが
そういう訳にはいかないんでな
MsgEn:
I'd usually say that, 
but it's not that simple this time.

MsgJp:
これからお前には何度も尋問を行ってもらう
そのためにも、尋問のやり方に慣れてもらわないとな
MsgEn:
We're going to be conducting 
a lot of interrogations with you.
That's why we're going to have to get you 
familiar with how to conduct one.

MsgJp:
まずは基本的な情報を聞いてみるのがいいだろう
<COL ff2600>《話題》</COL>を選んでくれ
MsgEn:
I suggest asking for some basic information first.
Pick a <COL ff2600>"topic".</COL>

MsgJp: さて――まずは名前から聞いてみるか

うう――俺が一体何したってんだ
てめぇら絶対に許さねえぞ
MsgEn:
Ugh—What have I even done? 
I'll never forgive you all!

MsgJp:
おい、聞こえなかったか？
名前を聞いてんだよ
MsgEn:
Hey, didn't you hear me?
I asked you what your name was.

MsgJp: ケッ――てめぇらなんかに誰が言うかよ
MsgEn: Tch—Who would say anything to the likes of you?

MsgJp:
お前が話題を選び、俺がやりとりすることで
尋問は進んでいく
――だが、なかなか口を割りそうにないな
MsgEn:
You choose the topics, 
and I'll handle the questioning. 

—But it looks like they're not 
going to open up easily.

MsgJp:
<COL ff2600>だから、"脅す"ことで追加情報を探ったり
決定的な "《証拠》を突きつける"ことで
口を割らざるを得ない状況に追い込んでいくんだ</COL>
MsgEn:
<COL ff2600>So, you'll need to either "intimidate" them 
to extract more information or 
"present decisive evidence" to force them into a 
situation where they have no choice but to talk.</COL>

MsgJp:
――ちょうど、コイツを確保した際に
《証拠》として使えそうな物があった
今回は、それを使ってみよう
MsgEn:
--Just when we secured this guy,
we found something we could use as "evidence".
Let's use it this time.

MsgJp:
さぁ、やってみろ
"脅す"ことでさらなる情報を引き出したり
"《証拠》を突きつける"ことで尋問を進め
ヤツを追い詰めることができるぞ
MsgEn:
Go ahead. 
You can use "intimidation" to extract more 
information or "present evidence" to advance the 
interrogation and corner them.

MsgJp:
この生意気なゴロツキに、一泡吹かせてやろう
さぁ―― "《証拠》を突きつける" んだ
MsgEn:
Let's put this cheeky thug in his place. 
Now—present the evidence.

MsgJp: これがなんだか分かるか？
MsgEn: Do you know what this is?

MsgJp:
あっ！
俺のナイフ――返せ！

少しかすれているが――柄に文字が刻んであるな？
BーAーSーIーT――
MsgEn:
It's a little faint, 
but it's engraved on the handle, isn't it?
B-A-S-I-T—

MsgJp:
かなり使い込まれた古い物だが、この彫り癖は
<NPC 3274>のものだな
MsgEn:
This is a very worn old item, 
but this carving pattern is 
definitely from <NPC 3274>.

MsgJp:
奴が得物に掘る、銘以外の文字となると
おそらくこれは持ち主の名前――
MsgEn:
Since it's not an inscription on the weapon, 
this must be the owner's name.
In other words, your name is...

MsgJp:
――ハァ？
何言ってんだ、お前――
MsgEn:
- Huh?
What are you talking about, you—

MsgJp:
今のように、重要な選択を選び損なったり
突きつける《証拠》を間違えることは
あまりオススメできない
MsgEn:
Making mistakes in important choices or 
presenting the wrong evidence, as you did now, 
is not advisable.

MsgJp:
失敗を繰り返し、あまりに目に余るようなら――
俺のやり方で、手を下させてもらう
MsgEn:
Should you persist in making mistakes to the 
point of being unacceptable, 
I'll deal with it my way.

MsgJp:
簡単に言えば――<COL ff2600>尋問失敗を一定回数繰り返すと
それ以上尋問を行えなくなり、終了となる</COL>
気を付けろよ
MsgEn:
In simple terms, 
<COL ff2600>if you fail the interrogation a certain number 
of times, you won't be able to continue 
and it will end.</COL> 
Be careful.
In other words, your name is...

MsgJp:
――だ、だからどうしたってんだ？
別に、<NPC 691>なんて珍しい名前じゃねえだろ
MsgEn:
And what of it? 
<NPC 691> isn't exactly a rare name.

MsgJp:
よし、コイツの名前は<NPC 691>で間違いなさそうだ
言葉は強気だが、動揺しているみたいだな
MsgEn:
Alright, this guy's name is definitely <NPC 691>. 
He sounds confident, but he's clearly nervous.

MsgJp:
時には、脅すことで《尋問》や《諜報活動》の
ヒントとなる話が聞けることもある
――だが、むやみにやりすぎるなよ
MsgEn:
Threatening can sometimes yield useful 
information for interrogations or 
intelligence operations, but don't go overboard.

MsgJp:
さて――――
おい！
粋がっていられるのも今のうちだぞ
MsgEn:
Now then―――― 
Hey! Enjoy your bravado while it still lasts.

MsgJp:
お、俺が嘘ついてるとでも言うのかよ？
俺はメガド生まれメガド育ち――
地元を愛するただのゴロツキさ
MsgEn:
Oh, are you saying I'm lying?
I was born and raised in Megado—
I'm just a thug who loves his hometown.

MsgJp:
そうか、そんなに地元っ子だと言うのなら――
お前の身元を保証する家族や友人はいるんだろうな
MsgEn:
Well, if you're such a local boy--
I'm sure you have family and friends who can 
vouch for your identity.

MsgJp:
黙っちまったぞ、分かりやすい男だな
どうやら周辺人物を探られると困るらしい
――この男について、聞き込みしてみるか
MsgEn:
He's gone mute; what a straightforward fellow. 
It looks like he's uncomfortable with 
questions about his associates. 

— How about we investigate him further?

MsgJp:
だが、正体を暴くためにはさらなる証拠が必要だ
<COL ff2600>そして――それらの証拠は
《潜入調査》と《諜報活動》によって入手できる</COL>
MsgEn:
However, in order to uncover the true identity, further evidence is needed.
<COL ff2600>And—those pieces of evidence can be obtained 
through "undercover" and "intelligence activities."</COL>

MsgJp:
<COL ff2600>《尋問》</COL>、<COL ff2600>《潜入調査》</COL>そして<COL ff2600>《諜報活動》</COL>
その３つがお前と俺が取り組む任務の軸となる
――よく覚えておいてくれ
MsgEn:
<COL ff2600>Interrogation</COL>, <COL ff2600>undercover work</COL>, and <COL ff2600>espionage</COL>
are the three pillars of the mission 
that you and I will be working on.
-- Remember that.

MsgJp:
あぁ、最後に――言い忘れていたが
<COL ff2600>任務は、それぞれ1日に１度のみ行うことができる</COL>
MsgEn:
Oh, lastly — I forgot to mention that each
<COL ff2600>mission can only be performed once a day</COL>

MsgJp:
尋問に臨む前に、入念な調査と
《証拠》の収集を忘れないように気をつけろ
MsgEn:
Be careful not to forget to do thorough research 
and gather "evidence" before going in 
for an interrogation.

MsgJp:
さて――今日はこれで終わりにしよう
協力、感謝する
MsgEn:
Well--let's call it a day.
Thanks for your help, I appreciate it.

MsgJp: ――今日はこのくらいにしてやるか
本当に、今日の尋問はこれで終了にしていいんだな？
MsgEn: Are you sure you want to call it quits on today's interrogation?

MsgJp:
――その《証拠》を突きつけるのは
ここではなさそうだな
MsgEn:
It seems that presenting that evidence isn't 
the right approach here.

MsgJp:
脅してさらなる情報を引き出したり
諜報で新たな《証拠》を探すのもいい
――もう一度よく考えてみるんだ
MsgEn:
You can threaten them to extract more information 
or search for new evidence using intelligence
— think about it again.

- Huh?
What are you talking about?

MsgJp:
とぼけているようには見えない――
その選択は、事実と異なっているようだ
MsgEn:
It doesn't seem like he's playing dumb-- 
That choice appears to be incorrect.

MsgJp: もう一度、良く考えてみろ

のんびりとお喋りするつもりはない
一度痛い目を見ないと、どうやら
この男には分かってもらえないらしいな
MsgEn:
I'm not here to have a leisurely chat. 
It seems this man won't understand 
until he experiences some pain.

MsgJp:
覚者、少しあっちを向いていろ
お前に見せるには
少し刺激が強いからな――
MsgEn:
Arisen, look away for a moment.
What I'm about to do is a bit too intense for 
you to see.

MsgJp:
まったく、手こずらせやがって
明日はもう少し喋る気になるだろう――
MsgEn:
You're a real hassle.
By tomorrow, you'll be more willing to talk.

MsgJp: さぁ、何について尋ねようか？
MsgEn: Now, what shall I ask about?

MsgJp:
さて、<NPC 691>――
一体何者なのか教えてもらおうか
MsgEn:
Now then, <NPC 691>—
it's time you tell us who you really are.

MsgJp:
名乗るほどのモンじゃねえよ――
字も書けなきゃ、宿も無し
その日暮らしの無頼漢さ
MsgEn:
Not worth introducing—
no writing skills, no home,
just a vagabond scraping by.

MsgJp:
ふざけるな！
お前はナヴィドの屋敷から出た俺達を尾行していた
――ヤツの手の者か？
MsgEn:
Cut the crap!
You were tracking us after we left Navid's place.
—Are you one of his lackeys?

MsgJp:
ナヴィドって――<NPC 681>・クルト侯爵のことか？
おいおい、何の話か知らねえが面倒事はごめんだぞ！
MsgEn:
Navid? As in Marquis Kurt <NPC 681>?
Hey, whatever this is, 
count me out of your problems!

MsgJp:
チッ――おとなしく答えてはくれないか
コイツが<COL ff2600>ただのゴロツキではない可能性を示す
《証拠》</COL>があればいいんだが――
MsgEn:
Tch... He won't talk easily.
We need some 
<COL ff2600>evidence to show he's more than just a thug...</COL>
So what are we going to do?

MsgJp:
この辺り一帯を仕切る、お前たちゴロツキどもの
リーダーが最近変わったようだな
ちゃんと挨拶したのか？
MsgEn:
The one in charge of your gang around here 
seems to have changed.
Have you introduced yourself yet?

MsgJp:
は――あ、当たり前だろ
急になんだよ
MsgEn:
Ah, of course I did.
What's with the sudden question?

MsgJp:
そのリーダーはある特技があるらしくてな
なんと――縄張りにいる奴ら全員の顔と名前を
記憶しているんだそうだ
MsgEn:
Apparently, the leader has a special skill
- he remembers the faces and names
of everyone in his territory!

MsgJp:
さっき俺は、「挨拶をしたか？」と聞いた
――それにお前は「当たり前だ」と答えた
MsgEn:
Earlier I asked you, "Did you say hello?"
-- to which you replied, "Of course."

MsgJp:
ならば、当然リーダーは
お前のことを知っているはずだろうな？
MsgEn:
If so, of course the leader
should know about you, right?

MsgJp:
だが、アイツははっきりと
「<NPC 691>なんか知らない」と言っていた
MsgEn:
However, he clearly said
"I don't know anything about<NPC 691>"

MsgJp:
そ、そんな――
たまたま忘れていただけって可能性もあるだろ！
MsgEn:
W-well, that's just—
It's possible he just happened to forget!

MsgJp:
それはない――このリストを見ろ
これには、メガドの宿無したちが全員記されている
MsgEn:
That's not possible— 
Look at this list. 
It includes everyone without a home in Megado.

MsgJp:
最近は、憲兵の取り締まりやらオークの襲撃やら
物騒なことが増えているから――ということらしいが
MsgEn:
Lately, 
with increased patrols by the Military Police and 
attacks by orcs, 
it seems there's been more unrest.

MsgJp:
ご立派なことに、自警団ヅラして
水面下でこんなモンを作成していた
MsgEn:
Impressive, 
pretending to be a noble vigilante while secretly 
making something like this.

MsgJp:
当然、このリストにお前の名前はない
――お前は一体何者だ？
MsgEn:
Of course, your name is not on this list
--who the hell are you?

MsgJp:
よし、言い逃れできないところまで追いつめたぞ
別の《話題》も聞いてみるか
MsgEn:
Got you cornered with no way out now. 
Let's ask about another topic.

MsgJp:
この男――<NPC 691>の身元か
結局分からず仕舞いだったな
MsgEn: We still haven't figured out this man's identity—<NPC 691>.

MsgJp:
少なくともただのゴロツキではないことは判明した
――この"証言"でな
MsgEn:
At least we've confirmed 
he's not just a common thug—
thanks to this "testimony."

MsgJp:
コイツから引き出せる情報はまだあるはずだ
尋問を続けよう
MsgEn:
There must be more information we can extract from this guy.
Let's keep interrogating him.

MsgJp: さぁ、何について尋ねようか？
MsgEn: Now, what shall I ask about?

MsgJp:
ところで――
尾行の目的はなんなんだ？
MsgEn:
By the way--
what's the purpose of the tail?

MsgJp:
尾行？
ハッ――もっと可愛いもんだろ

ちょーっと――
後をついて行っただけじゃねえか

何の目的で？
一目惚れでもしたってのか？
MsgEn:
For what purpose?
Love at first sight?

MsgJp:
そこで眺めてるヤツが、メガドを解放した
張本人だってのは一目見て気付いた
そして思ったのさ――相当懐も温かいはずだ、とね
MsgEn:
The person watching from that spot is clearly the 
one who freed Megado. 
It was obvious just by looking. 
I figured they must be quite wealthy.

MsgJp: なるほどな、そりゃ納得だ

オーク軍を壊滅させた戦士を
一介のゴロツキでしかないお前が追い剥ぎか
MsgEn:
Is someone as insignificant as you, 
just a common thug, 
really going to rob the warrior who wiped 
out the Orc army?

MsgJp:
お――俺達には失うモノなんて無いからな
一攫千金を常に狙ってんだよ、文句あんのか？
MsgEn:
W-We've got nothing to lose, 
so we're always aiming for a big score. 
Got a problem with that?

MsgJp:
そうか――
覚者とやり合って、勝てる勝算はあったんだな？
MsgEn:
I see—
so you thought you had a chance of winning 
against the Arisen?

MsgJp:
そんなのいちいち計算しねーよ
ひらめいて、体が勝手に動いちまった
MsgEn:
I don't calculate that every single time.
I got inspired, and my body moved on its own.

MsgJp:
――なぁ
頼むよ、ほんの出来心なんだよ、許してくれ
MsgEn:
Look, it was just a lapse in judgment. 
Please, forgive me.

MsgJp:
――だ、そうだ
なんとかこの話を覆せる《証拠》はないものか――
MsgEn:
--So.
Is there any way to counter this with 
some evidence?

MsgJp:
あの辺り――
ずいぶんと子供が多いようだな？
MsgEn:
In that area―― 
It looks like there are a lot of children, 
doesn't it?

MsgJp:
あ？　ああ――
みんな戦争で親とはぐれたり、失ったりで
身を寄せ合って暮らしてるのさ
MsgEn:
What? Oh―― 
They've lost their parents or been separated from 
them because of the war, 
so they're sticking together.

MsgJp:
お前が衝動的に、俺達を追い剥ぎしようと
尾行したあの時も――傍に子供がいたみたいだな
MsgEn:
When you followed us impulsively to rob us, 
it seems there were children nearby as well.

MsgJp:
あの辺りは毎日彼らが見回りをしているそうだ
――もちろん知っているな？
MsgEn:
Apparently, 
they keep watch over that area every day—
I'm sure you know that, right?

MsgJp:
その子は、お前の顔を見たことがあるそうだ
しかも、何度も――な
MsgEn:
That kid has seen your face before.
And more than once--yeah.

MsgJp:
その子の話によると、お前――
コソコソしながらずいぶんと熱心に
何かを書き付けていたそうじゃないか
MsgEn:
According to the boy, you--
were sneaking around and writing
something down with a lot of enthusiasm!

MsgJp:
お前――
「字も書けなきゃ宿も無い」んじゃなかったのか？
MsgEn:
You--
I thought you said "no writing skills, no home"?

MsgJp:
あの日も、お前が物陰でせっせと
メモしていた姿を目撃したそうだ
MsgEn:
That day, too, it seems that they saw you busily 
taking notes in the shadows.

MsgJp:
ずいぶんと――
"用意周到な追い剥ぎ" だな？
MsgEn: Seems like you're a "well-prepared mugger," huh?

MsgJp:
ここまで《証拠》は揃っているんだ
いい加減に――――
MsgEn:
Evidence has been gathered up to this point. 
It's about time to――――

MsgJp:
それで勝ったつもりか？
バカバカしい！
MsgEn:
And you think you've won?
That's ridiculous!

MsgJp:
《証拠》なんて物で追い詰めたつもりだろうが――
憲兵の取り調べごっこはもう終わりだ！
MsgEn:
You thought you could corner me with this 
"evidence," but―― 
The charade of the 
Military Police interrogation is finished!

MsgJp:
俺がお前たちを尾行してメモしていたって？
それを子供が見ていたって？
――それを確固たる《証拠》だと言い張るのか？
MsgEn:
I was following you guys and taking notes?
A kid was watching it?
— Are you arguing that's solid "proof"?

MsgJp:
子供がなんと言おうと、身体検査された時に
そのメモが出てこなかった――
MsgEn:
Even if the child says otherwise, 
that note wasn't found during the body check.

MsgJp:
それこそが動かぬ事実だ
そうだろう、覚者さんよぉ――
MsgEn:
That is the irrefutable truth. 
Isn't that so, Arisen--

MsgJp:
――やれやれ
"<NPC 691>が書いていたメモ"――
その現物を見せるまで一歩も譲らないつもりか
MsgEn:
--Well then. 
Are you set on not giving in until you see the 
actual note written by <NPC 691>?

MsgJp:
覚者、この勝ち誇った腹立たしいツラに
そのメモとやらを突きつけてやろう
MsgEn:
Arisen, let's shove that note into 
this smug, infuriating face.

MsgJp:
お前が言っているそのメモ――
もしかして、この汚い紙束のことか？
MsgEn:
That note you're talking about--
Could you possibly be talking about this 
dirty stack of papers?

MsgJp:
字が汚くて読みづらいが――どうやら
覚者がとった行動が事細かに書かれているようだな
MsgEn:
The writing is sloppy and difficult to decipher, 
but it appears to describe the Arisen's actions 
in meticulous detail.

MsgJp: 一体どこで手に入れたかって？
MsgEn: Where the hell did you get it?

MsgJp:
上手く隠したつもりかもしれないが――
子供ってのは、見つけちゃいけないものを
うっかり掘り返す天才なのさ
MsgEn:
You may think you've hidden it well--
Kids are geniuses at accidentally digging
up things they shouldn't find.

MsgJp:
さて――こいつが俺達を尾行して
行動を探っていたということは
尾行メモの存在によって判明したな
MsgEn:
Well--we know that this guy was following us and 
probing our activities because of the existence of
the tailing notes.

MsgJp:
だが、ただの熱狂的ファンというにはあまりに――
内容が隙を突くことに特化しすぎている
まるで――暗殺を狙っているかのようにな
MsgEn:
However, it's too focused on exploiting 
vulnerabilities to be merely that of an 
enthusiastic fan. 

It's almost as if they're aiming for 
assassination.

MsgJp:
やったな、新しい情報を入手したぞ
やはり、この男の背後には
大きな影が動いているようだ
MsgEn:
Well done, we've acquired new information. 
It appears that a significant force is at work 
behind this man.

MsgJp:
俺はそれが――<NPC 681>だという確信がある
だが、まだ証拠が弱い
MsgEn:
I'm reasonably sure it's <NPC 681>,
but the evidence is still weak.

MsgJp:
――さぁ、尋問を続けよう
必ずヤツの尻尾を掴んでやる！
MsgEn:
Let's resume the interrogation. 
We're going to get to the bottom of this!

MsgJp:
<NPC 691>が書いたメモの発見によって
やはり俺達を複数回に渡って尾行していたことが
判明したな
MsgEn:
The memo written by <NPC 691> reveals that we 
were tracked on several occasions.

MsgJp:
だがその動機――
そしてこいつがただのゴロツキでないのなら
一体何者か、それはまだ謎のままだ
MsgEn:
But the motive--
and if this guy isn't just a thug,
who the hell is he? 

That remains a mystery.

MsgJp:
初めての尋問にしては良い調子だぞ
その調子で、さらなる情報を引き出すんだ
MsgEn:
This is a good start for a first interrogation. 
Keep this pace to get more information.

MsgJp:
そろそろ、お前の正体を
教えてくれてもいいんじゃないか？
MsgEn:
Isn't it about time 
you tell me who you really are?

MsgJp:
だーかーら、何度も言っているだろ
俺はメガド生まれメガド育ち、生粋の風来坊さ
MsgEn:
I keep saying it—I'm from Megado, born and raised. 
I'm a genuine drifter.

MsgJp:
一体俺に何の恨みがあってそこまで言い張るんだ？
本当の正体を現せ、なんて
MsgEn:
What grudge do you have against me to insist 
so much? 
Just reveal your true identity already.

MsgJp:
大体、そこまで言うなら《証拠》が
あるんだろうな？
決定的な "俺の正体を示す《証拠》"が――
MsgEn:
If you're going to insist so much, 
then you must have "evidence," right? 
Concrete "proof" of my true identity――

MsgJp: それを見せない限り、俺はもう一言も喋らないぜ
MsgEn:
I'm not saying another word 
unless you show that to me.

MsgJp:
やれやれ――縛られてるってのにずいぶん強気だな
覚者、今持っている《証拠》をもう一度
よく見直してみるんだ
MsgEn:
Good grief―― 
Even though you're tied up, 
you're quite confident. 

Arisen, take another close look 
at the "evidence" you have.

MsgJp:
その中に、コイツの正体を絞り込めそうな――
例えば、<COL ff2600>"共通点"</COL>がある《証拠》は無いか？
可能性でもいい、それらを<COL ff2600>連続で突きつけてやれ！</COL>
MsgEn:
Is there any evidence among those that could help 
narrow down this guy's identity―― 
for example, any <COL ff2600>"Commonalities"</COL> 
that could be significant? 

Even possibilities will do. 
<COL ff2600>Present them one after another!</COL>

MsgJp:
なるほど、これだな
それから？
MsgEn:
Understood, this is it. 
What's next?

MsgJp:
確かに、《薄汚れたメモの束》と
《憲兵の警ら日誌》――
この二つには "共通した書き方" があるみたいだな
MsgEn:
Certainly, "Bundle of Dirty Notes" and
"Military Police Patrol Log" —
seem to have a "common writing style".

MsgJp:
この事実から考えられる、<NPC 691>の正体――
それは一体何だと言うんだ？
MsgEn:
From this fact, 
the possible identity of <NPC 691>--
what the heck would you say that is?

MsgJp:
ああそうだよ！
潜入諜報任務中だったのに、ターゲットに
あっさり捕えられちまった間抜けな憲兵さ！！
MsgEn:
Yeah, that's it! 
I was a fool of a Military Police officer who got 
caught by the target during a covert mission!

MsgJp:
でかしたぞ、覚者
大当たりだ！
MsgEn: Good job, Arisen. You hit the jackpot!

MsgJp:
やはり<NPC 681>から、俺達を尾行するよう
命令を受けていたのか？
MsgEn:
So, you were indeed 
ordered by <NPC 681> to follow us?

MsgJp:
さぁ――どうだかな
俺は上官から命令を受けて動いているだけだ
誰が元締めだかなんて、興味ねえよ
MsgEn:
It's not my concern.
I'm just following the orders I was given.
Who's actually in charge doesn't matter to me.

MsgJp:
それよりも、だ――
本当にマズいのはお前らの方だぞ
MsgEn:
More importantly, though—
You're the ones who are really in trouble.

MsgJp:
憲兵を捕まえて、監禁と尋問なんか――
イタズラで済むような内容じゃないぜ
MsgEn:
Capturing a military police officer, 
locking him up and interrogating him--
This isn't just some prank.

MsgJp: ハッ、そんな脅しでいまさら怖がると思うのか？
MsgEn: Ha, you think such threats will scare me now?

MsgJp:
いいや、それだけじゃない
お前ら――侯爵様に楯突いているとかいう
レジスタンスだろ？
MsgEn:
That's not the whole story.
You're—
resistance members who are opposing 
the Marquis, aren't you?

MsgJp:
このメガドを護っているのは
侯爵様や、俺たち憲兵隊――それが常識だ
MsgEn:
It's understood that the marquis and our 
military police are the ones protecting Megado.

MsgJp:
もし口封じに俺を殺しでもしてみろ
死体が上がれば犯人はお前たちだとすぐに分かる
MsgEn:
If you kill me to cover this up, it will be clear 
that you're the ones responsible as soon as 
my body is discovered.

MsgJp:
そうなれば、レジスタンスは市民の敵と化すだろう
オーク騒ぎがやっと落ち着いた後での、すぐだ
気の立った市民たちはどうすると思う？
MsgEn:
If that happens, the resistance will become the 
enemy of the people. 
It will be right after the orc disturbances 
finally settle down. 

What do you think the angry citizens will do?

MsgJp:
――レジスタンス狩りが始まるだろうな
無駄な血が流れることになるぜ、お前らのせいでな
MsgEn:
--The resistance hunt will start.
There will be a lot of unnecessary bloodshed, 
because of you guys.

MsgJp: 勝手なこと言いやがるぜ

だが怪我をしたのはこちらだけじゃない――
コイツも、下手を打って俺たちに囚われているという
ボロを出してるんだ
MsgEn:
But it's not just us who are hurt—
he's also shown his weakness by getting 
captured by us.

MsgJp:
さぁ、調子に乗っているその口に
《証拠》をねじ込んでやれ
MsgEn:
Now, 
shove that evidence right into his cocky mouth.

MsgJp:
自分の状況を思い出し――
行く末に震え上がる、決定的な《証拠》をな！
MsgEn:
Think about your own situation —
the conclusive evidence that leaves you 
quaking about what's to come!

MsgJp:
フン、なんだその汚い紙束は――
そんなもんで許しを請おうってか？
MsgEn:
Hmph, what's with that pile of filthy papers? 
Are you trying to beg for mercy with that?

MsgJp:
これは、元は憲兵として活躍していた男が
獄中で書いた手記だ
MsgEn:
This is a diary written by a former 
military police officer during his time in prison.

MsgJp:
そ、それがなんだってんだよ
騎士だろうが憲兵だろうが全員が善人って訳じゃねえ
MsgEn:
Well, so what?
Whether you're a knight or a 
military police officer, 
not all of us are good guys.

MsgJp:
――いいやこの男は善人だった
ただ少し、任務に失敗しちまったんだ
MsgEn:
No, this man was a good person. 
He just failed a mission.

MsgJp:
よく聞けよ、<NPC 691>
手が使えないお前の為に読み上げてやる
MsgEn:
Listen carefully,<NPC 691>.
I'll read it aloud for you 
since your hands are bound.

MsgJp:
"それからすぐ同僚の憲兵たちが家に押しかけてきた
  昨日まで背中を預けた相手に縛り上げられるなんて
  一体誰が予想できる？"
MsgEn:
"Soon after, my fellow military police officers 
came barging into my home. 
Who could have predicted being bound by those 
I trusted just yesterday?"

MsgJp:
"獄中の暮らしは、外界から完全に断絶されていて
  残してきた病気のお袋が心配だ"
MsgEn:
"In prison, there's a complete disconnection from 
the outside, and I'm anxious about my sick 
mother whom I left behind."

MsgJp:
"ネド王子の安否は？　オーク軍はどうなった？
  くそ、あんな小さなミス一つでこんな仕打ち！
  もう許せない、俺は出るぞ" ――
MsgEn:
"What about Prince Nedo's safety? 
What happened to the Orc army? 
Damn it, 
to be treated like this over such a small mistake!
 I can't forgive this—I'm getting out of here!"

MsgJp:
奴は脱獄した後、憲兵からの追跡に耐え切れず
この手記を俺たちに手渡してすぐ絶命した
MsgEn:
After he escaped from prison, 
he couldn't withstand being chased by the 
military police and died right after handing over 
this note to us.

MsgJp:
さて――お前は今、任務に失敗して敵に捕らえられ
あまつさえ秘匿情報も漏らしている
MsgEn:
Now then-- 
you've failed your mission, 
been captured by the enemy, 
and even leaked confidential information.

MsgJp:
本当に許しを請うべきなのはどちらか――
わかるな？
MsgEn:
You should understand which of us 
should truly be asking for forgiveness.

MsgJp:
そう落ち込むな
お前にはひとつ、道がある
MsgEn:
Don't be so depressed.
There is a single path for you.

MsgJp:
俺たちに協力し、知る情報を全て提供してくれ
そうすれば身の安全か逃げ道か――
望むものを与えてやる
MsgEn:
Help us and give us all the information you know
and we'll give you either 
personal safety or a way out--
whatever you want.

MsgJp:
お、俺に憲兵隊と侯爵様を裏切って
レジスタンスに入れって言うのか？
MsgEn:
Oh, you want me to betray 
the Military Police and the Marquis
and join the resistance?

MsgJp:
おかしいとは思わないか？
オークの脅威が去って、平和になったはずの街で
今度は憲兵の横暴に脅かされている――
MsgEn:
Don't you think it's strange?
A city that was supposed to be at peace after the 
orc threat was over is now threatened by the 
brutality of the military police--

MsgJp:
諸悪の根源である侯爵――
<NPC 681>を打ち倒してこそ真の平和が訪れる
そうは思わないか
MsgEn:
True peace will come only when the root of all evil, the Marquis--
<NPC 681> is defeated.
Don't you think so?

MsgJp:
――何と言われようと無理なものは無理だ
投獄だろうと処刑だろうと甘んじて受け入れる
MsgEn:
No matter what they say, the impossible is impossible.
I'll accept whatever it is - be it prison or execution.

MsgJp:
くそ！
一体何が、ヤツをここまで頑なにさせる！？
MsgEn:
Damn!
What the hell is making him so stubborn?

MsgJp:
コイツは間もなく堕ちる――
あと一押し、何か《証拠》は無いのか！
MsgEn:
This guy is going to give up shortly...
One more push, is there any more evidence we can use?

MsgJp:
ある老人から預かったものだ
彼は息子を亡くしたと話していた
MsgEn:
I got this from an old man;
he told me he lost his son.

MsgJp:
男手一つで育てた息子を憲兵隊に送り出した後
連絡が取れなくなったため、殉職したものと
MsgEn:
After sending out his son, who he raised himself, to the military police;
he lost contact and assumed his son was killed in the line of duty.

MsgJp:
ほう、やはりお前の親父さんか
なぜ連絡してやらない？
MsgEn:
I knew it; he's your father.
Why didn't you contact him?

MsgJp:
家族と連絡を取れば、危険が及ぶからと――
上官に忠告を受けて――
MsgEn:
My superiors told me not to contact my family 
because it might put them in danger...

MsgJp:
なるほど、そうやって反乱の芽を
摘みやすい環境を作っている訳だな
繋がりを絶たせておけば、切り捨てるのも容易――
MsgEn:
I see, that's how they make it easier to nip rebellion in the bud.
It's easier to eliminate them if you keep them disconnected from others.

MsgJp:
<NPC 691>――頼む
親父さん、そしてお前自身のために
レジスタンスに協力してはくれないか？
MsgEn:
<NPC 691>--Please
for the sake of you and your father;
Will you help the resistance?

MsgJp:
――――わかった、俺の負けだ
あんたらに協力するよ
MsgEn:
---- Okay, I give up.
I'll help you guys out.

MsgJp:
俺の知っていることを話せばいいんだな
――と言っても俺は下っ端だから、あんたらが
期待するような大したことは知らないと思うぜ
MsgEn:
I should just tell you what I know
-- but since I'm a bad person, I don't think you guys know much about what you'd expect from

MsgJp:
あぁ、それで構わない！
ぜひ聞かせてくれ！
MsgEn:
Oh, that's fine!
Please let me hear it!

MsgJp:
覚者、よくやったな
<NPC 691>は完全に落ちた――尋問成功だ！
MsgEn:
Well done, Arisen. 
<NPC 691> has fully broken down—
interrogation successful!

MsgJp:
さぁ、コイツの持つ情報を全て聞き出そう
これで<NPC 681>のヤツに大きく近付けるぞ！
MsgEn:
Now, 
let's find out all the information this guy has.

With this we'll get a lot closer to <NPC 681>!

MsgJp:
さぁ、あとは持っている情報を全て聞き出すだけだ
何から聞こうか？
MsgEn:
Next, we need to get all the details. 
What will you start with?
B. What is the Military Police?

MsgJp:
憲兵隊――についてか？
そうだな、改めて説明すると難しいんだが――
MsgEn:
The Military Police?
Well, again, it's hard to explain..

MsgJp:
侯爵家直属の兵隊だな
オーク撤退後のメガドにおいて
強権統治の実働隊として動いている
MsgEn:
It's a soldier directly under the Marquess's family, isn't it
in Megado after the Orc retreat, and
is operating as a working force for powerful rule

MsgJp:
あー、つまり――
過激な治安維持部隊ってところだ
MsgEn:
Ah, I mean... it's a
radical security maintenance force

MsgJp:
正直言うと、市民はみんな憲兵に怯えてる
反抗的な態度や怪しい行動は
取締りの対象になるからな
MsgEn:
To be honest, all citizens are afraid of military police
because any rebellious attitudes and suspicious behavior are subject to
enforcement.

MsgJp:
そうと分かっていながら
なぜ所属していたんだ？
MsgEn:
Knowing that,
why were you a part of it?

MsgJp:
実は――
金が良いんだわ、これが
MsgEn:
As a matter of fact...
The pay is good - it really is.

MsgJp:
まぁ、稀に今回のような息の詰まる
特別任務が与えられることもあるが――
MsgEn:
Well, in rare cases, you'll be given a breathtaking
special mission like this one...

MsgJp:
良い給料で、市民に大きな顔できる上
オークとも戦わなくて済む
――最高の仕事だろ？
MsgEn:
A good salary, a big impression on the citizens
and not having to fight against orcs
— best job ever, right?

MsgJp: オークと戦わなくて済む――だと？
MsgEn: You don't have to fight against orcs?

MsgJp:
"オークとの戦闘は、王国兵士に任せておけ
  憲兵隊は、人間の相手をするのが仕事"
――ってことらしい
MsgEn:
"Leave the orc fighting to the soldiers of the kingdom.
The Military Police are supposed to deal with humans."
That's what they said.

MsgJp: ま、俺が知っているのはこれくらいかな――
MsgEn: Well, I think that's all I know.

MsgJp: ナヴィド・クルト侯爵ねぇ――

一応憲兵隊の指揮権を持ってるって話だけど
俺らみたいな下っ端じゃ
そうそうお目にかかれないぜ
MsgEn:
He supposedly has command over 
the military police, 
but someone like us low-ranking folks won't get 
to see him very often.

MsgJp:
むしろ覚者さん
あんたの方が詳しいんじゃないのかい？
MsgEn: In fact, aren't you more familiar with it, Arisen?

MsgJp: ――コイツ、昼まで監視してやがった

へへ――あぁ、そうそう！
憲兵隊を創設したのは<NPC 681>様だったな
MsgEn:
Heh—oh, that's right! 
<NPC 681> was the one who 
created the Military Police.

MsgJp:
先代侯爵が亡くなって、爵位を継いだ<NPC 681>様が
他にもいろいろ整備したって話だな
詳しくは忘れちまったけど――
MsgEn:
After the previous marquis passed away, 
<NPC 681> inherited the title and 
apparently made various improvements. 

I don't remember the details, though—

MsgJp:
まぁ、なんだかんだでメガドがここまで
発展してきたのは、<NPC 681>様の功績も
大きいって訳よ
MsgEn:
Ultimately, <NPC 681>'s accomplishments are 
a major reason for how far Megado has come.

MsgJp:
おいおい、そんな怖い顔すんなって！
俺が知っているのはこれくらいだな
MsgEn:
Hey hey, don't make such a scary face!
That's all I know.

MsgJp:
レジスタンスぅ？
そうだなぁ――

メフィスさん、あんたはバッチリ指名手配に
なってるぜ
だが――
MsgEn: Mephis, you're on the wanted list for sure. But—

MsgJp:
俺の知る限り、レジスタンスを大々的に
どうこうするって話はまだ聞いてねえなあ
MsgEn:
As far as I know, I haven't heard any major 
plans to deal with the resistance yet.

MsgJp:
まだ、そこまで危険視は
されていないということか？
MsgEn:
So, the resistance isn't 
considered a major threat yet?

MsgJp:
だな
まぁそもそも、レジスタンスについて
侯爵側の持っている情報が少なすぎるってのもある
MsgEn:
Yes.
Well, to begin with, there is too little 
information about the Resistance 
on the Marquis's side.

MsgJp:
――あるいは、全て筒抜けだからこそ
軽んじられているのか――
MsgEn:
--Or maybe it's being downplayed precisely 
because everything is leaked?

MsgJp:
いずれにせよ、侯爵様のご関心はレジスタンスより
覚者さん――あんたにあるようだぜ
MsgEn:
In any case, the Marquis seems to be interested in
the Arisen rather than the Resistance -- you

MsgJp: 結局、今回お前に与えられていた任務は何なんだ？
MsgEn:
After all, what was the mission you were 
given this time around?

MsgJp:
そりゃあもちろん、覚者さんの尾行・行動監視だ
それを逐一メモして、上官に提出する
MsgEn:
Well, of course, it's tracking and 
behavior monitoring on the Arisen.
Write it down one by one and submit it.

MsgJp: 一体指令は誰が出している？

直接の伝令は上官からだよ
で、任務についての詳しい質問や詮索は
許可されていない
MsgEn:
The orders are given by the superior officer. 
Detailed questions or probing about the 
mission are not allowed.

MsgJp:
だが噂では――指揮しているのは
侯爵家の家令、<NPC 586>さんだとか
MsgEn:
But according to rumors, the one in command is 
<NPC 586>, 
the steward of the marquis' household.

MsgJp:
<NPC 586>――か
覚者、お前は顔を見たことがあるかもしれんな
MsgEn:
<NPC 586>... I see. 
Arisen, you might recognize their face.

MsgJp:
まぁ、あくまで噂だぜ
<NPC 586>さんが独断で指揮しているのか
さらに上から命令を受けているのかは定かじゃない
MsgEn:
Well, it's just a rumor. 
I'm not sure if <NPC 586> is directing this 
on his own or if he's taking orders from
further up the chain.

MsgJp:
とにかくこれは有用な情報だぞ、覚者！
この先は<NPC 586>とかいう侯爵家の家令が
鍵となりそうだな――
MsgEn:
In any case, this information is 
quite useful, Arisen! 
The steward of the Marquis, 
<NPC 586>, 
seems to be the key moving forward.

MsgJp:
――これで、俺が知っていることは
全て話したぞ
MsgEn:
--That's it.
I've told you everything I know.

MsgJp:
――覚者、次のターゲットは<NPC 586>だ
次回<NPC 681>の屋敷へ行くときには
それとなく身辺を探ってくれ
MsgEn:
Arisen, the next target is <NPC 586>. 
When you head to 
<NPC 681>'s estate next time, 
subtly investigate the surroundings.

MsgJp:
なぁ、他に道も無いんだし
最後までレジスタンスに付き合うからさぁ――
MsgEn:
Look, there's no turning back now, 
so I'll see this through with the Resistance.

MsgJp: そろそろ解いてくれねえか？
MsgEn: Isn't it about time you untied me?

MsgJp:
――ヤツもこう言っていることだし
そろそろこの尋問を終えようか
MsgEn:
――Given what he's said, 
we should bring this interrogation to a close.

MsgJp:
フフ――正直、お前がここまでやるとは予想外だ
よく頑張ったな、覚者
MsgEn:
Huh - honestly, 
I didn't expect you to make it this far.
Good job, Arisen!

MsgJp:
<NPC 691>を落とせたのはお前の力だ
次もよろしく頼むぞ、相棒――
MsgEn:
It was your skill that took down <NPC 691>. 
Let's work together again, partner.

MsgJp:
おい！　
自分がどういう状況か分かっているのか！？
MsgEn:
Hey! 
Are you aware of the trouble you're in right now!?

MsgJp:
おい、急になんだよ！
ただのゴロツキだって言ってるだろ！
MsgEn:
Hey, what's going on!? 
I've already said, I'm just a lowlife!

MsgJp:
そうか、ならばそれを証明できる
人物はいるんだな？
MsgEn:
Well, then there's a
person who can prove it, right?

MsgJp:
あ、あぁ――！
もちろんだ！

覚者、ゴロツキの身分を証明できるという
人物を探してみよう
あるいは――証明できないという証明でもいい
MsgEn:
Arisen, let's try to find someone who can vouch 
for this thug's identity. 
Or perhaps, proof that they 
can't back up his story will suffice.

MsgJp:
おい、いい加減にしろ！
一体どういうつもりで尾行した！？
MsgEn:
Hey, come on!
What the hell were you thinking following me?

MsgJp:
わっ――なんだよ驚かすな
衝動的な追い剥ぎだって言ってるだろ
MsgEn:
Hey—what's going on? 
I told you, 
I'm just a spur-of-the-moment bandit!

MsgJp:
衝動的な、か――
ならば、衝動的じゃない《証拠》があれば
認めるんだな？
MsgEn:
Impulsive, huh--
So if we have "proof" that it's not impulsive,
you'll admit it?

MsgJp: ハッ、そんなもんある訳ないだろ

奴が本当に尾行していたなら、付近の地形や
俺たちの行動を事前調査していたはず
――目撃者がいてもおかしくないな
MsgEn:
If he was really following us, 
he would have surveyed the nearby terrain and
our movements in advance.
--I wouldn't be surprised if there were witnesses.

MsgJp:
俺達の尾行時につけていたメモを出してみろ
だと――？
MsgEn:
You want me to hand over the notes I took 
while tailing you—huh?

MsgJp:
どこにあるかお前が一番よく知ってんだろうが！
隠したんだろう？
場所を言え！！
MsgEn:
You know best where it is!
You hid it, didn't you?
Tell me where it is!

MsgJp:
し、知らねえよ！
そもそもあんな、何もない場所で隠しても
すぐに見つかっちまうだろうが！
MsgEn:
I-I don't know! 
Hiding something in a place like that, 
it'd be found right away!

MsgJp:
――覚者、<NPC 691>は確保されるまで
確実にそのメモを持っていたはずだ
捕まる瞬間に捨てたか隠したか――
MsgEn:
Arisen, <NPC 691> must have had that note 
until they were captured. 
They either threw it away or hid it at the 
moment of their capture.

MsgJp:
いずれにせよ、現場から離れていないはずだ
奴を捕まえたのは俺たちの集会所にほど近い路地――
覚者、行ってみよう
MsgEn:
—In any case, it shouldn't be far from the scene. 
The alley where we captured them is quite close 
to our meeting place. Let's head over, Arisen.

MsgJp:
おい、いい加減時間稼ぎは止めろ！
痛めつけられたいのか？
MsgEn:
Hey, come on, stop stalling!
You want to get hurt?

MsgJp:
な、何か他の《証拠》でもあるってのか！？
不気味なメモ一つで、俺が何か企んでるなんて
あんまりじゃねえか！
MsgEn:
—Do you have any other "evidence" 
to back this up?! 
It's outrageous to think I'm planning something 
based on just one strange note!

MsgJp:
少し外で頭でも冷やしてきたらどうだ？
冷静になって
自分の馬鹿な行いを見つめなおして来いよ！
MsgEn:
—Why don't you go outside and cool 
your head a bit? 
Calm down and take a good look 
at your foolish actions!

MsgJp:
――コイツの言うことも一理ある
覚者、一度諜報に出て、まだ行ってない場所や
戦ってない敵と戦うのも良いかもしないぞ
MsgEn:
—There's some truth to what this guy is saying. 
Arisen, it might be a good idea to go out on a 
reconnaissance mission, explore places you 
haven't been to yet, 
and fight enemies you haven't faced.

MsgJp:
そして他の《証拠》を例のメモと
じっくり見比べてみろ
――自ずと答えは見えるはずだぜ
MsgEn:
Then, examine the other 
evidence closely against that memo. 
—The answer will come to light.

MsgJp:
憲兵めが、自分の状況をわかっているのか？
その気になれば殺せるんだぞ！
MsgEn:
The military police—
are they even aware of their predicament? 
I could end them whenever I choose!

MsgJp:
フン――今さらそんな脅しが通じるか
捕まった失態は、貴様らの逮捕で
挽回してやるからな
MsgEn:
Hmph—
do you really think those threats will 
scare me now? 
I'll redeem myself for getting captured 
by taking you down!

MsgJp:
――あの無慈悲な侯爵が、こんな大失敗を
その程度の手柄で許すと思うか？
MsgEn:
――Do you think the unforgiving marquis will 
let a failure this big slide for a simple 
accomplishment like that?

MsgJp:
覚者、憲兵は市民に対し権力を持つ代わりに
非常に厳しく冷酷な戒律で縛られている
コイツにはまだ、その実感が無いんだ――
MsgEn:
Arisen, 
the military police hold power over the citizens,
but they're also bound by cruel and strict rules.
This guy hasn't realized that yet.

MsgJp:
その現実を知らしめるような《証拠》は無いか？
昔はよく、メガドの裏路地で
憲兵の悲惨な噂を聞いたもんだったが――
MsgEn:
Do we have any kind of proof that could open his 
eyes to this reality? 
I recall hearing many dreadful tales about the 
military police in the alleys of Megado...

MsgJp:
おい！
憲兵たちのやり方に何とも思わないのか！？
MsgEn:
Hey!
Do you really have no problem with the way 
the military police operate!?

MsgJp:
思わない――というより
思いたくても、思ってはいけないんだ
所属している限りはな
MsgEn:
It's not that I don't care—
I'm not allowed to care, even if I wanted to.
As long as I'm one of them.

MsgJp:
思ってしまえば、行動や見た目に滲み出る
脱走兵なんて――
そうなれば、手が及ぶのは俺だけでは済まない
MsgEn:
If you let yourself think about it, 
it seeps into your actions and appearance. 
Once that happens, the repercussions won't be 
limited to just me.

MsgJp:
ヤツは揺らいでいる――
誰かを心配しているのか？
MsgEn:
He's wavering—
might he be anxious about someone?

MsgJp:
覚者――メガドに思い当る人物はいないか？
誰かは分からんが
きっとその人物が鍵となるはずだ
MsgEn:
Arisen—does anyone in Megado come to mind? 
I'm not sure who, 
but that person is likely the key.
Do you want to debug it?

MsgJp: どっちのモーションを見る？
どのモーションを見る？
MsgEn: Which motion would you like to see?

MsgJp: 000 ナイトウォーカー待機LOOP
003 尋問対象に語りかける
015 PL側を向く～選択待ち待機LOOP
MsgEn:
015 Facing the PL side – 
Awaiting selection, standby LOOP

MsgJp: 025 PLの視点を変える（尋問失敗）
ドノ「もーしょん」ヲミル？
MsgEn: Do you want to see "Dono's motion"?

MsgJp: 009 通常座り　→　座りピンチ
MsgEn: 009 normal sitting → sitting nervous? crossed legs?

MsgJp:
今まで何度も尋問は行ってきたが
さすがにオークは初めてだぜ
MsgEn:
I've conducted interrogations many times before, 
but this is the first time with an orc.

MsgJp:
とはいえ――やり方は今までと同じだ
今さら説明はいらないな？
MsgEn:
Nonetheless — the method is the same as before
You don't need further explanation now, right?

MsgJp:
それじゃ、早速始めるか
手始めに基本的な《話題》から聞いてみよう
MsgEn:
Well, let's get started:
Let's start with a basic "topic" for starters.
A. Purpose of coming to Megado

MsgJp:
裏切り者と思わしき人間とオークが共に居た
――これだけで限りなく決定的に近い
状況ではあるが、一応聞いてやる
MsgEn:
The fact that a suspected traitor and an orc were 
together is almost conclusive, 
but I'll still give you a chance to explain.

MsgJp: 一体あの場所で何をしていた？
MsgEn: What the hell were you doing in that place?

MsgJp:
フン――愚カナ人間メ
アノ死ンダ人間ニデモ、聞イテミロ！
MsgEn:
Hmph—Stupid humans. 
Try asking that dead human!

MsgJp:
おーくガ、人間ニ協力スルコトナド
火山ガ噴火シヨウガ、アリエナイ！
MsgEn:
There's no way an orc would help humans, 
not even if a volcano erupted!

MsgJp:
チッ――当然だが
簡単に答えてはくれないか
MsgEn:
Tch—Of course, 
it won't be easy to get answers.

MsgJp:
やはり、まずは証拠を手に入れてから
糸口を見つけていくしかないようだな――
MsgEn:
It seems we'll need to gather evidence first 
and find a clue from there.

MsgJp:
覚者、現場は調べてみたか？
証拠を見つけられるとしたら
最も可能性が高いのはあの場所だ
MsgEn:
Arisen, have you investigated the scene? 
If we're going to find evidence, 
that place is the most likely spot.

MsgJp:
もしまだ調べていないのなら
まずはこの事件が発生した現場を調べてみよう
MsgEn:
If you haven't already checked it out,
let's try the site where this incident occurred.

MsgJp:
おいおい――怖気づいたのか？
始まったばかりだぞ
MsgEn:
Whoa now — are you scared?
We're just getting started.

MsgJp:
ゲハハッ！　俺ガ怖イノカ？
オ前、本当ニアノ覚者カ？
MsgEn:
Gehaha!　Are you afraid of me?
Are you really an Arisen?

MsgJp:
ほら、オークにまで言われてるぞ
悔しくないのか？
MsgEn:
Look, even an orc is saying it. 
Aren't you frustrated?

MsgJp:
ここで安全に尋問できる時間は限られている――
出来る時に出来ることをやっておこう
MsgEn:
We have a limited amount of time to safely 
interrogate them here--
Let's do what we can.

MsgJp: お前自身のことを聞かせてもらおうか

俺ノコトダト？
フン――貴様ラ人間ニ、関係アルノカ？
MsgEn:
You want to know about me? 
Hmph—what concern is that to you humans?

MsgJp: それは、聞いてから俺たちが決めることだ
MsgEn: That's for us to decide after we hear it.

MsgJp: いつ頃からオーク軍に所属しているんだ？
MsgEn: Since when have you been part of the Orc Army?

MsgJp:
フン――貴様ラノ間抜ケナ王子ヲ
捻リ潰ス、ズット前カラサ
MsgEn:
Hmph—
I've wanted to crush that useless prince 
of yours since long ago.

MsgJp:
残念だったな、ネド王子は
貴様らオークを出し抜いてご健在なんだ
MsgEn:
Too bad Prince Nedo is still alive and well after
outfoxing you orcs.

MsgJp:
――ウガァァ！
今、生キテイヨウガ、死ンデイヨウガ
ソレハ小サナ違イダ！
MsgEn:
—Ughhh! 
Alive or dead, 
it's a minor difference!

MsgJp:
勝ツノハ、俺タチ！
人間ナド皆殺シダ！
MsgEn:
We will win! 
We'll slaughter all humans!

MsgJp:
そうかそうか――ところで、さっきより
ずいぶんと饒舌になったな？
MsgEn:
Ok, ok - by the way, you're a lot more
talkative than you used to be, aren't you?

MsgJp: 逃げるのも諦めて観念したのか？
MsgEn:
Have you given up on escaping 
and resigned yourself?

MsgJp:
観念ダト？　馬鹿メ！
おーくハ、絶対ニ！　人間ナドニ屈シナイ！
MsgEn:
Resigned? Idiot! 
An orc never bows to humans!

MsgJp:
ソシテ、今ニ貴様ラハ
後悔スルコトニナルダロウ！

おーくノ軍ハ、スグニチカラヲ溜メテ戻ッテクル
ソシテ俺ヲ助ケ出シ、チッポケナ人間ドモヲ
マタ奴隷ニスルノダ
MsgEn:
The orc army will gather its strength and return. 
They will rescue me and wipe out 
all you insignificant humans.
-- You have a lot of confidence.

MsgJp: フン――命乞イシテモ遅イ
MsgEn: Hah— it's too late to beg for your life now.

MsgJp:
かなり自信満々のようだが――
オーク1匹を助けるために満身創痍の
オーク軍が来ると、本当に思うか？
MsgEn:
You seem quite confident, 
but do you really believe that the already 
beaten orc army would come all this way just 
to save a single orc?

MsgJp:
オーク軍の情報を引き出すには
この鼻っ柱をへし折ってやるか――
MsgEn:
To get the orc army's information, 
we might need to crush this arrogance.

MsgJp:
あるいは、口を滑らしてしまうような
上機嫌にさせる《証拠》があると良いんだが――
MsgEn:
Alternatively, it would be ideal to have some 
evidence that puts them in such a good mood 
that they might slip up.

MsgJp:
フゥ――なるほど
オークとまともに対話するのは初めてだが
やはりスムーズにはいかないな
MsgEn:
Huh... I see.
This is the first time I've had a 
proper conversation with an orc.

It's not exactly going smoothly.

MsgJp:
しかも――どうやらコイツ
長い事オーク軍にいたらしいが
MsgEn:
What's more... apparently this guy
has been in the Orc Army for a long time.

MsgJp:
今まで戦死もせず、出世も
できていないところを見ると
口だけは立派な雑魚オークのようだな
MsgEn:
Seeing as how he hasn't died in battle and hasn't 
been able to rise to the top,
he seems to be a small fry orc with a big mouth.

MsgJp:
おい覚者、コイツどうしようか
始末するか？
MsgEn:
Hey Arisen, what should we do with this guy? 
Should we get rid of him?

MsgJp:
ウガァァァァァ！！
人間メ――コレ以上ノ侮辱ハ、許サンゾ！
MsgEn:
Ugaaaaaa!! 
Humans— 
I won't tolerate any more of this humiliation!

MsgJp:
なんだ、気に障ったか？ 
だが事実だろう
MsgEn:
What, you don't like it? 
But it's true.

MsgJp:
ウガァァァァ！！
伝令兵ハ生キ残リ
手紙ヲ届ケルコトガ仕事ダ！
MsgEn:
Guhgaaaaaa!! 
The messenger is to stay alive 
and deliver the letter!

MsgJp:
生キ長ラエ、軍ニ貢献シ続ケルコト
優秀デアル証ナノダ！
無知ナ人間メ、捻リ潰シテヤル！
MsgEn:
Surviving and contributing to the army is 
evidence of superiority! 

I'll crush ignorant humans!

MsgJp:
ほう――思いがけず重要な情報を
二つ得られたな
MsgEn:
Ho—
We unexpectedly got two important pieces 
of information.

MsgJp:
一つ目――どうやらオークはあえて怒らせたり
おだてたりするとよく喋るようだな
これからの尋問に役立ちそうだ
MsgEn:
One, it seems that orcs tend to talk more when 
they are deliberately provoked or flattered. 
This might be useful for future interrogations.

MsgJp:
それからもう一つ――
このオークは伝令兵として
メガドまではるばる文書を届けに来たんだ
MsgEn:
Two; this orc came all the way to Megado 
as a messenger to deliver a document.

MsgJp:
となると
<COL ff2600>届けに来たオークの文書が
事件現場のどこかにまだある可能性が高い</COL>
MsgEn:
Then it's likely that the document delivered by 
the orc is 
<COL ff2600>still somewhere at the scene of the incident.</COL>

MsgJp:
覚者、まずはそれを足がかりとして
諜報活動を始めていこう
MsgEn:
Arisen, let's use that as a starting point and 
begin our intelligence activities.

MsgJp:
来たな
さぁ、今日も始めようか
MsgEn:
You're here.
OK, let's start today too.

MsgJp: 本当に、今日の尋問はこれで終了にしていいんだな？
MsgEn: Are you sure you want to call it quits on today's interrogation?

MsgJp: ――今日はこのくらいにしてやるか

――ゲハハハッ！
愚カナ人間、頭オカシクナッタカ
MsgEn:
-- Gehahaha!
Foolish humans, have you gone mad?

MsgJp:
――その《証拠》を突きつけるのは
ここではなさそうだな
MsgEn:
It seems that presenting that evidence isn't 
the right approach here.

MsgJp:
脅してさらなる情報を引き出したり
諜報で新たな《証拠》を探すのもいい
――もう一度よく考えてみるんだ
MsgEn:
You can threaten them to extract more information 
or search for new evidence using intelligence
— think about it again.

MsgJp:
――本当にそう思うか？
もう一度、よく考え直してみたらどうだ？
MsgEn:
--do you really think so?
Why don't you think again?

MsgJp:
――グハハ！　愚カナ人間メ！
恐怖デ、頭オカシクナッタカ
MsgEn:
-- Hahaha! You foolish humans! 
Have you gone mad from fear?

MsgJp:
チッ、オークに舐められちまったみたいだな
――二度目はしっかりな？
MsgEn:
Tch, it looks like the orc is 
treating us with contempt. 

-- Make sure not to let it happen a second time.

MsgJp: 手始めに、基本的なことでも聞いてみるか
MsgEn: Let's ask some basic questions for starters.
A. Purpose of coming to Megado

MsgJp:
良い調子だな――
さて、何を聞く？
MsgEn:
You're in good shape—
Well, what to ask?
A. Purpose of coming to Megado
C, During the occupation of Megado.
A. Purpose of coming to Megado

MsgJp:
良い調子だな――
さて、何を聞く？
MsgEn:
You're in good shape—
Well, what to ask?
A. Purpose of coming to Megado
C, During the occupation of Megado.

MsgJp:
良い調子だな――
さて、何を聞く？
MsgEn:
You're in good shape—
Well, what to ask?
A. Purpose of coming to Megado
C, During the occupation of Megado.

MsgJp:
あと一歩だな――
よし、頼むぞ
MsgEn:
We're just one step away—
Okay, I'll ask.
A. Purpose of coming to Megado
C, During the occupation of Megado.

MsgJp:
このままでは埒が明かない――
強硬手段が効かないか、実際に試させてもらう
覚者、悪いがこれにお前の意思は関係ない
MsgEn:
If we continue like this, we'll get nowhere—
If strong measures don't work, 
I'll have to put them to the test myself.
Arisen, sorry, 
but your input isn't required for this.

MsgJp:
少しあっちを向いていろ
お前に見せるには
少し刺激が強いからな――
MsgEn:
Arisen, look away for a moment.
What I'm about to do is a bit too intense for 
you to see...

MsgJp:
まったく、手こずらせやがって
明日はもう少し喋る気になるだろう――
MsgEn:
You're a real hassle.
By tomorrow, you'll be more willing to talk.

MsgJp:
さて――裏切り者と思わしき人間と
オークが共に居た
MsgEn:
Now then—
The supposed traitor was seen with an orc.

MsgJp:
これだけで限りなく決定的に
近い状況ではあるが、一応聞いてやる
MsgEn:
With this alone, the situation is almost certainly 
conclusive, but I'll ask anyway.

MsgJp: 一体あの場所で何をしようとしていた？
MsgEn: What the hell were you trying to do in that place?

MsgJp:
フン――愚カナ人間メ
アノ死ンダ人間ニデモ、聞イテミロ！
MsgEn:
Hmph—Stupid humans. 
Try asking that dead human!

MsgJp:
おーくガ、人間ニ降参スルコトナド
火山ガ噴火シヨウガアリエナイ！
MsgEn:
There's no chance an orc would ever yield to 
humans, even if a volcano were to erupt!

MsgJp:
チッ――
当然だが簡単に答えてはくれないか
MsgEn:
Tch—Of course, 
it won't be easy to get answers.

MsgJp:
覚者、まずは事件現場を調査して
《証拠》を手に入れよう
それを突きつけ、糸口にするんだ――
MsgEn:
Arisen, begin by inspecting the scene
to find "evidence."
Use that to press for answers.

MsgJp:
どのような手を使ってでも協力してもらうぞ
まずは――この文書についてだ
MsgEn:
No matter what methods I have to use, 
you'll cooperate. 

First, let's talk about this document.
I see your expression has shifted.

MsgJp:
お前がメガドに訪れたのは
これを届けるためだな？
MsgEn:
You came to Megado
to deliver this, right?

MsgJp:
この文書――オーク軍の暗号か何かだな
なんと書いてあるか、読み上げろ
MsgEn:
This document--
it's some kind of Orc military code or something.

What does it say? Read it out loud.

MsgJp: ――オ前タチ、読メナインダロウ？

読ンデヤル――ワケナイダロウガ！
愚カダナ！　貴様ラ、愚カダナ！
MsgEn:
Read it — why would I!
Stupid fool! You're an idiot!

MsgJp:
驚いたな――
俺たち、オークにコケにされてるぞ！
MsgEn:
Unbelievable— 
we're getting ridiculed by an orc!

MsgJp:
おい、いずれ分かることなんだ――
時間を稼いでも無駄だぞ
MsgEn:
Hey, we'll find out sooner or later--
You're wasting your time.

MsgJp: グハハ！　面白イ人間ドモダ

クソ、完全に舐められちまったようだな
――すまない
MsgEn:
Shit, we've clearly been overcome. 
I apologize.

MsgJp:
オークを動揺させるには
もっと決定的な証拠が必要だ
やはりこの文書を翻訳するしかないか――
MsgEn:
To unsettle the orc, 
more decisive evidence is needed. 
Seems we must translate this document after all.

MsgJp:
覚者、＜オーク軍の密通文書＞を翻訳する手段を
メガドで探してみよう
内容さえ分かったら、あとは突きつけてやるだけだ
MsgEn:
Arisen, look for a method to translate the 
"Orc Army Secret Documents" in Megado. 

Once we know its contents, 
we can present it and take action.

MsgJp:
バジットの時に世話になった<NPC 698>なら
何か知っているかもしれないな
MsgEn:
If anyone might know something, 
it would be <NPC 698>, 
who helped us during the Basit situation.

MsgJp:
手紙の内容は
"オーク軍は要請に応え、メガドに援軍を手配した"
という旨だった――間違いないな？
MsgEn:
The content of the letter was to the effect that 
"The Orc army responded to the request and 
arranged reinforcements for Megado"

— there's no doubt about that?

MsgJp:
問題は――
一体誰がオークの援軍を要請したか
MsgEn:
The question is--
who on earth called for orc reinforcements?

MsgJp:
その手がかりは、ナヴィドの執事である
エニスが握っていた――はずだったんだがな
MsgEn:
The clue was - or should have been - 
held by Navid's butler,
Ennis.

MsgJp: なぜ取引相手であるエニスを殺したんだ？
MsgEn: Why did you kill Ennis, your business partner?

MsgJp:
アノ人間来タアト――
覚者、オ前ノ臭イガシタ！
MsgEn:
After that human came—
Arisen, I smelled your stink!

MsgJp:
アノ人間ガ、おーく軍ヲ裏切リ、覚者ト組ンデ
俺ヲ殺ソウトシタ――ダカラ殺シタ
MsgEn:
That human betrayed the orc army and teamed up 
with the Arisen to kill me—so I killed them.

MsgJp:
グルル！
おーくハ！　裏切リヲ！　許サナイ！

誤解だった――と言っても今更意味はない
それよりも、この証言を
何かに活かせないか考えよう
MsgEn:
There's no point in 
saying it was a misunderstanding —

Rather than that,
let's think about whether this testimony 
can be used in something

MsgJp: オークは裏切りを許さない――か
MsgEn:
Orcs are unforgiving when it 
comes to betrayal, huh...

MsgJp:
取引相手すら手にかけるほど
激昂するとはな
その特性――何かに利用できるかもな
MsgEn:
He was so enraged, he killed his own ally. 
That kind of temper... 
it might be something we can exploit.

MsgJp:
現場を調べたら見つかったこの密通文書――
メガドの通称 "ガクシャ" に訳してもらったら
こんなことが書いてあった
MsgEn:
The clandestine document found during 
the investigation—
when translated by the "Scholar" of Megado, 
it turned out to say this.

MsgJp:
"オーク軍はメガドに援軍を手配した"
要請したのは、一体誰なのか――
MsgEn:
"The Orc Army has arranged 
reinforcements for Megado"
Who exactly requested it ――

MsgJp:
だが、それを知っている<NPC 586>は殺された
"覚者の臭いがしたから、裏切られたと思った"
――という動機らしい
MsgEn:
The person who knew about it, 
<NPC 586>, was killed. 
The motive appears to be that 
"they smelled the scent of the Arisen and 
thought they had been betrayed."

MsgJp:
オークは裏切りを絶対に許さない――
この特性は利用できるかもしれないぞ
覚えておこう
MsgEn:
Orcs never forgive betrayal --
You might be able to use this characteristic.
Let's keep that in mind.

MsgJp: お前自身のことを聞かせてもらおうか
いつ頃からオーク軍に所属しているんだ？
MsgEn: Since when have you been part of the Orc Army?

MsgJp: フン――貴様ラ人間ニ、関係アルノカ？
MsgEn: Hmph—Does it concern you humans in any way?

MsgJp:
ダガコレダケ教エテヤル
――命乞イナラ今ノウチダ
MsgEn:
I'll tell you this much—
if you want to beg for your life, now is the time.

MsgJp:
おーく軍ハ、スグチカラヲ溜メ、戻ッテクル
ソシテ俺ヲ助ケ出シ、チッポケナ人間ドモヲ
マタ奴隷ニスルノダ
MsgEn:
The orc army will soon gather its 
strength and come back. 

They'll rescue me and turn you insignificant 
humans into slaves again.

MsgJp: このオーク――かなり自信があるらしいな
MsgEn: This orc—he seems to be quite confident.

MsgJp:
オーク軍の情報を引き出すには
この鼻っ柱をへし折ってやるか
MsgEn:
To get the orc army's information, 
we might need to crush this arrogance.

MsgJp:
あるいは、口を滑らしてしまうような
上機嫌にさせる証拠があると
良いんだが――
MsgEn:
Alternatively, it would be ideal to have some 
evidence that puts them in such a good mood 
that they might slip up.

MsgJp: いや、お前の話を疑うつもりは無い
MsgEn: No, I don't doubt your story.

MsgJp:
実はここだけの話なんだが――
引いたはずのオーク軍がいくらか
この街に戻っているという噂があってな
MsgEn:
Actually, between you and me--
There are rumors that some of the orc forces, 
which were supposed to have withdrawn, 
are returning to this city.

MsgJp:
まさか、あのオーク軍がたった1人のオークを
救うため戻ってくるとはにわかに信じ難いが――
MsgEn:
It's hard to believe that the orc army would 
return just to save one orc, but――

MsgJp: グァッハッハッハ！　ヤハリナ！

貴様ラ皆殺シニシテヤル！
アノめがど奪取以降、マタ人間ノ血ヲ
浴ビラレル時ガ来タノダ！
MsgEn:
You will all be killed!
After the capture of Megado, 
it's time once more to be soaked in human blood!!

MsgJp:
お前はオーク軍に占領されていた頃から
メガドにいたのか？
MsgEn:
Have you been in Megado since it 
was under Orc occupation?

MsgJp:
フン、当然ダ！ 
常ニ最前線ニ、在ルコトコソ戦士ノ証
MsgEn:
Well, of course! 
Always being on the front lines is the mark of a warrior.

MsgJp:
人間ドモガ、愚カナ反抗ヲ起コシタラ
ソノ時、伝令兵ガイナケレバ
一体誰ガ事態ヲ伝達スル！
MsgEn:
If the humans start a foolish rebellion, 
who will report the situation if 
there are no messengers?

MsgJp:
どうやらこのオークは
占領下のメガドについて詳しいようだぞ
MsgEn:
It appears this orc is knowledgeable 
about Megado during its occupation.

MsgJp:
もしかすると、ナヴィドの悪事の証拠を
入手できるかもしれないな
街に増えるオークどもの真意も気になるが――
MsgEn:
We might be able to gather 
evidence of Navid's wrongdoings. 

I'm also curious by the true motives of the 
growing number of orcs in the city.

MsgJp:
まずは上機嫌で口が軽くなっている今
占領下の<NPC 681>の情報を聞き出そう
MsgEn:
Since he's in high spirits and more 
inclined to talk, 
let's extract information about <NPC 681> 
during the occupation period.

MsgJp:
このオークは繰り返していた――
"今にオークの仲間が、体勢を立て直し
  メガドを再侵攻し、俺を助けに来るはずだ"――と
MsgEn:
The Orc repeatedly said—
"Soon, my fellow Orcs will recover, re-attack 
Megado, and come to rescue me."

MsgJp:
グアハハ！　ソウダ！
ヤット命乞イヲスル準備ガデキタカ！
MsgEn:
Guahaha!　That's right!
I'm ready for you to beg for your life!

MsgJp:
確かに、街にはオークが増えている
目撃者の証言によると
"奴らは何かを探しているようだ"――だとさ
MsgEn:
The orcs are indeed increasing in the city. 
Witnesses say, 
"They seem to be searching for something."

MsgJp:
その《証拠》を突きつけたせいでヤツは今
超がつくほど上機嫌な訳だが――チャンスでもある
今なら、他の《話題》でも口が軽くなっているはずだ
MsgEn:
Confronting him with that "evidence" has put him 
in a surprisingly good mood—giving us a chance. 
He should be more forthcoming 
about other "topics" now.

MsgJp:
伝令兵なのに、前線で動いていたなんて
随分と危険な任務をしていたんだな？
MsgEn:
You're a messenger and you've been 
working on the front lines.
You've been on some pretty dangerous missions, 
haven't you?

MsgJp:
グァッハッハッハ！ 
当然ダ
危険デアレバアルホド、名誉ナ任務ナノダ！
MsgEn:
Guhahaha! 
Of course,
it's dangerous, an honorable mission!

MsgJp:
前線にいたということは、人間達とも
接する機会が多かったんじゃないか？
MsgEn:
Being on the front line meant that there were 
many opportunities to interact with humans, right?

MsgJp: 例えば――ナヴィド侯爵とか

ナビ――何ダト？
人間ノ名ナド、イチイチ覚エテイナイ！
MsgEn:
Navi - what?
I can't remember every single human name!

MsgJp:
伝達兵なら何度か関わりがあっても
良さそうなものだがな
名前だけではわからないか――
MsgEn:
You should be able to recognize a messenger if 
you've interacted with them multiple times. 
Is the name not enough?

MsgJp: おお、確かにこれなら分かりやすいな
MsgEn: Oh, this makes it much clearer.

MsgJp:
ホラ、この人間だ
人間達のリーダーだったそうだから
覚えているんじゃないか？
MsgEn:
Look, it's this human. 
He was their leader, 
so you probably know him, right?

MsgJp: ん？ どうやらピンと来たみたいだな
MsgEn: Hmm? Looks like it rang a bell.

MsgJp: グルルル――ソノ不快ナ顔見セルナ！
MsgEn: Grrrrr――Don't show me that vile face!

MsgJp:
ひょっとすると――コイツが鍵を握っているかもな
<NPC 681>について知っていること――
全て聞き出してやろうぜ
MsgEn:
He might be the key――
let's make him reveal everything he knows 
about <NPC 681>――

MsgJp:
そうだな――まずはメガドで
常識となりつつある、<NPC 681>の
英雄譚について真偽を確かめよう
MsgEn:
Indeed――first, let's verify the truth of the 
legend of <NPC 681>, 
which is becoming common knowledge in Megado.

MsgJp:
ナヴィドはメガド占領中
人間達のリーダーを務めていたそうだな
MsgEn:
It seems that Navid was the human leader during 
the occupation of Megado.

MsgJp:
人間達をまとめ、オーク達との間を
取り持っていたと聞いているが
それは間違い無いのか？
MsgEn:
I've been told they brought the humans together 
and mediated with the orcs—can you confirm that?

MsgJp:
――ウグウゥ
確カニ――奴ハ人間ノ分際デ、出シャバリ
奴隷ドモノ、統括ヲ始メタ――
MsgEn:
Ugh... 
Yeah, that human had the nerve to interfere 
and manage the slaves...

MsgJp:
市民たちの話は事実だった、のか？
じゃあ、奴は本当に潔白だった――
MsgEn:
So the citizens were telling the truth?
So he really was innocent--

MsgJp:
ケッパク――潔白――？
グフ――グッフッフ――

まだ何か――話していない<NPC 681>の
行動があるのか？
MsgEn:
Is there more about <NPC 681>'s 
behavior you haven't mentioned?

MsgJp:
――オークよ
俺たちはナヴィドがどんな裏切りをしたか知り
罰を与えたいだけだ
MsgEn:
—Orc, 
we seek only to uncover Navid's treachery 
and see him punished.

MsgJp:
さぁ、聞かせてくれ――
人間の分際で、ナヴィドは
どんなことをしたか教えてくれ
MsgEn:
So, tell us—
what did Navid do, despite being just a human?

MsgJp:
――ガッハッハ！
人間ノ罰ナド、何ノ面白味モ無イガ
受ケルノガ、アノ人間ナラバ――面白ソウダ
MsgEn:
Gahahaha! 
A human punishment is dull,
but if it's that man, it could be entertaining.

MsgJp:
ヨク聞ケ！
アノ人間ハ、モウヒトツ取引シテイタ
MsgEn:
Listen to me!
That human being is a deal breaker.

MsgJp:
<COL ff2600>めがどヲ自ラ
我々、おーく軍ニアケ渡シ
物資ヤ戦利品、受ケ取ッテイタ！</COL>
MsgEn:
<COL ff2600>Megado opened its gates to our Orc army
in exchange for supplies and spoils!</COL>

MsgJp:
――メガドの功労者ナヴィド侯爵の
明るみになっていない事実
MsgEn:
――The hidden truths
about Marquis Navid, the hero of Megado.

MsgJp:
ナヴィドとオークの癒着――
ついに、決定的な悪事を突き止めたぞ
MsgEn:
Navid and Orc collusion--
Finally, we've pinpointed the definitive evil!

MsgJp: さぁ、詳しく聞き出さないとな
MsgEn: Come on. We've got to get the details.

MsgJp:
《証拠》のおかげでオークはやっと
<NPC 681>のことを思い出したようだな
そして――
MsgEn:
Thanks to the evidence, the orc has finally
recalled <NPC 681>. And now――

MsgJp:
奴は、自らメガドをオークに明け渡したこと――
オーク軍と交渉し、人間の統率を行う代わりに
オーク軍から報酬を受け取っていたことが分かった
MsgEn:
It was revealed that he himself had
surrendered Megado to the orcs—
that he negotiated with the orc army
and received rewards from them in return
for managing the humans.
For someone of his lowly human status—!

MsgJp:
まさか、下っ端と思われたオークの口から
核心を聞き出すことができるとはな――
さぁ、さらに話を聞いて行こう
MsgEn:
Who would have thought we'd get essential info 
from a lowly orc—
Let's keep probing for more.

MsgJp:
メガドがあまりにも早く陥落したのは
ナヴィドの手引きがあったからか――
MsgEn:
The reason Megado fell so quickly was 
because of Navid's assistance--

MsgJp:
人間ガ――人間ノ分際デ
おーくト取引シヨウナド！
MsgEn: A human—striking deals with orcs, of all things!

MsgJp: そんな取引をオーク軍が許したのか？
MsgEn: Did the orc army actually permit such a deal?

MsgJp:
落ち着け、お前がなぜ怒るのか――教えてくれ
その取引に応じたのは――
MsgEn:
Relax. 
Why does this anger you? 
Who made the deal?

MsgJp: 俺ナラ！　許サナカッタ！
MsgEn: It was me! I didn't approve!

MsgJp:
ならば、応じたのは――お前の上官なんだな？
お前の意志ではなかったと
MsgEn:
So, 
it was your superior who agreed to it, not you?

MsgJp:
オーク軍にも酔狂な奴がいるもんだな
あるいは――その時にはまだ
人間と取引をする心の余裕があったのか
MsgEn:
The Orc army has its own oddities. 
Alternatively――
maybe they still had some tolerance for 
negotiating with humans at that time.

MsgJp:
まずいぞ、オークが興奮してきた――
だが話は繋がってきたな
MsgEn:
This is bad, the Orc is getting agitated―― 
but the story is coming together.

MsgJp:
ナヴィドはオークと取引し
降伏してメガドを明け渡した
MsgEn:
Navid made a deal with the Orcs, 
surrendered, and handed over Megado.

MsgJp:
そして占領下の市民たちを指揮し
まるで英雄のように振る舞っているが――
裏ではオークと癒着し私腹を肥やしていた
MsgEn:
And while he leads the citizens under occupation 
and acts like a hero, behind the scenes he was 
colluding with the Orcs and enriching himself.

MsgJp:
――とはいえ
オークの証言だけでは糾弾する証拠として
あまりにも弱い
MsgEn:
-- Nevertheless, the orc's testimony alone 
is too flimsy to be considered solid 
evidence for an indictment.

MsgJp:
何か、<NPC 681>が私腹を肥やしていたことの
具体的な《証拠》が無いことにはな――
MsgEn:
Unless you have some
concrete "proof" that <NPC 681>
was lining his own pockets...

MsgJp:
――これは？
日付や数字のリストのようだが――
